words.tr: 他最后一刻退缩了（chickened out：怯懦地退缩；临阵脱逃）
words.uk: hi ˈtʃɪkənd aʊt æt ðə lɑːst ˈməʊmənt
words.us: hi ˈtʃɪkənd aʊt æt ðə læst ˈmoʊmənt
words.ex: He chickened out at the last moment and didn't jump into the water.
words.ex_cn: 他在最后一刻退缩了，没有跳进水里。
words.en: To lose courage and back out of a commitment or action at the last minute due to fear.

words.w: Don't take it out on me
words.tr: phrase. 别把气撒在我身上；别因某事对我发脾气
words.uk: dəʊnt teɪk ɪt aʊt ɒn miː
words.us: doʊnt teɪk ɪt aʊt ɑːn miː
words.ex: I didn't break the cup, so don't take it out on me.
words.ex_cn: 我不是打碎杯子的人，别冲我发脾气。
words.en: Do not vent your anger or frustration on me.

words.tr: phrase. 付清；偿还（欠款）；缴清（应付款项）
words.ex: He must pay up before he leaves.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前必须付钱。
words.en: To pay a debt or an amount owed in full.

words.tr: 你将会为此付出代价（常用于威胁或报复语境）
words.ex: If you break the rules, you'll pay for this.
words.ex_cn: 如果你违反规则，你会为此付出代价。
words.en: You will suffer the consequences of this action.

words.ex: You're out of your mind to jump into the cold water without a suit.
words.ex_cn: 你没穿泳衣就跳进冷水里，真是疯了。
words.en: To be behaving in a wildly irrational, reckless, or insane manner.

words.w: You shouldn't say things like that
words.uk: ju ʃʊdnt seɪ θɪŋz laɪk ðæt
words.us: ju ʃʊdnt seɪ θɪŋz laɪk ðæt
words.ex: You shouldn't say things like that to your friend.
words.ex_cn: 你不应该对朋友说那种话。
words.en: A polite or firm way to tell someone that their remark is inappropriate, offensive, or unwise.

words.ex: I won't let you play video games now, it's for your own good.
words.ex_cn: 我现在不让你打电子游戏，这是为了你好。
words.en: Done for someone's benefit, even if it is not immediately pleasant or appreciated.

words.w: Why are you picking on me
words.uk: waɪ ɑː ju ˈpɪkɪŋ ɒn miː
words.us: waɪ ɑːr ju ˈpɪkɪŋ ɑːn mi
words.ex: Why are you picking on me? I didn't do anything wrong.
words.ex_cn: 你为什么总挑我毛病？我什么都没做错。
words.en: To ask why someone is treating you unfairly, targeting you, or criticizing you persistently.

words.w: He always finds fault with my work
words.tr: 他总是挑我工作的毛病
words.uk: hi ˈɔːlweɪz faɪndz fɔːlt wɪð maɪ wɜːrk
words.us: hi ˈɔːlweɪz faɪndz fɔːlt wɪð maɪ wɜːrk
words.ex: He always finds fault with my work, even when I do it well.
words.ex_cn: 他总是挑我的工作毛病，即使我做得很好。
words.en: To consistently criticize or find minor imperfections in someone's work or efforts.

words.ex: Can you hold it for me?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我拿着它吗？
words.en: To stop or pause an activity, often used as an imperative command.

words.tr:
v. 等待；等候；
n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: to stay in one place or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives, etc.

words.tr: interj. 嗯嗯嗯（表示犹豫、否定或拖延）
words.ex: When asked if he wanted more cake, he said 'uh-uh-uh' and shook his head.
words.ex_cn: 当被问是否想再吃点蛋糕时，他摇头说‘唔唔唔’。
words.en: An interjection used to express disapproval, hesitation, or to stop someone from doing something.

words.ex: Don't do that, it's dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 别那样做，很危险。
words.en: A direct command or strong advice to cease a specific action immediately.

words.ex: Why are you doing that? It's not safe.
words.ex_cn: 你为什么要做那个？不安全。
words.en: To ask for the reason behind a specific action or behavior that seems unusual or concerning.

words.ex: Please line up for the school bus.
words.ex_cn: 请为校车排队。
words.en: Please form an orderly queue.

words.ex: Don't cut in line, please wait your turn.
words.ex_cn: 请不要插队，排队等候。
words.en: Do not interrupt the queue.

words.ex: I know you're excited, but don't push me now.
words.ex_cn: 我知道你很兴奋，但现在别逼我。
words.en: Do not shove or jostle.

words.tr: v. 不要叫我绰号；不要辱骂我
words.ex: Don't call me names, I didn't do anything wrong.
words.ex_cn: 别骂我，我什么都没做错。
words.en: Do not insult me verbally.

words.tr: v. 别当话匣子；别多嘴多舌
words.en: Do not be a gossip or reveal secrets.

words.tr: v. 把它藏起来，不让人看到
words.ex: He kept the keys out of sight so the child wouldn't find them.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏起来，以免孩子找到。
words.en: Keep it hidden from view.

words.tr: 短语：离我远点；别靠近我
words.ex: Stay away from me when you are sick.
words.ex_cn: 你生病时离我远点。
words.en: Keep your distance from me.

words.tr: adv. 别搞鬼；别耍花招；老实点
words.ex: We are working now, so no funny stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我们现在在工作，别搞怪。
words.en: No tricks or deceptive behavior.

words.tr: v. 别插手这件事；别卷入此事
words.ex: Stay out of this argument—it’s none of your business.
words.ex_cn: 别插手这个争论——这不关你的事。
words.en: Do not interfere in this matter.

words.ex: Don't ruin it by being late.
words.ex_cn: 别因为迟到把它搞砸了。
words.en: Do not spoil the situation.

words.tr: v. 停止打架；停止争斗
words.ex: Please stop fighting and talk nicely.
words.ex_cn: 请停止争吵，好好说话。
words.en: Cease physical conflict.

words.tr:
v. （使）结冰；（使）冻结；
n. 严寒期；冻结；
words.ex: The water will freeze in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 水在寒冷的天气里会结冰。
words.en: If a liquid or a substance containing a liquid freezes, or if something freezes it, it becomes solid because of low temperatures.

words.ex: The duck swims in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A duck is a bird that lives by water and has webbed feet, a short neck, and a large flat beak. As a verb, to duck means to lower the head or body quickly to avoid being hit or seen.

words.tr: 短语. 举起双手（通常表示投降或服从）
words.ex: The teacher said, 'Hands up if you know the answer.'
words.ex_cn: 老师说：‘知道答案的举手。’
words.en: Used to order someone to surrender or stop resisting by raising their hands.

words.ex: Don't move, the dog might bite.
words.ex_cn: 别动，狗可能会咬人。
words.en: A command telling someone not to change position.

words.ex: You listen to me when I speak.
words.ex_cn: 我讲话时你要听我说。
words.en: An imperative instruction demanding attention and obedience.

words.tr: phrase. 下来；吞下；弯下；写下
words.ex: He got down from the chair slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地从椅子上下来。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower position; to write something down; to cause someone to feel sad or depressed.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.ex: Stay where you are until I come back.
words.ex_cn: 原地待着，直到我回来。
words.en: A command instructing someone to remain in their current location.

words.tr: phrase. 继续前进；转变话题
words.ex: He decided to move on after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 分手后，他决定继续前行。
words.en: To continue with your life after you have dealt with a bad experience.

words.tr: adv. 跪着；匍匐在地；表示恳求或屈服
words.ex: He got on his knees to ask for forgiveness.
words.ex_cn: 他跪下来请求原谅。
words.en: An order to kneel on the ground, often in a submissive or vulnerable position.

words.ex: He shouted, 'Let go of me!' as the stranger held his arm.
words.ex_cn: 当陌生人抓住他的手臂时，他大喊：‘放开我！’
words.en: A request or command for someone to release their grip on the speaker.

words.tr: v. 赶快逃命；拼命逃跑
words.ex: The children screamed and ran for your lives when they saw the bear.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到熊时尖叫着拼命逃跑。
words.en: An urgent warning to flee immediately to avoid danger.

words.ex: I need to stop him from running into the street.
words.ex_cn: 我需要阻止他冲上马路。
words.en: A command to physically restrain or halt a person's movement.

words.ex: Can it be true?
words.ex_cn: 这可能是真的吗？
words.en: A colloquial, often rude, command to be quiet.

words.tr: phrase. 后退；站开（以便让出空间或避免危险）
words.ex: Please stand back and let the emergency personnel do their job.
words.ex_cn: 请靠后站，让急救人员做他们的工作。
words.en: To move or stay at a distance from something, especially in order to avoid being involved or to get a better view.

words.tr: phrase. 别闹了；住手；别再这样了（常用于要求某人停止某种令人不悦的行为）
words.ex: Cut it out! I'm trying to concentrate.
words.ex_cn: 别闹了！我正努力集中注意力。
words.en: An informal expression used to tell someone to stop doing something that is annoying or unwanted.

words.ex: The police said, 'You're under arrest' for stealing the car.
words.ex_cn: 警察说：‘你因偷车而被逮捕了。’
words.en: A formal declaration that someone is being taken into police custody.

words.ex: The police told the suspect to spread'em and check for weapons.
words.ex_cn: 警察命令嫌疑人张开双手，检查是否有武器。
words.en: A slang command, often used by law enforcement, instructing someone to spread their legs for a search.

words.ex: He gave me a heads up about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他提醒我关于会议的事情。
words.en: A warning or notification to alert someone about something.

words.ex: He told me to drop it and walk away.
words.ex_cn: 他让我放下它，然后走开。
words.en: To stop discussing or considering a topic; to cease an activity.

words.tr: v. 别碰；把手拿开（用于命令他人停止接触某物或某人）
words.ex: Get your hands off my bag!
words.ex_cn: 别碰我的包！
words.en: A command to stop touching or interfering with something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 走开，消失；迷路
words.ex: He told the noisy boy to get lost.
words.ex_cn: 他让那个吵闹的男孩走开。
words.en: If you tell someone to get lost, you are telling them in a rude way to go away.

words.tr: phrase. 离开这里；滚出去；别开玩笑了（表示难以置信或惊讶）
words.ex: Get out of here! I can't believe it!
words.ex_cn: 别逗了！我简直不敢相信！
words.en: Leave a place immediately, often used as an exclamation to tell someone to go away.

words.tr: phrase. v. 后退；退却；放弃；不再接近或攻击
words.ex: He told the dog to back off when it got too close.
words.ex_cn: 当狗靠得太近时，他让它后退。
words.en: To move backwards away from something or someone, especially in order to avoid a confrontation or to retreat from a previously stated position or commitment.

words.tr: phrase. 谢谢你；表示感谢的用语
words.ex: Thank you for helping me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢你帮我做作业。
words.en: A polite expression used to show gratitude or appreciation for something someone has done or given.

words.tr: int. 谢谢； n. 感谢；“thank”的复数；
words.ex: Thanks for helping me.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢你帮我。
words.en: an expression of gratitude

words.ex: Thank you very much for helping me.
words.ex_cn: 非常感谢你帮我。
words.en: Expressing gratitude in a very polite manner.

words.ex: Your help is much appreciated. Thank you.
words.ex_cn: 你的帮助非常感谢。谢谢。
words.en: Expressing gratitude for something received or done.

words.ex: Thanks for your kindness when I lost my wallet.
words.ex_cn: 当我丢掉钱包时，感谢你的好意。
words.en: Expressing thanks for someone's kind actions or nature.

words.ex: I appreciate your kindness when you helped me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 当我帮你做作业时，我感激你的善良。
words.en: Acknowledging and valuing someone's kind behavior.

words.tr: 我无法充分表达对你的感激之情
words.ex: I can't thank you enough for helping me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我无法充分表达对你的感激之情，谢谢你帮我做作业。
words.en: Expressing that someone's help is so great that simple thanks are insufficient.

words.w: I can hardly thank you enough for your kindness
words.tr: 我无法充分感谢你的仁慈
words.ex: I can hardly thank you enough for your kindness.
words.ex_cn: 我无法充分感谢你的仁慈。
words.en: Expressing that someone's help is so great that simple thanks are insufficient.

words.ex: You've been very helpful with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 你一直非常有帮助地帮我做作业。
words.en: Acknowledging that someone has provided useful assistance.

words.ex: Thank you for the help with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 感谢你帮我做作业。
words.en: Expressing gratitude for assistance received.

words.ex: Thanks for your time during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 感谢你在会议中花费的时间。
words.en: An expression of gratitude for someone's time or effort.

words.ex: Thanks for everything you did for me.
words.ex_cn: 感谢你为我做的一切。
words.en: An expression of gratitude for all things or efforts.

words.ex: I didn't win the game, but thank you anyway.
words.ex_cn: 我没有赢得比赛，但尽管如此，还是谢谢你。
words.en: Used to thank someone despite their help not being needed or successful.

words.tr: 感叹语. 多好啊；真不错
words.ex: How nice!
words.ex_cn: 真好！
words.en: Used to express pleasure or approval.

words.tr: 短语 我欠你一个人情；我改天一定还你
words.ex: Thanks for helping me move; I owe you one.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢你帮我搬家；我欠你一个人情。
words.en: An informal way to say you will repay someone for their help.

words.w: Thanks a lot for your present
words.uk: θæŋks ə lɒt fɔːr jɔː ˈprɛzənt
words.us: θæŋks ə lɑːt fɔːr jɔːr ˈprɛzənt
words.ex: Thanks a lot for your present.
words.ex_cn: 非常感谢你的礼物。
words.en: Expressing gratitude for a gift someone has given you.

words.ex: Thanks for saying so, I really appreciate it.
words.ex_cn: 感谢这么说，我真的很感激。
words.en: Thanking someone for giving a compliment or expressing a positive opinion.

words.ex: Thanks for telling me the news.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢告诉我这个消息。
words.en: Thanking someone for providing information.

words.ex: Thanks for waiting for me.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢等我。
words.en: Thanking someone for waiting for you to arrive or finish something.

words.ex: Thanks for asking me out to dinner.
words.ex_cn: 感谢邀请我出去吃饭。
words.en: Thanking someone for inviting you on a date or social outing.

words.ex: Thanks for cheering me up when I was sad.
words.ex_cn: 感谢你让我在伤心时振作起来。
words.en: Thanking someone for making you feel happier or more optimistic.

words.ex: You saved my life when I fell into the river.
words.ex_cn: 当我掉进河里时，你救了我的命。
words.en: An exaggerated way to thank someone for their extremely helpful action.

words.ex: Thanks for warning me about the rain.
words.ex_cn: 感谢你提醒我下雨的事。
words.en: An expression of gratitude for being alerted to a potential danger or problem.

words.w: Thanks for coming all the way over here
words.uk: θæŋks fɔː ˈkʌmɪŋ ɔːl ðə weɪ ˈəʊvə hɪə
words.us: θæŋks fɔr ˈkʌmɪŋ ɔl ðə weɪ ˈoʊvər hɪr
words.ex: Thanks for coming all the way over here to help me.
words.ex_cn: 感谢你特地过来这里帮我。
words.en: An expression of gratitude for someone making a long journey to visit.

words.w: Thank you for your letter. It was very kind of you
words.tr: 谢谢你给我的来信。你真是太好了。
words.uk: θæŋk juː fɔːr jɔː ˈlɛtə. ɪt wəz ˈvɛri kaɪnd əv juː
words.us: θæŋk juː fɔːr jɔːr ˈlɛtər. ɪt wəz ˈvɛri kaɪnd əv juː
words.ex: Thank you for your letter. It was very kind of you.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢你的来信，你真是太好了。
words.en: A polite acknowledgment of a received letter, expressing appreciation for the sender's kindness.

words.tr: phrase. 不客气；不用谢（用于回应别人的感谢）
words.ex: You're welcome.
words.ex_cn: 不客气。
words.en: A polite response used to acknowledge thanks or as a standalone greeting.

words.tr: phrase. 不客气；别提了（用于回应感谢）
words.ex: Thank you for your help. - Don't mention it.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢你的帮助。- 不用谢。
words.en: Used to indicate that thanks or an apology are not necessary.

words.ex: I'm glad I could help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 我很高兴能帮上你的功课。
words.en: A polite response indicating pleasure at having been able to assist someone.

words.ex: I'm sorry.
words.ex_cn: 我很抱歉。
words.en: An expression of regret or apology.

words.tr: int. <口>哎哟（犯明显错误时的道歉） n. 呐喊; 大叫( whoop的名词复数 ); 喘息声
words.ex: Whoops! I dropped my pencil.
words.ex_cn: 哎呀！我把铅笔掉地上了。
words.en: used to express surprise or apology

words.tr: phrase. 对不起；麻烦你；打扰一下
words.ex: Excuse me, I didn't mean to bump into you.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我不是故意撞到你的。
words.en: used as a polite way to get someone's attention, to interrupt someone, or to ask someone to move so that you can pass

words.tr: phrase. 对不起；麻烦你；打扰一下
words.ex: Excuse me, I didn't mean to bump into you.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我不是故意撞到你的。
words.en: used as a polite way to get someone's attention, to interrupt someone, or to ask someone to move so that you can pass

words.ex: I'm awfully sorry for being late.
words.ex_cn: 我非常抱歉迟到了。
words.en: A strong expression of apology for causing trouble or inconvenience.

words.ex: I'm sorry about that I broke your cup.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我打碎了你的杯子。
words.en: A standard apology for a specific error or unfortunate situation.

words.ex: It's my fault that the glass broke.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃打碎了，这是我的错。
words.en: An admission that one is responsible for a mistake or problem.

words.tr: 感叹语；我的错（表示歉意或承认失误）
words.ex: Oops. My mistake—I forgot to bring the book.
words.ex_cn: 哎呀，我的错——我忘了带书。
words.en: A casual apology for a minor error or oversight.

words.ex: I feel bad about it when I hurt your feelings.
words.ex_cn: 当我伤害了你的感受时，我对此感到抱歉。
words.en: An expression of regret or remorse for a specific action or situation.

words.ex: I'm sorry I couldn't come to your party.
words.ex_cn: 抱歉我没能来参加你的派对。
words.en: An expression of regret for being unable to attend or participate.

words.w: I'm sorry about the other day
words.uk: aɪm ˈsɒrɪ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈʌðə deɪ
words.us: aɪm ˈsɔːri əˈbaʊt ðə ˈʌðər deɪ
words.ex: I'm sorry about the other day when I was late.
words.ex_cn: 对不起那天我迟到了。
words.en: An apology for a specific past incident or behavior.

words.ex: Please forgive my rudeness, I didn't mean to interrupt.
words.ex_cn: 请原谅我的无礼，我不是故意打断的。
words.en: A request for forgiveness after behaving impolitely.

words.w: I don't know how to apologize to you
words.tr: 我不知该如何向你道歉
words.uk: aɪ dəʊnˈt nəʊ haʊ tə əˈpɒlədʒaɪ tuː juː
words.us: aɪ doʊnt noʊ haʊ tə əˈpɑːlədʒaɪ tuː juː
words.ex: I don't know how to apologize to you.
words.ex_cn: 我不知该如何向你道歉。
words.en: A statement expressing difficulty in finding the right words to apologize.

words.tr: phrase. 我不是那个意思；我并非有意那样说
words.ex: I didn't mean that.
words.ex_cn: 我不是那个意思。
words.en: That was not my intended meaning or implication.

words.ex: I'm sorry to trouble you, but can you help me?
words.ex_cn: 抱歉打扰你，你能帮我一下吗？
words.en: An apology for causing inconvenience or bother to someone.

words.w: I'm really sorry for troubling you
words.uk: aɪm ˈrɪəli ˈsɒri fɔː ˈtrʌblɪŋ ju
words.us: aɪm ˈrɪli ˈsɔri fɔr ˈtrʌblɪŋ ju
words.ex: I'm really sorry for troubling you.
words.ex_cn: 我真的很抱歉打扰你。
words.en: A sincere apology for causing someone trouble or difficulty.

words.w: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting
words.uk: aɪm ˈsɒrɪ tə hæv kɛpt ju ˈwɔɪtɪŋ
words.us: aɪm ˈsɔːri tə hæv kɛpt ju ˈweɪtɪŋ
words.ex: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 对不起让你久等公交车了。
words.en: An apology for making someone wait for a period of time.

words.tr: 我希望我能（表达一种遗憾或无法实现的愿望）
words.ex: I wish I could go to the park today.
words.ex_cn: 我真希望今天能去公园。
words.en: A polite expression of regret or desire for something that is currently impossible or unlikely to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 没关系；不要紧；没事（用于回应道歉或感谢）
words.ex: That's all right, I can help you.
words.ex_cn: 没关系，我可以帮你。
words.en: used to tell someone that you are not upset or angry about something, especially something they have done

words.w: Please be more careful next time
words.uk: pliːz biː mɔː ˈkeəfəl nɛkst taɪm
words.us: pliːz biː mɔːr ˈkerfəl nɛkst taɪm
words.en: A polite request for someone to exercise greater caution in the future.

words.w: Let me get your coat for you
words.uk: lɛt miː ɡɛt jɔː kəʊt fɔː juː
words.us: lɛt mi ɡɛt jɔr koʊt fɔr ju
words.ex: Let me get your coat for you before we leave.
words.ex_cn: 我们在离开前让我帮你拿外套。
words.en: An offer to assist by taking someone's coat.

words.tr: phrase. 请随意；别拘束；像在自己家一样
words.ex: Please make yourself at home; help yourself to anything you'd like.
words.ex_cn: 请自便；随意取用任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: To behave as if you are in your own home, to feel comfortable and relaxed in someone else's home.

words.tr: 短语. 你有空吗？你有一分钟时间吗？
words.ex: Do you have a minute to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你有空帮我一下吗？
words.en: A polite inquiry to check if someone is available for a brief conversation.

words.w: Can I talk to you for a minute
words.tr: 我可以跟你聊一分钟吗？
words.uk: kæn aɪ tɔːk tu ju fər ə ˈmɪnɪt
words.us: kæn aɪ tɑːk tu ju fər ə ˈmɪnɪt
words.ex: Can I talk to you for a minute? I need help with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我可以跟你聊一分钟吗？我需要帮忙做作业。
words.en: A polite request for a brief conversation.

words.tr: 短语. 您先请；您先走
words.ex: After you, sir.
words.ex_cn: 先生，您先请。
words.en: A polite expression used to suggest that someone else should go first or take their turn before you.

words.w: Can I give you a hand
words.tr: 短语 我能帮你吗？；提供帮助
words.uk: kæn aɪ ɡɪv juː ə hænd
words.us: kæn aɪ ɡɪv ju ə hænd
words.ex: Can I give you a hand with your bags?
words.ex_cn: 我能帮你拿包吗？
words.en: An offer to help someone with a task.

words.tr: phrase. 对不起；麻烦你；打扰一下
words.ex: Excuse me, I didn't mean to bump into you.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我不是故意撞到你的。
words.en: used as a polite way to get someone's attention, to interrupt someone, or to ask someone to move so that you can pass

words.ex: I'll accept your offer if the price is lower.
words.ex_cn: 如果价格更低，我会接受你的提议。
words.en: An expression used to agree to a proposal or suggestion.

words.tr: phrase. 对突然的通知感到抱歉
words.ex: I'm sorry for the short notice, but the meeting has been moved to tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我很抱歉通知得这么突然，但会议已经改到明天了。
words.en: An apology for informing someone of something at the last minute.

words.ex: John is incredible.
words.ex_cn: 约翰是不可思议的。
words.en: A statement expressing admiration for someone's exceptional ability or character.

words.tr: phrase. 干得好；做得好（用于表扬他人）
words.ex: He did a good job on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中表现得很好。
words.en: An expression used to praise someone for their work or achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 干得好！（用于称赞或鼓励某人）
words.ex: You did it! Way to go!
words.ex_cn: 你做到了！太棒了！
words.en: Used to express approval or encouragement for someone's achievement or effort.

words.ex: Well done! You solved the problem correctly.
words.ex_cn: 做得好！你正确地解决了这个问题。
words.en: Used to express approval or praise for someone who has done something successfully or achieved something.

words.ex: He is a good son to his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他是父母的好儿子。
words.en: A son is a male child in relation to his parents.

words.ex: Congratulations on your graduation!
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你毕业！
words.en: An expression of pleasure or joy in the success or good fortune of another.

words.ex: You were great in the play last night.
words.ex_cn: 你昨晚在戏剧中很棒。
words.en: An expression of approval or admiration for someone's performance or behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 祝贺你；对你有好处；干得好（用于表达对他人好事的赞赏或讽刺）
words.ex: Good for you for finishing the race!
words.ex_cn: 你完成了比赛，真棒！
words.en: Used to express approval or congratulations to someone for something they have done.

words.ex: The teacher praised the good boy for helping his classmate.
words.ex_cn: 老师表扬了这个好孩子，因为他帮助了同学。
words.en: Praise given to a boy or man for good behavior or achievement.

words.tr: 感叹句：多漂亮的裙子啊
words.ex: What a nice dress!
words.ex_cn: 多漂亮的裙子啊！
words.en: A compliment expressing admiration for a dress.

words.ex: I like your shirt.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢你的衬衫。
words.en: A statement expressing approval or liking for a shirt.

words.ex: That's a great tie you are wearing.
words.ex_cn: 那是一条你戴着的很棒的领带。
words.en: A compliment expressing admiration for a tie.

words.ex: You have a nice car.
words.ex_cn: 你有一辆不错的车。
words.en: You possess an attractive automobile.

words.ex: Where did you buy it?
words.ex_cn: 你在哪里买的？
words.en: Inquire about the purchase location of an item.

words.w: I bought it at the K store
words.uk: aɪ bɔːt ɪt æt ðə keɪ stɔː
words.us: aɪ bɔːt ɪt æt ðə keɪ stɔːr
words.ex: I bought it at the K store.
words.ex_cn: 我是在K商店买的它。
words.en: I acquired it at the K store.

words.ex: The shirt was on sale last week.
words.ex_cn: 那件衬衫上周正在打折。
words.en: It was offered at a reduced price.

words.ex: You look nice in that dress.
words.ex_cn: 你穿那条裙子很好看。
words.en: Your appearance is pleasant.

words.tr: 看起来你穿/戴得很漂亮
words.ex: That dress looks nice on you.
words.ex_cn: 那条裙子看起来你穿得很漂亮。
words.en: It suits you well.

words.w: All the credit goes to you
words.uk: ɔːl ðə ˈkrɛdɪt ɡəʊz tu ju
words.us: ɔːl ðə ˈkrɛdɪt goʊz tu ju
words.ex: You fixed the computer, so all the credit goes to you.
words.ex_cn: 你修好了电脑，所以所有的功劳都归于你。
words.en: You deserve all the praise for this achievement.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；极好的；明亮的；灿烂的；
words.ex: He gave a brilliant answer to the math question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这道数学题给出了卓越的回答。
words.en: A brilliant person, idea, or performance is extremely clever or skilful.

words.tr: 感叹语，用于表达对某人的赞叹或惊讶，意为‘真是个男子汉’或‘了不起的人’
words.ex: What a man! He saved the child from the fire all by himself.
words.ex_cn: 真是个男子汉！他一个人从火里救出了孩子。
words.en: An exclamation expressing admiration for a man's actions or character.

words.ex: Wow, that cake looks delicious!
words.ex_cn: 哇，那个蛋糕看起来真美味！
words.en: You say 'wow' when you are very impressed, surprised, or pleased by something.

words.tr: 你正处于连胜状态；连续获胜
words.ex: You're on a winning streak after winning three games in a row.
words.ex_cn: 你连续赢了三场比赛，正处于连胜状态。

words.ex: You have a cute son.
words.ex_cn: 你有一个可爱的儿子。
words.en: Your son is charming and endearing.

words.w: You look young for your age
words.tr: 你看起来比实际年龄年轻
words.uk: juː lʊk jʌŋ fɔːr jɔːr eɪdʒ
words.us: juː lʊk jʌŋ fɔːr jɔːr edʒ
words.ex: You look young for your age, even though you are 60.
words.ex_cn: 你虽然60岁了，但看起来比实际年龄年轻。
words.en: Appearing younger than one's actual age.

words.w: I appreciate your effort very much
words.ex: I appreciate your effort very much.
words.ex_cn: 我非常感激你的努力。
words.en: I am very grateful for the work you have done.

words.ex: I envy you because you can travel so much.
words.ex_cn: 我羡慕你，因为你可以经常旅行。
words.en: I feel a desire to have what you possess.

words.tr: 他非常看重你；他对你评价很高
words.ex: He thinks highly of you because you always help others.
words.ex_cn: 他非常看重你，因为你总是帮助别人。
words.en: He holds you in high regard or esteem.

words.w: I need a boss I can look up to
words.tr: 我需要一个值得敬仰的上司
words.uk: aɪ niːd ə bɒs aɪ kæn lʊk ʌp tuː
words.us: aɪ nid ə bɑs aɪ kæn lʊk ʌp tu
words.ex: I need a boss who leads with honesty and kindness.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一个值得敬仰的上司。
words.en: I require a supervisor I can respect and admire.

words.ex: He's got guts to speak up against the boss.
words.ex_cn: 他有胆量敢对老板说出意见。
words.en: He is very brave or courageous.

words.ex: I agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的观点。
words.en: Used to express agreement with a statement or opinion.

words.tr: phrase. 我认为如此；我想是这样
words.ex: I think so.
words.ex_cn: 我认为是这样。
words.en: An expression of tentative agreement or belief.

words.ex: The coffee is too hot to drink.
words.ex_cn: 这咖啡太热了，没法喝。
words.en: In addition; also; more than is desirable, permissible, or possible; excessively or extremely.

words.tr: 短语 你说什么都行；随便你；我听你的
words.ex: I don't mind where we eat—anything you say.
words.ex_cn: 我不在乎我们去哪儿吃——你说什么都行。
words.en: I agree completely; I will do as you suggest.

words.ex: There was no objection to the new plan.
words.ex_cn: 对这个新计划没有人提出异议。
words.en: I do not oppose this; I accept it.

words.w: I don't have any objection to it
words.uk: aɪ dəʊnt hæv ˈeni əbˈdʒekʃn tu ɪt
words.us: aɪ doʊnt hæv ˈeni əbˈdʒekʃn tu ɪt
words.ex: I don't have any objection to it.
words.ex_cn: 我不反对它。
words.en: I have no objection to this matter.

words.ex: We can meet at 5 p.m. That's fine with me.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以在下午五点见面，那对我来说没问题。
words.en: That is acceptable or satisfactory to me.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 那是公平的；那很合理
words.ex: You got half the cookies, that's fair.
words.ex_cn: 你得到了一半的饼干，那是公平的。
words.en: A reasonable or just response or decision.

words.tr: phrase. 你说得太对了；我完全同意（用于强烈赞同别人说的话）
words.ex: You can say that again.
words.ex_cn: 你再说一遍吧。
words.en: Used to express strong agreement with what someone has said.

words.ex: Playing video games sounds like fun.
words.ex_cn: 玩电子游戏听起来很有趣。
words.en: Appears to be enjoyable or entertaining.

words.tr: phrase. 当然；毫无疑问（表示强烈同意或肯定）
words.ex: You bet I will help you.
words.ex_cn: 当然了，我会帮你。
words.en: Used to express that something is certain or that someone is very willing to do something.

words.w: Are you for or against his idea
words.tr: 你支持还是反对他的想法
words.ex: Are you for or against his idea to raise taxes?
words.ex_cn: 你支持还是反对他提高税收的想法？
words.en: A question asking whether you support or oppose his suggestion.

words.ex: She is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个好学生。
words.en: Something that is good is of a high quality, standard, or level.

words.ex: That's a good idea for our project.
words.ex_cn: 那对我们项目来说是个好主意。
words.en: An idea that is considered beneficial or advantageous.

words.w: What you say is partly right
words.uk: wɒt juː seɪ ɪz ˈpɑːtli raɪt
words.us: wʌt juː seɪ ɪz ˈpɑːrtli raɪt
words.ex: What you say is partly right, but we need more data.
words.ex_cn: 你说的有部分是对的，但我们还需要更多数据。
words.en: Your statement is partially correct.

words.ex: I don't agree with your idea.
words.ex_cn: 我不同意你的想法。
words.en: I have a different opinion.

words.ex: I can't agree with your idea.
words.ex_cn: 我不同意你的想法。
words.en: I am unable to concur with that.

words.tr: phrase. 我对此表示怀疑；我不太相信
words.ex: I doubt it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我怀疑明天会下雨。
words.en: An expression of skepticism or disbelief about a statement or situation.

words.ex: You said it was free, but that's not what you said last week.
words.ex_cn: 你说过它是免费的，但那不是你上周说的。
words.en: That contradicts your previous statement.

words.tr: 我无法接受那个；我不相信那个；我不认同那个（常用于表达对某事的怀疑或拒绝接受）
words.ex: I can't buy that excuse.
words.ex_cn: 我无法接受那个借口。
words.en: I cannot accept that explanation or claim.

words.tr: phrase. 糟糕的主意；不明智的想法
words.ex: Skipping breakfast is a bad idea.
words.ex_cn: n. 不吃早餐是个坏主意。
words.en: A bad idea is a thought or plan that is not wise or likely to lead to a good outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 无用的；不好的；无价值的；糟糕的
words.ex: This plan is no good.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划不行。
words.en: If you say that something is no good or is not any good, you mean that it is of no use or value for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He said he could finish the project in one day, but that's impossible.
words.ex_cn: 他说他可以在一天内完成这个项目，但那是不可能的。
words.en: That's impossible means that something cannot be done or achieved.

words.ex: That's absolute nonsense to say the earth is flat.
words.ex_cn: 说地球是平的那简直是胡说八道。
words.en: That is completely ridiculous or false.

words.tr: phrase. 行不通；不起作用；无法运作
words.ex: It won't work if you don't follow the steps.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不按步骤来，它就不会有效。
words.en: used to say that something is not functioning or will not be successful

words.tr: phrase. 并不总是；未必总是；不总是
words.ex: He is not always late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他并不总是上课迟到。
words.en: Not always means that something does not happen all the time or is not true in every case.

words.tr: phrase. 并不完全是；算不上；不完全是；其实不是
words.ex: Do you like the movie? Not really.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 你喜欢这部电影吗？并不真的。
words.en: used to say that something is not completely true or not exactly what you want

words.ex: He asked if I wanted coffee, and I said yes.
words.ex_cn: 他问我是否想要咖啡，我说是。
words.en: Used to give an affirmative response or to agree with a positive statement.

words.ex: I am a student.
words.ex_cn: 我是一名学生。
words.en: The first-person singular present of the verb 'be', used to state one's own existence or identity.

words.ex: Do you like pizza? Yeah.
words.ex_cn: 你喜欢披萨吗？是。
words.en: used to give an affirmative response

words.tr: phrase. 我认为如此；我想是这样
words.ex: I think so.
words.ex_cn: 我认为是这样。
words.en: An expression of tentative agreement or belief.

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.ex: He is absolutely sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对确定这个答案。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.ex: He is lazy, in a word.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他很懒。
words.en: used to give a summary or to introduce a conclusion

words.ex: He asked if I wanted coffee, and I said yes.
words.ex_cn: 他问我是否想要咖啡，我说是。
words.en: Used to give an affirmative response or to agree with a positive statement.

words.ex: You're perfectly correct about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 你对这个答案完全正确。
words.en: You are absolutely right.

words.tr: 从某种意义上说，他是对的
words.ex: In a sense he's right, but we still need more data.
words.ex_cn: 从某种意义上说，他是对的，但我们仍需要更多数据。
words.en: In some ways, he is correct.

words.tr: 短语。就是这个；就这样；完了；对了（表示确认、结束或强调）
words.ex: I found the key! That's it!
words.ex_cn: 我找到钥匙了！就是这个！
words.en: used to say that something is finished or that something is all that there is

words.tr: 短语. 你明白了；没问题；包在我身上（表示理解或答应请求）
words.ex: A: Can you handle this project? B: You got it!
words.ex_cn: A: 你能处理这个项目吗？ B: 你明白了！
words.en: An expression used to confirm that you will do something or that you agree with a request or suggestion.

words.w: Your answer is to the point
words.tr: 你的回答切中要点；简洁明了，直击要害
words.uk: jɔː ˈɑːn.sər ɪz tu ðə ˈpɔɪnt
words.us: jʊr ˈæn.sər ɪz tu ðə ˈpɔɪnt
words.ex: Your answer is to the point.
words.ex_cn: 你的回答切中要点。

words.ex: I bet it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我敢打赌明天会下雨。
words.en: used to say that you are fairly sure that something is true or will happen, although you cannot prove this.

words.tr: phrase. 为什么不（用于提出建议或表示同意）
words.ex: Why not go for a walk?
words.ex_cn: 为什么不去散个步呢？
words.en: used to make a suggestion or to agree with a suggestion

words.tr:
n. 宾果游戏
int. 太好了！
words.ex: He shouted bingo when he got five in a row.
words.ex_cn: 当他连成五子时，他大喊‘宾果’。
words.en: Bingo is a game in which each player has a card with numbers on it. The caller calls out numbers and if a player has that number on their card they mark it off. The first player to mark off all their numbers calls out 'Bingo!' and wins the game.

words.ex: I hear birds singing in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我听到早晨鸟儿在唱歌。
words.en: To perceive or become aware of (sound) through the ear.

words.ex: I hear birds singing in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我听到早晨鸟儿在唱歌。
words.en: To perceive or become aware of (sound) through the ear.

words.ex: Thank you, sir.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢，先生。
words.en: A polite or formal way of addressing a man, especially one whose name you do not know or a man of higher rank or status.

words.ex: He will pass the test, no doubt.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会通过考试。
words.en: You use no doubt to indicate that you are making a judgment or statement that you think is probably true, although you are not certain.

words.tr: 短语. 公平合理；说得有理；好吧，可以接受
words.ex: You didn't finish your homework, but fair enough, you were sick.
words.ex_cn: 你没完成作业，但可以理解，你生病了。
words.en: Used to admit that something is reasonable or acceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 恐怕是这样；我想是的（用于委婉地给出肯定答复，常带遗憾或无奈）
words.ex: I'm afraid so, the meeting is canceled.
words.ex_cn: 恐怕是的，会议取消了。
words.en: used to politely tell someone something that may annoy, upset, or disappoint them

words.ex: Your opinion is reasonable because it considers all the facts.
words.ex_cn: 你的观点是合理的，因为它考虑了所有事实。
words.en: Your viewpoint is logical and makes sense.

words.tr: phrase. 如果你这么说（表示勉强同意或略带怀疑的回应）
words.ex: If you say so, I will believe you.
words.ex_cn: 如果你这么说，我就相信你。
words.en: used to indicate reluctant acceptance or agreement with something someone has said

words.ex: Do you like pizza? Yeah.
words.ex_cn: 你喜欢披萨吗？是。
words.en: used to give an affirmative response

words.ex: As far as I know, he lives in New York.
words.ex_cn: 据我所知，他住在纽约。
words.en: According to the information that I have.

words.ex: I'm going to call you later.
words.ex_cn: 我稍后会给你打电话。
words.en: Used to express a future intention or action.

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.ex: I'm not tired.
words.ex_cn: 我不是累。
words.en: A phrase used to express disagreement, denial, or refusal.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: That's not right.
words.ex_cn: 那不对。
words.en: Used to state that a statement or idea is wrong or false.

words.tr: 你的想法从根本上说是错误的
words.ex: Your idea is fundamentally wrong because it ignores basic facts.
words.ex_cn: 你的想法从根本上说是错误的，因为它忽视了基本事实。
words.en: Your idea is completely incorrect at its core.

words.ex: I said I like apples, but that's not what I mean.
words.ex_cn: 我说我喜欢苹果，但那不是我的意思。
words.en: That is not what I intended to say or convey.

words.ex: Are you coming to the party tonight? Certainly not, I have to work.
words.ex_cn: adv. 你今晚来参加派对吗？肯定不来，我得工作。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is definitely not the case or will not happen.

words.ex: He has never been to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他从未去过日本。
words.en: At no time in the past or future; on no occasion; not ever.

words.ex: She was not a bit tired after the long journey.
words.ex_cn: 长途旅行后她一点也不累。
words.en: Not at all; not in the slightest.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；没门；不可能；表示强烈否定或惊讶
words.ex: No way will I eat that food.
words.ex_cn: 我绝不会吃那种食物。
words.en: used to say that there is no possibility that you will do something or that something will happen

words.tr: 短语. 那怎么可能；这怎么可能
words.ex: How can that be true?
words.ex_cn: 那怎么可能是真的？
words.en: An expression used to express disbelief or surprise about a situation or statement.

words.w: We don't agree on this point
words.tr: 我们在这个问题上意见不一致
words.uk: wi dəʊnt əˈɡriː ɒn ðɪs pɔɪnt
words.us: wi doʊnt əˈɡriː ɑːn ðɪs pɔɪnt
words.ex: We don't agree on this point.
words.ex_cn: 我们在这个问题上意见不一致。

words.ex: I'm not talking about that, let's focus on the homework.
words.ex_cn: 我可不是在说那个，我们还是专注作业吧。
words.en: I am not discussing that particular topic.

words.tr: interj. 表示否定或不赞同的声音
words.ex: She said uh-uh when asked if she wanted cake.
words.ex_cn: 当被问到是否想吃蛋糕时，她说‘不’。
words.en: used to express negation or disagreement

words.tr: phrase. 那不行；那不够好；那不可接受
words.ex: You can't be late again—that won't do.
words.ex_cn: 你不能再迟到了——那样不行。
words.en: That is not acceptable or sufficient.

words.tr: 他不会做；他不行（指某人不适合做某事）
words.ex: He won't do his homework because he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意做作业，因为他累了。
words.en: He will not act in that way.

words.ex: He said he saw a flying elephant, but that makes no sense.
words.ex_cn: 他说他看见了一只会飞的大象，但那没有意义。
words.en: phrase. That is illogical or unreasonable.

words.ex: He broke the glass, but it was not me.
words.ex_cn: 他打碎了玻璃，但不是我。
words.en: Used to indicate that the speaker is not the person being referred to.

words.ex: I deny that he stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 我否认他偷了钱。
words.en: I refuse to accept that statement as true.

words.ex: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 也许明天会下雨。
words.en: used to show that something is possible or that something might be true

words.tr: phrase. 不完全如此；并不确切；并非真的
words.ex: It is not exactly what I wanted.
words.ex_cn: 这并不完全是我想要的。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is not completely true or accurate.

words.tr: 短语. 我猜是这样；我想是吧
words.ex: I guess so, the weather is nice today.
words.ex_cn: 我想是吧，今天天气不错。
words.en: A phrase used to express reluctant or uncertain agreement.
It is possibly true, but not certain.

words.tr: phrase. 可能是；也许是；或许是
words.ex: It could be a simple mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这可能是个简单的错误。
words.en: It is possible that something is the case.

words.ex: I hope you're right about the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我希望你对明天的天气判断是对的。
words.en: I wish that what you say is correct.

words.ex: He is sort of tired after the long walk.
words.ex_cn: 他走了很长的路，有几分累了。
words.en: to some extent; rather

words.tr: 这有点像那样；差不多就是那样的意思
words.ex: I want a red shirt, it's something like that.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一件红衬衫，差不多就是那样的。
words.en: It is approximately or similar to that.

words.tr: phrase. 视情况而定；这要看情况
words.ex: Can we go to the park? It depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们能去公园吗？这要看天气情况。
words.en: used to say that you are not certain about something because you do not know what will happen or what the situation will be

words.ex: Hopefully, it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 但愿明天会下雨。
words.en: If you say that something will happen hopefully, you mean that you wish it to happen or you think it is likely to happen.

words.ex: There's no guarantee that you will pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 你是否能通过考试是没有保证的。
words.en: There is no certainty that it will happen.

words.ex: I can't say when he will come back.
words.ex_cn: 我说不出他什么时候回来。
words.en: A phrase used to express uncertainty or reluctance to give a definite opinion or answer.

words.tr: 短语. 表示模棱两可的回答；既是也不是
words.ex: Is it easy to learn a new language? Well, yes and no.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言容易吗？嗯，既是又不是。
words.en: Used to express that something is partly true and partly not true.

words.tr: phrase. 一半一半的；半乳脂半奶油的（常用于咖啡或饮品）
words.ex: I drink coffee with half and half instead of cream.
words.ex_cn: 我喝咖啡时加一半奶一半水，而不是加奶油。
words.en: A mixture of two equal parts; used to describe something that is equally one thing and another.

words.tr: phrase. 我会试试；我来尝试一下
words.ex: I'll try to finish the report by tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我会尽量在明天之前完成报告。
words.en: An expression indicating a willingness to attempt something.

words.ex: It's difficult to say if he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 很难说他明天是否会来。
words.en: An expression indicating that a situation or outcome is hard to judge or predict with certainty.

words.tr: phrase. 可以更好；还有提升空间
words.en: A polite way to say that something is not as good as it could be, often implying mild disappointment.

words.w: He gave me an ambiguous answer
words.tr: phrase. 模棱两可的；含糊不清的
words.ex: He gave me an ambiguous answer when I asked about the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 当我问起截止日期时，他给了我一个模棱两可的答案。
words.en: He provided an answer that was unclear or open to more than one interpretation.

words.w: I need some time to think it over
words.tr: 我需要一些时间仔细考虑一下
words.uk: aɪ niːd sʌm taɪm tu θɪŋk ɪt ˈəʊvə
words.us: aɪ nid sʌm taɪm tu θɪŋk ɪt ˈoʊvər
words.ex: I need some time to think it over before I say yes.
words.ex_cn: 在答应之前，我需要一些时间好好想想。
words.en: I require a period of time to carefully think about a matter before making a decision.

words.ex: I'll consider it when I finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我做完作业后会考虑这件事。
words.en: I will give something serious thought before deciding whether to accept or agree to it.

words.tr: phrase. 我会考虑一下；我会再想想
words.ex: I'll think about it.
words.ex_cn: 我会考虑一下的。
words.en: I will consider it; I will give it some thought.

words.ex: I'll think it over before I say yes.
words.ex_cn: 在答应之前，我会好好考虑一下。
words.en: I will take time to think carefully about a matter before making a decision.

words.tr: phrase. 让我先考虑一下；让我睡一觉再决定
words.ex: I will let me sleep on it before I decide.
words.ex_cn: 在我做决定之前，我会好好想想。
words.en: To delay making a decision until one has had time to think it over.

words.w: I'll see what I can do
words.uk: aɪl siː wɒt aɪ kæn duː
words.us: aɪl siː wʌt aɪ kæn du
words.ex: I'll see what I can do to help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 我会看看我能为你做些什么来帮你完成作业。
words.en: I will try to help or find a solution, but I cannot make a firm promise.

words.tr: phrase. 你呢？（用于询问对方的情况或意见）
words.ex: How about you?
words.ex_cn: 你呢？
words.en: A polite inquiry asking for another person's opinion or preference.

words.tr: 短语. 你怎么想？；你认为如何？
words.ex: I think algebra is hard.
words.ex_cn: 我觉得代数很难。
words.en: A polite inquiry asking for someone's opinion or judgment on a matter.

words.tr: 短语 你有什么看法？
words.ex: What's your opinion about the new school rule?
words.ex_cn: 你对新校规有什么看法？
words.en: A request for someone's personal view or judgment on a matter.

words.tr: 短语 你有什么建议？
words.ex: What's your suggestion for solving this problem?
words.ex_cn: 你有什么建议来解决这个问题？
words.en: A request for advice or a proposed course of action from someone.

words.ex: You bought apples. What else?
words.ex_cn: 你买了苹果。还有什么？
words.en: An expression used to ask for additional information or to continue a topic.

words.tr: 任何问题都可以（指对问题没有特别要求，随便哪个都行）
words.ex: You can ask any question will do about the homework.
words.ex_cn: 你可以问任何关于作业的问题。
words.en: Any inquiry is acceptable; no specific question is required.

words.tr: 你推荐什么？（用于询问对方的建议或推荐）
words.ex: What do you recommend?
words.ex_cn: 你推荐什么？
words.en: A polite inquiry asking for someone's suggestion or advice about something.

words.ex: It's raining hard, don't you think so?
words.ex_cn: 雨下得很大，你不这么认为吗？
words.en: Used to seek confirmation or agreement from the listener.

words.ex: Do you agree that homework is important?
words.ex_cn: 你同意作业很重要吗？
words.en: A direct request for someone to confirm or share their agreement.

words.tr: phrase. 给我一个明确的答案
words.ex: Can you give me a definite answer about the meeting time?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我一个关于会议时间的明确答复吗？
words.en: Ask for a clear, unambiguous response without hesitation.

words.tr: 是或否吗？（用于询问肯定或否定的回答）
words.ex: Is it yes or no?
words.ex_cn: 是还是不是？
words.en: A request for a simple choice between two options.

words.ex: It doesn't answer my question about the homework.
words.ex_cn: 它没有回答我关于作业的问题。
words.en: The response provided does not address or resolve the issue raised.

words.tr: 你毫无机会；你不可能成功
words.ex: You don't stand a chance against the champion.
words.ex_cn: 你赢不了冠军。
words.en: You have no possibility of success or victory in a given situation.

words.tr: phrase. 忍无可忍的最后一击；压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草
words.ex: It's the last straw when he forgot our anniversary again.
words.ex_cn: 当他再次忘记我们的纪念日时，这成了压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。
words.en: It is the final, intolerable incident that causes a decision or action.

words.w: Let me hear your candid opinion
words.tr: 让我听听你坦率的意见
words.uk: lɛt mi hɪə jɔː ˈkændɪd əˈpɪnjən
words.us: lɛt mi hɪr jʊr ˈkændɪd əˈpɪnjən
words.ex: Let me hear your candid opinion about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 让我听听你对新政策的坦率意见。
words.en: Ask for an honest, straightforward opinion without reservation.

words.w: Can you think of anything better
words.uk: kæn ju θɪŋk əv ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ˈbɛtə
words.us: kæn ju θɪŋk əv ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ˈbɛtər
words.ex: Can you think of anything better than a good book on a rainy day?
words.ex_cn: 你能想到比雨天读一本好书更好的事吗？
words.en: A request for alternative suggestions or improvements.

words.ex: Do you have any complaints about the service?
words.ex_cn: 你对这项服务有任何不满吗？
words.en: Any expression of dissatisfaction, whether written or spoken, about a product or service.

words.ex: What is your complaint about the service?
words.ex_cn: 你对这项服务有什么不满？
words.en: A question asking for the reason behind someone's dissatisfaction or grievance.

words.tr: phrase. 相当开明的；相当宽容的
words.ex: I'm fairly broad-minded, so I accept different opinions.
words.ex_cn: 我相当开明，因此能接受不同的观点。
words.en: I am quite open to different ideas or lifestyles.

words.w: That kind of chance comes once in a blue moon
words.tr: 这种机会千载难逢；极其罕见
words.uk: ðæt kaɪnd əv tʃɑːns kʌmz wʌns ɪn ə bluː muːn
words.us: ðæt kaɪnd əv tʃæns kʌmz wʌns ɪn ə bluː muːn
words.ex: Winning the lottery is that kind of chance comes once in a blue moon.
words.ex_cn: 中彩票就是那种几乎不可能发生的事。
words.en: That type of opportunity is extremely rare.

words.tr: phrase. 在我看来；依我之见；我认为
words.ex: In my opinion, this book is very good.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这本书非常好。
words.en: Used to introduce a personal viewpoint or belief.

words.tr: 短语. 我不这么认为
words.ex: A: Do you think it will rain tomorrow? B: I don't think so.
words.ex_cn: A: 你觉得明天会下雨吗？ B: 我不这么认为。
words.en: used to express disagreement or doubt about something

words.w: I think it is a matter of opinion
words.tr: 我认为这是个观点问题
words.uk: aɪ θɪŋk ɪt ɪz ə ˈmætər əv əˈpɪnjən
words.us: aɪ θɪŋk ɪt ɪz ə ˈmætər əv əˈpɪnjən
words.ex: I think it is a matter of opinion whether pizza is better than burgers.
words.ex_cn: 我认为披萨是否比汉堡更好是个见仁见智的问题。
words.en: I believe this is subjective and depends on personal perspective.

words.ex: It's not important if we arrive late.
words.ex_cn: 我们晚到一点没关系。
words.en: It is not significant or crucial.

words.ex: That's a good idea.
words.ex_cn: 这是个好主意。
words.en: An expression of approval for a suggested course of action, indicating that it is considered sensible or desirable.

words.tr: 那不是真的；那是错误的
words.ex: He said he didn't take the money, but that's not true.
words.ex_cn: 他说他没拿钱，但那不是真的。
words.en: Used to deny the truth of a statement or claim.

words.tr: phrase. 对的；正确的（用于表示同意或确认）
words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: An expression used to confirm that something is correct or accurate.

words.ex: I can't afford it because I have no money.
words.ex_cn: 我买不起，因为我没钱。
words.en: I do not have enough money to purchase or pay for something.

words.ex: The old bookstore is small, but it's worth a look.
words.ex_cn: 那家旧书店很小，但值得一看。
words.en: It is worth examining or considering.

words.tr: 短语. 你明白；你看；你知道（用于解释或引起注意）
words.ex: You see the bird flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 你看到鸟在天上飞。
words.en: Used to introduce an explanation or to check if someone understands.

words.tr: 让我们说清楚；把事情讲明白
words.ex: Let's get this straight: I didn't steal your book.
words.ex_cn: 我们说清楚一点：我没偷你的书。
words.en: Let's clarify the situation to avoid misunderstanding.

words.ex: I would not do that if I were you.
words.ex_cn: 如果我是你，我不会那样做。
words.en: I would avoid doing that action.

words.tr: 你还没见过真正的呢（俚语，表示后面还有更惊人的事情）
words.ex: You ain't seen nothing yet—wait till you see the surprise!
words.ex_cn: 你还没见过真正的呢——等下看看这个惊喜！
words.en: A phrase used to indicate that something more impressive or dramatic is yet to come.

words.tr: 短语. 别多此一举；知足常乐；既然已经足够好，就不要再去改动
words.ex: The house is old, but it's safe — let's leave well enough alone.
words.ex_cn: 房子虽然旧了，但很安全，我们就别再改动了。
words.en: An idiom meaning to stop interfering with a situation that is already satisfactory.
An expression used to suggest that something perceived might not be real or is a product of one's mind.

words.ex: In the long run, eating healthy saves money on doctor visits.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食可以节省看医生的费用。
words.en: Over an extended period of time; in the future, especially in the distant future.

words.ex: Why did you come late?
words.ex_cn: 你为什么来晚了？
words.en: You use why in questions when you ask about the reasons for something.

words.tr: 你为什么认为那样；你凭什么这么想
words.ex: What makes you think that I stole your book?
words.ex_cn: 你凭什么认为我偷了你的书？
words.en: A question asking for the reason behind someone's belief or assumption.

words.tr: 动词短语 告诉我为什么
words.ex: Tell me why you were late again.
words.ex_cn: 告诉我你为什么又迟到了。
words.en: A request for an explanation or the reason for something.

words.tr: 副词短语 怎么发生的；为什么会这样
words.ex: How did it happen that you were late?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么会迟到的？
words.en: A question asking for the details of how an event or situation occurred.

words.w: What are you doing this for
words.tr: 你在为此做什么？（询问动机或目的）
words.uk: wɒt ɑː ju ˈdʊɪŋ ðɪs fɔː
words.us: wʌt ɑː ju ˈduːɪŋ ðɪs fɔːr
words.ex: What are you doing this for? I just want to help.
words.ex_cn: 你这么做是为了什么？我只是想帮忙。
words.en: A question inquiring about the purpose or reason for someone's actions.

words.ex: Why did you do that? It made me sad.
words.ex_cn: 你为什么那样做？它让我很难过。
words.en: A question asking for the reason behind a specific action someone took.

words.ex: What causes it? The rain made the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 是什么导致的？雨水让路面变得湿滑。
words.en: A question seeking the cause or origin of a particular phenomenon or problem.

words.tr: v. 向我解释它；给我说明一下
words.ex: Can you explain it to me?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我解释一下吗？
words.en: A request for clarification or detailed information about a topic.

words.tr: phrase. 为什么不（用于提出建议或表示同意）
words.ex: Why not go for a walk?
words.ex_cn: 为什么不去散个步呢？
words.en: used to make a suggestion or to agree with a suggestion

words.w: What are you so happy about
words.uk: wɒt ɑː juː səʊ ˈhæpi əˈbaʊt
words.us: wʌt ɑːr juː soʊ ˈhæpi əˈbaʊt
words.ex: What are you so happy about? Did you pass the test?
words.ex_cn: 你为什么这么开心？你考试及格了吗？
words.en: A question asking for the reason behind someone's current state of happiness.

words.tr: phrase. 为什么；为何目的（用于询问原因或目的）
words.ex: He asked, 'What for?' when she wanted to borrow his pen.
words.ex_cn: 当她想借他的笔时，他问道：‘为什么？’
words.en: used to ask the reason for something

words.tr: prep. 为谁（语法错误，正确形式应为 for whom）
words.ex: This gift is for who?
words.ex_cn: 这个礼物是为谁的？
words.en: Used to ask about the person for whom something is intended or relevant.

words.w: What's the purpose of your visit
words.uk: wɒts ðə ˈpɜːpəs əv jɔː vɪzɪt
words.us: wʌts ðə ˈpɜːrpəs əv jʊr ˈvɪzɪt
words.ex: The officer asked, 'What's the purpose of your visit?'
words.ex_cn: 官员问：‘你来访的目的是什么？’
words.en: A question asking the reason or objective behind someone's presence or action.

words.tr: 没有理由不；完全没有理由不去做
words.ex: You can try it—there's no reason not to.
words.ex_cn: 你可以试试——没有理由不这么做。
words.en: There is no obstacle or justification preventing something from being done.

words.ex: Why are you here? I didn't expect to see you.
words.ex_cn: 你为什么在这里？我没料到会见到你。
words.en: A question asking the reason for someone's presence in a particular place.

words.ex: I'll tell you why I was late—the bus broke down.
words.ex_cn: 我告诉你我为什么迟到——公交车抛锚了。
words.en: I will explain the reason or cause for something.

words.ex: It started like this, with a simple question.
words.ex_cn: 事情就是这样开始的，从一个简单的问题开始。
words.en: To describe how a situation or event began.

words.tr: phrase. 那就是为什么；因此
words.ex: He didn't study for the exam, that's why he failed.
words.ex_cn: conj. 他没有为考试学习，这就是他失败的原因。
words.en: used to introduce a reason or explanation for something that has just been stated

words.ex: I think you're mistaken about the time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 我觉得你对会议的时间弄错了。
words.en: I believe you have made an error in your assessment or statement.

words.ex: You're wrong about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 你对答案的理解是错的。
words.en: Your statement or belief is incorrect.

words.ex: Whose fault is that the glass broke?
words.ex_cn: 那玻璃碎了是谁的错？
words.en: Who is responsible for a mistake or negative situation?

words.tr: n. 酸葡萄心理；得不到的东西就贬低它的心态
words.ex: He says he doesn't like the job, but I think it's sour grapes because he didn't get it.
words.ex_cn: 他说他不喜欢这份工作，但我认为这是吃不着葡萄说葡萄酸，因为他没得到它。
words.en: A phrase used to express that someone is pretending to dislike something they cannot have.

words.ex: You can choose the color; that's up to you.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选择颜色；由你决定。
words.en: A polite way to say that the decision is yours to make.

words.tr: 那不是这个po（不完整表达，可能为“point”等词的缩写）
words.ex: That's not the point.
words.ex_cn: 那不是重点。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate that something is not the main point or issue.

words.ex: Excuse me, that's mine.
words.ex_cn: 不好意思，那是我的。
words.en: A polite way to ask someone to return an item that belongs to you.

words.w: Do you mind if I ask you a favor
words.tr: 你介意我请你帮个忙吗？
words.uk: duː ju maɪnd ɪf aɪ ɑːsk ju ə ˈfeɪvə(r)
words.us: duː ju maɪnd ɪf aɪ æsk ju ə ˈfeɪvər
words.ex: Do you mind if I ask you a favor? Can you help me carry this box?
words.ex_cn: 你介意我请你帮个忙吗？你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？
words.en: A polite request for permission to ask for help.

words.w: Would you give me a hand
words.tr: 短语 请帮我一下；帮忙
words.uk: wʊd ju ɡɪv mi ə hænd
words.us: wʊd ju ɡɪv mi ə hænd
words.ex: Can you would you give me a hand with this box?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我一下这个箱子吗？
words.en: A polite request for assistance.

words.ex: I'm sorry to bother you, but can you help me with this?
words.ex_cn: 不好意思打扰你，你能帮我一下吗？
words.en: A polite apology for interrupting or causing inconvenience.

words.tr: 我会很乐意做（表示愿意或欣然接受请求）
words.en: An expression of willingness to help or do something.

words.tr: 情态动词短语，表示委婉地请求或询问可能性：我能否有可能……
words.ex: Could I possibly borrow your pen for a moment?
words.ex_cn: 我能否有可能借你的笔用一下？
words.en: A polite and tentative way to ask for permission or make a request.

words.tr: phrase. 如果你愿意；如果你想的话
words.ex: If you'd like, I can help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 如果你愿意，我可以帮你做作业。
words.en: If you would prefer that.

words.ex: Could you pass the sugar, please?
words.ex_cn: 你能把糖递一下吗？

words.tr:
int. 请；
v. 使欢喜；取悦；
words.ex: Please pass me the salt.
words.ex_cn: 请把盐递给我。
words.en: to make someone happy or satisfied

words.tr: 短语. 给你；这就是你要的东西（用于递东西给别人时）
words.ex: Here you are, your algebra book.
words.ex_cn: 给你，你的代数书。
words.en: A phrase used to hand something to someone, meaning 'This is for you.

words.ex: Please do this task before lunch.
words.ex_cn: 请在午餐前完成这个任务。
words.en: A direct but polite request for someone to perform a task.

words.w: Would you drive me to the store
words.tr: 你会开车送我去商店吗
words.uk: wʊd ju draɪv mi tu ðə stɔː
words.us: wʊd ju draɪv mi tu ðə stɔːr
words.ex: Would you drive me to the store? I need to buy milk.
words.ex_cn: 你能开车送我去商店吗？我需要买牛奶。
words.en: A polite request for someone to transport you to a store.

words.w: Would you help me find the number for the ABC Hotel
words.tr: 你能否帮我找到ABC酒店的电话号码？
words.uk: wʊd juː hɛlp miː faɪnd ðə ˈnʌmbə fɔː ðə ˌeɪ biː ˈsiː ˈhoʊtəl
words.us: wʊd juː hɛlp mi faɪnd ðə ˈnʌmbər fɔr ðə ˌeɪ biː ˈsiː ˈhoʊtəl
words.ex: Would you help me find the number for the ABC Hotel?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我找一下ABC酒店的电话号码吗？
words.en: A polite request for assistance in locating a phone number for a specific hotel.

words.w: I don't know how to fill out this form
words.tr: 我不知道如何填写这个表格
words.uk: aɪ dəʊnˈt nəʊ haʊ tə fɪl aʊt ðɪs fɔːm
words.us: aɪ doʊnt noʊ haʊ tə fɪl aʊt ðɪs fɔːrm
words.ex: I don't know how to fill out this form.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道如何填写这个表格。
words.en: A phrase expressing uncertainty or inability to complete a form due to lack of knowledge or guidance.

words.tr: 动词短语 告诉我为什么
words.ex: Tell me why you were late again.
words.ex_cn: 告诉我你为什么又迟到了。
words.en: A request for an explanation or the reason for something.

words.ex: May I borrow your pen to sign my name?
words.ex_cn: 我可以借你的笔签个名字吗？
words.en: A polite request to temporarily use someone's pen.

words.tr: 疑问句，意思是：你有笔吗？
words.ex: Do you have a pen?
words.ex_cn: 你有钢笔吗？
words.en: Do you have a pen?

words.w: Can you lend me ten dollars
words.uk: kæn juː lɛnd miː tɛn ˈdɒləz
words.us: kæn juː lɛnd miː tɛn ˈdɑːlərz
words.ex: Can you lend me ten dollars until tomorrow?
words.ex_cn: 你能借我十美元直到明天吗？
words.en: A polite request for someone to lend you ten dollars.

words.w: Would you give me a call
words.tr: 短语 请你给我打个电话
words.uk: wʊd juː ɡɪv miː ə kɔːl
words.us: wʊd juː ɡɪv miː ə kɔːl
words.ex: Would you give me a call when you arrive?
words.ex_cn: 你到了能给我打个电话吗？
words.en: A polite request for someone to telephone you.

words.w: I'd appreciate it if you could call me tonight
words.tr: 我会很感激你今晚能给我打电话
words.uk: aɪd əˈpriːʃiət ɪt ɪf ju kʊd kɔːl mi təˈnaɪt
words.us: aɪd əˈpriʃiət ɪt ɪf ju kʊd kɔːl mi təˈnaɪt
words.ex: I'd appreciate it if you could call me tonight.
words.ex_cn: 如果你今晚能给我打电话，我会很感激。
words.en: A polite expression of gratitude for a future phone call tonight.

words.ex: Please turn it down, the music is too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音量调小一点，音乐太响了。
words.en: A polite request to reduce the volume of sound or brightness.

words.w: Wait here until I get back
words.tr: 在这里等着，直到我回来
words.uk: weɪt hɪər ənˈtɪl aɪ ɡet bæk
words.us: weɪt hɪr ənˈtɪl aɪ ɡɛt bæk
words.ex: Wait here until I get back.
words.ex_cn: 在这里等着，我回来后再说。
words.en: An instruction to remain in a place until the speaker returns.

words.tr: phrase. 对不起；麻烦你；打扰一下
words.ex: Excuse me, I didn't mean to bump into you.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我不是故意撞到你的。
words.en: used as a polite way to get someone's attention, to interrupt someone, or to ask someone to move so that you can pass

words.tr:
int. 喂；哈喽；
n. “喂”的招呼声或问候声；
words.ex: Hello, can you hear me?
words.ex_cn: 喂，你能听到我吗？
words.en: used as a greeting or to begin a telephone conversation

words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一本书。
words.en: Used to indicate the place where someone or something is or where something happens.

words.ex: Do you have time to help me with my homework?
words.ex_cn: 你有时间帮我做作业吗？
words.en: A question asking if someone is available or has free time.

words.w: Can I ask you a favor
words.uk: kæn aɪ ɑːk juː ə ˈfeɪvə
words.us: kæn aɪ æsk juː ə ˈfeɪvər
words.ex: Can I ask you a favor? Could you help me carry this box?
words.ex_cn: 我可以请你帮个忙吗？你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？
words.en: A polite request for assistance.

words.tr: 我可以问你一些事情吗
words.ex: May I ask you something about your weekend?
words.ex_cn: 我可以问你关于你周末的事情吗？
words.en: A polite way to ask if you can ask a question.

words.tr: phrase. 对打断表示歉意的
words.ex: I'm sorry for interrupting, but can I ask a question?
words.ex_cn: 不好意思打断一下，我可以问个问题吗？
words.en: I apologize for breaking your concentration.

words.tr: 短语. 猜猜看，通常用于引出令人惊讶或有趣的消息
words.ex: Guess what? I got the job!
words.ex_cn: 你猜怎么着？我得到那份工作了！
words.en: Used to introduce a piece of information that is surprising or unexpected.

words.tr:
int. 对不起；抱歉；
adj. 抱歉的；遗憾的；
words.ex: Sorry, I broke your cup.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我打碎了你的杯子。
words.en: feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone

words.w: I mistook you for someone else
words.uk: aɪ mɪˈstʊk juː fɔː ˈsʌmwʌn ɛls
words.us: aɪ mɪˈstʊk juː fɔːr ˈsʌmwʌn ɛls
words.ex: I mistook you for someone else at the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 我在公交站把你错当成别人了。

words.tr: 我可以借用你的电话吗？
words.ex: May I use your phone to call my mom?
words.ex_cn: 我可以借用一下你的电话给我妈妈打个电话吗？
words.en: A formal request for permission to use someone's telephone.

words.tr: adv. 我该怎么做？（用于询问方法或建议）
words.ex: How should I do it if I want to pass the exam?
words.ex_cn: 如果我想通过考试，我该怎么做？
words.en: A question asking for guidance on how to perform a task.

words.w: This is the way you should do it
words.tr: 这就是你应该做它的方式
words.uk: ðɪs ɪz ðə weɪ ju ʃʊd du ɪt
words.us: ðɪs ɪz ðə weɪ ju ʃʊd du ɪt
words.ex: This is the way you should do it.
words.ex_cn: 这就是你应该做它的方式。
words.en: An instruction explaining the correct method to do something.

words.tr: 短语 它能解决问题；这就够了
words.ex: Just add a little salt — it'll do the trick.
words.ex_cn: 加一点盐就行了。
words.en: It will be effective or solve the problem.

words.ex: This looks better than the old design.
words.ex_cn: 这比旧设计看起来更好。
words.en: This is more aesthetically pleasing or satisfactory.

words.w: I'll do it my own way
words.uk: aɪl duː ɪt maɪ əʊn weɪ
words.us: aɪl duː ɪt maɪ oʊn weɪ
words.ex: I'll do it my own way, even if others disagree.
words.ex_cn: 我会按自己的方式做，即使别人不同意。
words.en: I will do it according to my own method or preference.

words.ex: I prefer things done like this.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢事情这样处理。
words.en: Like this: in this manner or way; similar to this example.

words.ex: You can ask her about her hobbies, like what?
words.ex_cn: 你可以问问她的爱好，比如什么？
words.en: Used to ask for an example or to express surprise at something mentioned.

words.ex: It's easy to learn the basics of math.
words.ex_cn: 学习数学的基础很容易。
words.en: It is not difficult; it requires little effort.

words.tr: phrase. 就这样；突然地；轻而易举地
words.ex: He fixed the bike just like that.
words.ex_cn: 他就这样修好了自行车。
words.en: In that manner; without further explanation or delay.

words.ex: It's a little hard to understand this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题有点难懂。
words.en: It presents a moderate degree of difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 情况复杂的；关系纠缠不清的
words.ex: It's complicated to explain why he left.
words.ex_cn: 解释他为什么离开很复杂。
words.en: It involves many parts or steps that are difficult to understand or deal with.

words.w: This is the first thing to do
words.uk: ðɪs ɪz ðə fɜːst θɪŋ tuː duː
words.us: ðɪs ɪz ðə fɜːrst θɪŋ tuː duː
words.ex: This is the first thing to do: clean your room.
words.ex_cn: 这是首先要做的事：打扫你的房间。
words.en: The initial action or task that must be completed.

words.ex: You dropped this pen on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 你把这支笔掉在地上了。
words.en: You have let go of this object, likely by accident.

words.ex: I think you dropped this wallet.
words.ex_cn: 我觉得你掉了这个钱包。
words.en: I believe you have let go of this object, likely by accident.

words.ex: Is this yours?
words.ex_cn: 这是你的吗？
words.en: A question asking if an object belongs to the person you are speaking to.

words.ex: Isn't this yours?
words.ex_cn: 这不是你的吗？
words.en: Is this your property? (Used to question ownership).

words.ex: This book is old, but it's mine.
words.ex_cn: 这本书很旧，但它属于我。
words.en: It belongs to me.

words.ex: I've lost my wallet, so I can't buy lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我丢了我的钱包，所以买不了午饭。
words.en: My wallet is no longer in my possession.

words.ex: I'm in trouble because I forgot my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我因为忘了作业而陷入麻烦。
words.en: I am in a difficult or problematic situation.

words.tr: 助动词+代词+动词 帮助我吗？（用于礼貌地询问是否可以提供帮助）
words.ex: May I help you with your bag?
words.ex_cn: 我可以帮你拿包吗？
words.en: Can I offer assistance? (Polite offer of help).

words.tr: v. 三思而行；在做决定前仔细考虑
words.ex: Think twice before you decide to quit your job.
words.ex_cn: 在决定辞职之前要三思。
words.en: Consider the consequences carefully before making a choice.

words.tr: 短语 这个怎么样？；这个呢？
words.ex: How about this one? Is it better than the last one?
words.ex_cn: 这个怎么样？比上一个更好吗？
words.en: What is your opinion of this option? (Suggesting an alternative).

words.w: I want to make a suggestion
words.uk: aɪ wɒnt tə meɪk ə səˈdʒestʃən
words.us: aɪ wɑnt tə meɪk ə sərˈdʒɛʃən
words.ex: I want to make a suggestion about the class schedule.
words.ex_cn: 我想对课程安排提一个建议。
words.en: A polite way to propose an idea or plan.

words.ex: Let's take a short cut to save time.
words.ex_cn: 我们抄近路以节省时间。
words.en: A suggestion to choose a quicker or easier route or method.

words.ex: Let's play hooky and go to the park instead of school.
words.ex_cn: 我们逃学去公园玩吧。
words.en: An invitation to skip school or work without permission.

words.ex: Let's call in sick today because we both have headaches.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天请病假吧，我们都头疼。
words.en: A suggestion to call one's workplace to report being ill and not attend.

words.ex: Let's play cards after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我们打牌吧。
words.en: An invitation to play a game using a deck of cards.

words.tr: 短语. 我有个主意；我有个想法
words.ex: I have an idea.
words.ex_cn: 我有一个想法。
words.en: A thought or suggestion about what to do.

words.ex: Tell you what, let's go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 告诉你，我们去公园吧。
words.en: A colloquial phrase used to introduce a suggestion, explanation, or piece of advice in a casual manner.

words.w: Let me think for a moment
words.uk: let mi θɪŋk fɔː(r) ə ˈməʊment
words.us: let mi θɪŋk fɔːr ə ˈmoʊment
words.ex: He learns algebra in seventh grade.
words.ex_cn: 他在七年级学习代数。
words.en: A request for a brief pause to allow the speaker time to consider or reflect on something.

words.ex: Just think about it—why would he lie to you?
words.ex_cn: 仔细想想——他为什么要对你撒谎？
words.en: A request to consider something carefully before deciding.

words.ex: You should get a haircut; your hair is too long.
words.ex_cn: 你应该去剪个头发了；你的头发太长了。
words.en: A piece of advice recommending a visit to a hairdresser or barber.

words.tr: 你愿意加入我们吗？（表示邀请或请求的委婉问句）
words.ex: Won't you join us for dinner?
words.ex_cn: 你愿意和我们一起吃晚饭吗？
words.en: A polite invitation asking someone to join a group or activity.

words.ex: I wanna make a bet that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打赌明天会下雨。
words.en: An informal offer to make a wager on the outcome of something.

words.w: I suggest you take a taxi
words.uk: aɪ səˈdʒɛst ju tāk ə ˈtæksi
words.us: aɪ səˈdʒɛst ju tɛk ə ˈtæksi
words.ex: I suggest you take a taxi because it is raining heavily.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你打车，因为雨下得很大。
words.en: A recommendation that someone use a taxi for transportation.

words.ex: He asked if I wanted coffee, and I said yes.
words.ex_cn: 他问我是否想要咖啡，我说是。
words.en: Used to give an affirmative response or to agree with a positive statement.

words.tr: phrase. 确定的；肯定的；无疑的
words.ex: Sure. What is it?
words.ex_cn: 当然。是什么？
words.en: An expression used to confirm understanding or willingness to proceed.

words.ex: Do you have any problems with the homework?
words.ex_cn: 你作业有什么问题吗？
words.en: A question asking if there are any difficulties or issues.

words.tr: 短语. 怎么了；出了什么事
words.ex: What's the matter? You look sad.
words.ex_cn: 怎么了？你看起来很难过。
words.en: used to ask someone if there is a problem or if they are upset, worried, etc.

words.ex: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 当然，我会帮你做作业。
words.en: Used to express agreement or to indicate that something is expected or obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 没问题；不用谢；没关系
words.ex: No problem, I will help you.
words.ex_cn: 没问题，我会帮你。
words.en: Used to express that something is easy, acceptable, or not an issue.

words.ex: Whose idea is it to clean the room today?
words.ex_cn: 今天打扫房间是谁的主意？
words.en: A question asking who proposed or originated a particular plan or thought.

words.tr: phrase. 谢谢你；表示感谢的用语
words.ex: Thank you for helping me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢你帮我做作业。
words.en: A polite expression used to show gratitude or appreciation for something someone has done or given.

words.tr:
int. 请；
v. 使欢喜；取悦；
words.ex: Please pass me the salt.
words.ex_cn: 请把盐递给我。
words.en: to make someone happy or satisfied

words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 我的荣幸；不客气；很乐意效劳
words.ex: Thank you for helping me with my homework. - My pleasure!
words.ex_cn: 谢谢你帮我做作业。- 我的荣幸！
words.en: A polite expression used to acknowledge thanks, implying that one was happy to do the thing for which thanks are being given.

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.tr: phrase. 一点也不； 不必客气
words.ex: I don't like spicy food, not at all.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢辣的食物，一点也不。
words.en: Used as a polite response to thanks or to express that something is not a problem or does not matter.

words.tr: phrase. 我将；我会（表示未来意愿或承诺）
words.ex: I will study algebra next semester.
words.ex_cn: 我下学期会学习代数。
words.en: A phrase expressing a strong intention or promise to do something in the future.

words.tr: 短语. 明白了；懂了；知道了
words.ex: He got algebra right on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中做对了代数题。
words.en: An informal expression meaning 'I understand' or 'I have grasped the concept'.

words.tr: phrase. 别再说了；我明白了（表示理解或同意，无需进一步解释）
words.ex: When he mentioned the budget issues, I just said, 'Say no more.'
words.ex_cn: 当他提到预算问题时，我只是说，‘不用多说了。’
words.en: used to tell someone that you understand what they are saying and that there is no need to say more

words.tr: phrase. 请随意；别拘束；像在自己家一样
words.ex: Please make yourself at home; help yourself to anything you'd like.
words.ex_cn: 请自便；随意取用任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: To behave as if you are in your own home, to feel comfortable and relaxed in someone else's home.

words.w: I'd be happy to help you
words.uk: aɪd bi ˈhæpi tə help ju
words.us: aɪd bi ˈhæpi tə help ju
words.en: An offer of assistance made with pleasure and willingness.

words.tr: adv. 毫无疑问地；确定地；当然；
words.ex: He will certainly come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他毫无疑问会来参加派对。
words.en: Without doubt; definitely.

words.tr: 不管你说什么（常用于表示不以为然或敷衍的回应）
words.ex: Whatever you say, I will not change my mind.
words.ex_cn: 你说什么都没用，我不会改变主意。
words.en: An expression meaning 'I accept or agree with whatever you have decided or stated'.

words.tr: 短语 为你做任何事；为你在所不辞
words.ex: I'll do anything for you because I care about you.
words.ex_cn: 我会为你做任何事，因为我关心你。
words.en: A phrase expressing a willingness to do anything for someone, often out of affection or loyalty.

words.ex: Don't worry about the broken chair, I'll take care of it.
words.ex_cn: 别担心那把坏掉的椅子，我会处理好的。
words.en: A statement indicating that one will handle or manage a task or situation.

words.tr: 短语动词. 算我一个；让我参与
words.ex: If you're planning a trip to the mountains, count me in!
words.ex_cn: 如果你们计划去山里旅行，算我一个！
words.en: To include someone in a plan or activity.

words.ex: You cleaned the kitchen, and I'll do the rest.
words.ex_cn: 你打扫了厨房，剩下的我来处理。
words.en: A promise to complete the remaining part of a task or activity.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.w: I'll do it no matter what
words.uk: aɪl duː ɪt nəʊ ˈmætə wɒt
words.us: aɪl duː ɪt noʊ ˈmætər wʌt
words.ex: I'll do it no matter what, even if it's hard.
words.ex_cn: 无论发生什么，我都会做，即使很难。
words.en: I will complete the task regardless of any obstacles or circumstances.

words.ex: It's quite easy to add two numbers.
words.ex_cn: 加两个数字很容易。
words.en: It is fairly simple or requires little effort.

words.tr: phrase. 没什么；不用谢；小事一桩
words.ex: When I thanked him for the help, he just said, 'It's nothing.'
words.ex_cn: 当我感谢他的帮助时，他只是说，'没什么。'
words.en: used to say that something is not important or not a problem
Used to express that something would be very good or satisfactory.

words.tr: 你会（用于提出请求或建议的句型开头）
words.ex: Would you please close the door?
words.ex_cn: phrase. 请你关上门好吗？
words.en: Used to politely make a request or offer.

words.tr: phr. 你上吧；轮到你了；开始吧
words.ex: You're on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 你在公交车上。
words.en: You are correct or right about something, especially when guessing or making a statement.

words.ex: Can I sit here, if you don't mind?
words.ex_cn: 如果你不介意，我可以坐这里吗？
words.en: if you don't mind: if you have no objection or are not bothered by something.

words.tr: adv. 在任何时间；无论何时；
words.ex: You can call me anytime.
words.ex_cn: 你随时都可以给我打电话。
words.en: at any time; whenever

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.ex: Let's do it now, before it gets too late.
words.ex_cn: 我们现在就做吧，趁还没太晚。
words.en: Let's proceed with the suggested action or plan.

words.tr: 短语 你的愿望就是我的命令（表示绝对服从）
words.ex: If you want coffee, your wish is my command.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想要咖啡，你的愿望就是我的命令。
words.en: I will fulfill your request immediately and obediently.

words.tr: 短语 那就够了；这样就可以了
words.ex: That will do for now.
words.ex_cn: 现在这样就可以了。
words.en: This is sufficient or acceptable for the current purpose.

words.tr: 短语 任何东西都行；随便什么都可
words.ex: I'm hungry, so anything'll do for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我饿了，随便吃什么都可以。
words.en: Any option or item will be satisfactory.

words.ex: I don't need a fancy restaurant; anywhere'll do.
words.ex_cn: 我不需要高档餐厅，哪里都行。
words.en: Any location will be suitable.
This amount or situation is now adequate; no more is needed.

words.tr: 它关于什么；它讲的是什么
words.ex: What's it about? It's about a boy who finds a magic book.
words.ex_cn: 它讲的是什么？讲的是一个男孩找到一本魔法书的故事。
words.en: What is the topic or subject of this matter?

words.w: May I have your phone number
words.tr: 我可以知道你的电话号码吗？
words.uk: meɪ aɪ hæv jɔː fəʊn ˈnʌmbə
words.us: meɪ aɪ hæv jʊr foʊn ˈnʌmbər
words.ex: May I have your phone number?
words.ex_cn: 我可以要你的电话号码吗？
words.en: Could you please provide your telephone number?

words.tr: 我希望我能（表达一种遗憾或无法实现的愿望）
words.ex: I wish I could go to the park today.
words.ex_cn: 我真希望今天能去公园。
words.en: A polite expression of regret or desire for something that is currently impossible or unlikely to happen.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.ex: I won't go to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚不会去参加聚会。
words.en: I will not do that; used to express refusal or denial.

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.tr: phrase. 谢谢你；表示感谢的用语
words.ex: Thank you for helping me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢你帮我做作业。
words.en: A polite expression used to show gratitude or appreciation for something someone has done or given.

words.tr: 短语. 我不这么认为
words.ex: A: Do you think it will rain tomorrow? B: I don't think so.
words.ex_cn: A: 你觉得明天会下雨吗？ B: 我不这么认为。
words.en: used to express disagreement or doubt about something

words.ex: I don't want it because it's too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 我不想要它，因为它太贵了。
words.en: A straightforward statement of lack of desire for something.

words.ex: I really don't want it.
words.ex_cn: 我真的不想要它。
words.en: An emphatic and clear refusal of something, stressing lack of desire.

words.w: I'm sorry I can't help you
words.uk: aɪm ˈsɒri aɪ kɑːnt hɛlp ju
words.us: aɪm ˈsɔːri aɪ kænt hɛlp ju
words.ex: I'm sorry I can't help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我不能帮你做作业。
words.en: An apology for being unable to provide assistance to someone.

words.ex: I'm against his proposal to raise taxes.
words.ex_cn: 我反对他提高税收的提议。
words.en: A statement of opposition to a plan or idea put forward by someone.

words.w: I wish I could help you
words.uk: aɪ wɪʃ aɪ kʊd hɛlp ju
words.us: aɪ wɪʃ aɪ kʊd hɛlp ju
words.ex: I wish I could help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 我真希望能帮你做作业。

words.ex: I want to go, but I can't because I'm sick.
words.ex_cn: 我想去，但我不能，因为我生病了。

words.w: I can't do anything about it
words.uk: aɪ kɑːnt duː ˈeniˈθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ɪt
words.us: aɪ kænt duː ˈeniˈθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ɪt
words.ex: I can't do anything about it, so I just let it go.
words.ex_cn: 我对此无能为力，所以我干脆放下了。
words.en: A statement indicating that one has no power or ability to change a situation.

words.ex: I can't make that happen without more time.
words.ex_cn: 如果没有更多时间，我无法让那件事发生。
words.en: An expression that one cannot cause a specific outcome to occur.

words.tr: 短语 不想做某事；没有心情
words.ex: I'm not in the mood to go out tonight.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 今晚我没心情出去。
words.en: Used to express that one does not feel like doing something or is not ready to engage in a particular activity.

words.w: I'm afraid I've got urgent business now
words.tr: 我恐怕我现在有急事要处理
words.uk: aɪm əˈfreɪd aɪv ɡɒt ˈɜːdʒənt ˈbɪznəs naʊ
words.us: aɪm əˈfreɪd aɪv ɡɑːt ˈɜːrdʒənt ˈbɪznəs naʊ
words.ex: I'm afraid I've got urgent business now, so I must leave.
words.ex_cn: 恐怕我现在有急事，必须走了。
words.en: A polite way to say one must attend to an important matter immediately.

words.w: I have other business to take care of
words.tr: 我还有其他事情要处理
words.uk: aɪ hæv ˈʌðə ˈbɪznəs tə teɪk kɛər əv
words.us: aɪ hæv ˈʌðər ˈbɪznəs tə teɪk kɛr əv
words.ex: I have other business to take care of, so I must leave now.
words.ex_cn: 我还有别的事要处理，所以必须走了。
words.en: I have other matters to attend to.

words.ex: I'm sorry.
words.ex_cn: 我很抱歉。
words.en: An expression of regret or apology.

words.ex: I can't talk now, but I'm busy just now.
words.ex_cn: 我现在不能说话，但我现在正忙。

words.ex: I can't talk now, but I'm in a hurry.
words.ex_cn: 我现在不能聊天，但我很赶时间。

words.tr: phrase. 现在不行；不是现在；暂时不
words.ex: I can't talk not right now, I'm busy.
words.ex_cn: 我现在不能聊天，我在忙。
words.en: Not at this time.

words.tr: phrase. 别算上我；我不参加
words.ex: I don't like horror movies, so count me out.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢恐怖片，别算我一个。
words.en: I do not wish to participate.

words.ex: I'd rather not go to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我宁愿今晚不去参加派对。
words.en: Used to politely decline or express a preference against doing something.

words.tr:
adv. 足够地；充分地；
adj. 足够的；充足的；
int. 够了；
words.ex: He didn't run fast enough to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得不够快，没能赢得比赛。
words.en: as much or as many as required.

words.ex: I've had enough of this noise.
words.ex_cn: 我受够了这种噪音。
words.en: I am no longer willing to tolerate this.

words.ex: Unfortunately, he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 不幸的是，他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect.

words.w: it's not convenient for me today
words.uk: ɪts nɒt kənˈvɪniənt fɔː mi təˈdeɪ
words.us: ɪts nɑːt kənˈviniənt fɔːr mi təˈdeɪ
words.ex: It's not convenient for me today because I have a meeting.
words.ex_cn: 今天对我来说不方便，因为我有个会议。

words.tr: phrase. 与主题无关；离题；不相干
words.ex: That's beside the point.
words.ex_cn: 那与主题无关。
words.en: That is irrelevant to the main point.

words.tr: 是否可以；……可以吗（用于礼貌地询问某事是否可行）
words.ex: Is it all right if I leave early today?
words.ex_cn: 我今天早点走可以吗？
words.en: Is it acceptable if

words.tr: 短语 我可以进来吗？
words.ex: May I come in? I have a question.
words.ex_cn: 我可以进来吗？我有个问题。
words.en: Am I permitted to enter?

words.ex: May I sit here? The other seats are full.
words.ex_cn: 我可以坐这儿吗？其他座位都满了。
words.en: A polite request for permission to sit in a specific location.

words.tr: 我可以在这里玩接球吗？
words.ex: May I play catch here?
words.ex_cn: 我可以在这里玩接球吗？
words.en: A polite inquiry asking if it is permissible to play catch in that area.

words.w: Do you mind if I smoke
words.uk: duː ju maɪnd ɪf aɪ sməʊk
words.us: duː ju maɪnd ɪf aɪ smoʊk
words.ex: Do you mind if I smoke here?
words.ex_cn: 你介意我在这里抽烟吗？
words.en: A polite request for permission to smoke, showing consideration.

words.w: Am I allowed to take pictures here
words.uk: æm aɪ əˈlaʊd tu teɪk ˈpɪktʃəz hɪə
words.us: æm aɪ əˈlaʊd tu teɪk ˈpɪktʃərz hɪr
words.ex: Am I allowed to take pictures here?
words.ex_cn: 我在这里可以拍照吗？
words.en: A question asking whether taking photographs is permitted in that place.

words.ex: Let me see it before you throw it away.
words.ex_cn: 在你扔掉之前，让我看一下。
words.en: An expression indicating a desire to examine or inspect something closely.

words.tr: 我可以借用你的电话吗？
