words.ex: May I use your phone to call my mom?
words.ex_cn: 我可以借用一下你的电话给我妈妈打个电话吗？
words.en: A formal request for permission to use someone's telephone.

words.ex: May I use the bathroom, please?
words.ex_cn: 我可以去洗手间吗？
words.en: A polite request for permission to use the restroom facilities.

words.w: Can I park my car there
words.tr: 我可以把车停在那里吗？
words.uk: kæn aɪ pɑːk maɪ kɑː ðeə
words.us: kæn aɪ pɑrk maɪ kɑr ðer
words.ex: Can I park my car there?
words.ex_cn: 我可以把车停在那里吗？
words.en: A question asking if parking a vehicle in a particular spot is allowed.

words.ex: May I take a look at your book?
words.ex_cn: 我可以看一下你的书吗？
words.en: A polite request for permission to examine or inspect something.

words.ex: You mean any place where we can sit quietly?
words.ex_cn: 你的意思是任何我们可以安静坐下的地方？
words.en: A question seeking clarification about whether a specific location is being referred to.

words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 由你决定；取决于你
words.ex: It's up to you to decide what to eat.
words.ex_cn: 吃什么由你决定。
words.en: The decision is yours to make.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我确信他明天会来。
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.tr: 短语 我愿意；我同意（表示乐意接受挑战或参与某事）
words.ex: I'm game for a hike this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我愿意这个周末去徒步。
words.en: An informal expression meaning one is willing or eager to participate in an activity.

words.w: If that's all right with you
words.tr: 短语 如果你认为没问题的话
words.uk: ɪf ðæts ɔːl raɪt wɪð ju
words.us: ɪf ðæts ɔːl raɪt wɪð ju
words.ex: We can meet at 3 p.m., if that's all right with you.
words.ex_cn: 我们三点见面，如果你觉得可以的话。
words.en: A polite way to ask if a proposed action or situation is acceptable to the other person.

words.w: If it's all right with you
words.tr: 短语 如果你同意的话；如果你不介意的话
words.uk: ɪf ɪts ɔːl raɪt wɪð ju
words.us: ɪf ɪts ɔːl raɪt wɪð ju
words.ex: Can we start the meeting now, if it's all right with you?
words.ex_cn: 如果你们不介意的话，我们现在可以开始会议吗？
words.en: If you are comfortable with it; if you have no objection.

words.ex: He asked if I wanted coffee, and I said yes.
words.ex_cn: 他问我是否想要咖啡，我说是。
words.en: Used to give an affirmative response or to agree with a positive statement.

words.tr: 用于礼貌地同意或鼓励对方做某事，表示“请吧”或“当然可以”
words.ex: Can I borrow your pen? Please do.
words.ex_cn: 我可以借你的笔吗？请吧。
words.en: A polite request or instruction, often used to ask someone to do something.

words.ex: You may go home now, your work is finished.
words.ex_cn: 你可以回家了，你的工作已经完成了。

words.tr: n. 约翰（男性名）；俚语指厕所；
words.ex: John is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 约翰是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A male given name.

words.tr: phrase. 恐怕不行；恐怕不是这样
words.ex: Can you come to the meeting tomorrow? I'm afraid not.
words.ex_cn: 你明天能来开会吗？恐怕不行。
words.en: Used to politely say that something is not possible or that you cannot do something.

words.ex: I'd rather you didn't speak loudly in the library.
words.ex_cn: 我宁愿你不要在图书馆里大声说话。
words.en: I would prefer that you did not do that.

words.tr: phrase. 绝对不行；无论如何都不；休想
words.ex: Would you ever consider going bungee jumping? Not on your life!
words.ex_cn: 你会考虑去蹦极吗？绝不可能！
words.en: Used to emphasize that you will definitely not do something or that something will definitely not happen.

words.tr: phrase. 除非我死了；休想；绝对不行（表示强烈反对）
words.ex: You'll take my car over my dead body!
words.ex_cn: 想开走我的车，除非我死了！
words.en: Used to express vehement opposition to something.

words.ex: Do you want to go out tonight? Nope.
words.ex_cn: 你今晚想出去吗？不。
words.en: Used to give a negative response or to refuse something.

words.ex: He has not yet finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: used to say that something has not happened or been done up to the present time, especially when you expect it to happen or be done soon

words.ex: The keys are not here.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙不在这儿。
words.en: Not in this place; not at this location.

words.ex: You may not eat here because this is a library.
words.ex_cn: 你不能在这里吃东西，因为这是图书馆。
words.en: You are not allowed to eat in this place.

words.ex: Can you take a look at my homework?
words.ex_cn: 你能看一下我的作业吗？
words.en: To direct one's gaze in order to see someone or something.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: If you listen to someone or something, you give your attention to a sound or to what someone says.

words.ex: Please don't ignore me when I am talking.
words.ex_cn: 当我说话时，请不要不理我。
words.en: Do not disregard me; pay attention to me.

words.ex: Look here, the keys are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 看这里，钥匙在桌子上。
words.en: Look in this direction; observe this.

words.tr: 看那个（表示惊讶、赞叹或提醒注意）
words.ex: Look at that bird flying so high!
words.ex_cn: 看那只飞得那么高的鸟！
words.en: Observe that thing or situation over there.

words.ex: Please come to my house tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请明天来我家。
words.en: To move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker; to arrive at a place; to happen or take place.

words.tr:
v. 看；看上去；
n. 看；
words.ex: He looks at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看着天空。
words.en: To direct your eyes in a particular direction.

words.ex: Look at me when I'm talking to you.
words.ex_cn: 当我和你说话的时候看着我。
words.en: Direct your attention to me.

words.ex: I heard something strange outside the window.
words.ex_cn: 我听到窗外有奇怪的声音。
words.en: I perceived a sound with my ears.

words.w: I'll go and take a look right away
words.uk: aɪl ɡəʊ ænd teɪk ə lʊk raɪt əˈweɪ
words.us: aɪl ɡoʊ ænd teɪk ə lʊk raɪt əˈweɪ
words.ex: I'll go and take a look right away.
words.ex_cn: 我马上去看看。
words.en: I will go and inspect something immediately.

words.ex: It's your turn to solve the algebra problem.
words.ex_cn: 轮到你来解这个代数题了。
words.en: It is now your opportunity or responsibility to act or speak.

words.ex: I thought he was late, but as a matter of fact, he is early.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上，他来早了。
words.en: You use as a matter of fact to introduce a statement that gives more details about what has just been said, or an explanation of it, or something that contrasts with it.

words.ex: Don't tell anyone about the surprise party.
words.ex_cn: 别告诉任何人关于这个惊喜派对的事。
words.en: Keep this information confidential from others.

words.tr: 我有一个坦白；我需要承认一件事
words.ex: I have a confession: I didn't finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我得坦白：我没完成作业。
words.en: I need to disclose something personal or hidden.

words.ex: I have a secret that I can't tell anyone.
words.ex_cn: 我有一个不能告诉任何人的秘密。
words.en: I possess information that is not to be shared.

words.tr: 短语 让你了解情况；告诉你详情
words.ex: I'll fill you in on what happened at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 我会告诉你会议上发生了什么。
words.en: I will inform you of the details later.

words.tr: 短语 坦诚相告；说实话
words.ex: I'll level with you—I didn't finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我对你说实话吧——我没完成这个项目。
words.en: I will be completely honest with you.

words.w: That is about all I know
words.tr: 那就是我所知道的全部了
words.uk: ðæt ɪz əˈbaʊt ɔːl aɪ nəʊ
words.us: ðæt ɪz əˈbaʊt ɔːl aɪ noʊ
words.ex: I can't help you more—that is about all I know.
words.ex_cn: 我不能再帮你了——我只知道这么多。
words.en: That is essentially all the information I have.

words.w: This is just between you and me
words.uk: ðɪs ɪz ˈdʒʌst bɪˈtwiːn juː ənd miː
words.us: ðɪs ɪz ˈdʒʌst bɪˈtwiːn juː ənd mi
words.ex: This is just between you and me, so don't tell anyone.
words.ex_cn: 这件事只限你我知道，别告诉别人。
words.en: This information is strictly confidential between us.

words.ex: It's a secret, so don't tell anyone.
words.ex_cn: 这是个秘密，所以别告诉任何人。
words.en: This is a piece of information that must be kept hidden.

words.w: Let me tell you a secret
words.uk: lɛt miː tɛl juː ə ˈsiːkrət
words.us: lɛt miː tɛl juː ə ˈsiːkrət
words.ex: Let me tell you a secret: I love chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 让我告诉你一个秘密：我爱巧克力。
words.en: I am about to share a confidential piece of information with you.

words.ex: He can't keep a secret because he tells everyone everything.
words.ex_cn: 他守不住秘密，因为他会把一切都告诉别人。
words.en: Someone who cannot keep confidential information to themselves.

words.tr: 你嘴太大了；你爱说闲话；你管不住嘴
words.ex: You've got a big mouth — everyone knows your secret now.
words.ex_cn: 你嘴太严不住了——现在人人都知道你的秘密了。
words.en: Someone who talks too much, especially about things that should be kept private.

words.w: I don't have the guts to say that to my boss
words.tr: 我没有勇气对我的老板说那句话
words.uk: aɪ dəʊnt hæv ðə ɡʌts tə seɪ ðæt tu maɪ bɒs
words.us: aɪ doʊnt hæv ðə ɡʌts tə seɪ ðæt tu maɪ bɑs
words.ex: I don't have the guts to ask for a raise.
words.ex_cn: 我没有胆量向老板要求加薪。
words.en: Lacking the courage or bravery to do or say something.

words.tr: phrase. 有人私下告诉我；小道消息说
words.ex: A little bird told me that you got a new job.
words.ex_cn: 有小道消息告诉我，你找到新工作了。
words.en: A way of saying you have heard a piece of information but do not want to reveal your source.

words.ex: I didn't say anything when he left.
words.ex_cn: 他离开时，我什么也没说。
words.en: I remained silent; I did not speak.

words.w: It was a slip of the tongue
words.uk: ɪt wɒz ə slɪp əv ðə tʌŋ
words.us: ɪt wʌz ə slɪp əv ðə tʌŋ
words.ex: I meant to say 'coffee,' but it was a slip of the tongue—I said 'tea' instead.
words.ex_cn: 我想说‘咖啡’，但说溜了嘴，说成了‘茶’。
words.en: An accidental and unintentional mistake in speaking.

words.ex: I won't say a word about the surprise party.
words.ex_cn: 我不会透露任何关于惊喜派对的事。
words.en: I will not reveal any information; I will remain silent.

words.ex: I promise to help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 我答应帮你做作业。
words.en: A phrase used to assure someone that you will definitely do something.

words.ex: I can't promise I will be on time because of the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 由于交通原因，我不能保证我会准时。
words.en: I am unable to give a guarantee or assurance.

words.ex: I will do my homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚饭后会做作业。
words.en: used to say that you are willing to do something that someone has asked you to do

words.ex: I swear I did not steal your book.
words.ex_cn: 我发誓我没偷你的书。
words.en: Used to emphasize that what you are saying is true.

words.tr: phrase. 相信我（用于劝说或强调自己所说属实）
words.ex: Trust me, it will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 相信我，会没事的。
words.en: An informal phrase used to express confidence in a statement or to persuade someone to believe what is being said.

words.tr: 谚语 一诺千金；承诺就是承诺
words.ex: I told you I'd help you move, and a promise is a promise.
words.ex_cn: 我告诉你我会帮你搬家，言出必行。
words.en: A commitment or pledge should be honoured and kept.

words.tr: 那是什么气味？（用于询问某种气味的来源或性质）
words.ex: What's that smell?
words.ex_cn: 那是什么气味？
words.en: A question inquiring about an unidentified or notable scent detected in the air.

words.ex: What's that noise coming from the kitchen?
words.ex_cn: 从厨房传来的那是什么声音？
words.en: An inquiry about an unidentified sound.

words.tr: 短语 这行是做什么用的？
words.ex: What is this line for in the code?
words.ex_cn: 这段代码中的这一行是做什么用的？
words.en: A question asking the purpose of a queue or series of people/vehicles.

words.tr: phrase. 你正在做什么？（用于非正式场合询问对方当前的活动或计划）
words.ex: What are you up to this weekend?
words.ex_cn: 这个周末你打算做什么？
words.en: An informal way to ask someone what they are doing or planning to do, especially if it is something secret or surprising.

words.w: May I ask you a question
words.tr: 我可以问你一个问题吗？
words.uk: meɪ aɪ æsk juː ə ˈkwɛsʧən
words.us: meɪ aɪ æsk juː ə ˈkwɛstʃən
words.ex: May I ask you a question about the homework?
words.ex_cn: 我可以问你一个问题关于作业吗？
words.en: A polite request to pose a question.

words.tr: adj. 昏昏欲睡的；困倦的
words.ex: He felt drowsy after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后感到昏昏欲睡。
words.en: A request for the definition of the word 'drowsy'.

words.tr: 这是什么（用于询问某物的名称或性质）
words.ex: He is learning algebra at school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学校学习代数。
words.en: A question asking for the name or identity of an object or item being presented or observed.

words.ex: What's that on the table?
words.ex_cn: 桌子上的那是什么？
words.en: An inquiry about an unidentified object or person.

words.tr: 谁的？（用于询问某物属于谁）
words.ex: This book is on the table; who does this belong to?
words.ex_cn: 这本书在桌子上，这是谁的？
words.en: A question asking who owns or is responsible for something.

words.tr: phrase. 哪一个（用于在多个选项中进行选择）
words.ex: She is studying algebra.
words.ex_cn: 她正在学习代数。
words.en: Used to ask for a specific choice or identification from a set of options.

words.ex: What's it called when you jump over a puddle?
words.ex_cn: 跳过水坑它叫什么？
words.en: Used to ask for the name or term for something.

words.w: What did you get for me
words.uk: wɒt dɪd juː ɡet fɔː miː
words.us: wʌt dɪd juː ɡɛt fɔːr miː
words.ex: What did you get for me at the store?
words.ex_cn: 你在商店里为我买了什么？
words.en: A question asking what someone has obtained or brought for the speaker.

words.tr: 你打算去哪里；你正前往何处（常用于口语中询问目的地）
words.ex: Where are you headed after work?
words.ex_cn: 你下班后要去哪里？
words.en: A phrase used to ask someone about their destination or where they are going.

words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.ex: How often do you go to the park?
words.ex_cn: 你多久去一次公园？
words.en: Used to ask about the frequency of an event or action.

words.tr: phrase. 美国（United States of America 的缩写）
words.ex: The USA is known for its diverse culture and strong economy.
words.ex_cn: 美国以其多元文化和强大的经济而闻名。
words.en: A request for the expansion of the acronym 'USA'.

words.ex: How long does it take to walk to school?
words.ex_cn: 走路去学校要多久？
words.en: used to ask about the duration of time

words.ex: How early did you arrive at the station?
words.ex_cn: 你多早到达车站的？
words.en: A question about how far in advance something occurs.

words.ex: When does summer break start this year?
words.ex_cn: 今年暑假什么时候开始？
words.en: A question asking for the date or time when the summer holiday begins.

words.ex: When was the opening ceremony of the Olympics?
words.ex_cn: 奥运会的开幕式是什么时候？
words.en: A question asking for the specific date and time of an event's formal commencement.

words.w: Do you know the meaning of this word
words.tr: 你知道这个词的意思吗？
words.ex: Do you know the meaning of this word?
words.ex_cn: 你知道这个词的意思吗？
words.en: A request for the definition or significance of a specific term or phrase.

words.w: How do you pronounce this word
words.ex: How do you pronounce this word?
words.ex_cn: 你如何发音这个词？
words.en: A request for the correct vocalization or phonetic representation of a word.

words.w: What's the difference between A and B
words.tr: 什么是 a 和 b 之间的区别
words.uk: wɒts ðə ˈdɪfərəns bɪˈtwiːn ə ənd biː
words.us: wʌts ðə ˈdɪfərəns bɪˈtwiːn ə ənd biː
words.ex: What's the difference between a cat and a dog?
words.ex_cn: 什么是猫和狗之间的区别？
words.en: A request for the distinctions or contrasts between two specified items or concepts.

words.ex: I'm happy when I play with my dog.
words.ex_cn: 当我和我的狗玩耍时，我很快乐。
words.en: Used to express that one is feeling pleasure or contentment.

words.ex: I'm so happy.
words.ex_cn: 我非常高兴。
words.en: A statement expressing a high degree of pleasure or contentment.

words.ex: The yahoo shouted loudly in the library.
words.ex_cn: 那个粗汉在图书馆里大声喊叫。
words.en: Yahoo is an American web services provider. It was formerly one of the most popular sites on the Internet.

words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 哦，我不知道那件事。
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.ex: The boy is playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: A boy is a male child or a young male person.

words.ex: Wow, that cake looks delicious!
words.ex_cn: 哇，那个蛋糕看起来真美味！
words.en: You say 'wow' when you are very impressed, surprised, or pleased by something.

words.ex: Do you like pizza? Yeah.
words.ex_cn: 你喜欢披萨吗？是。
words.en: used to give an affirmative response

words.ex: The kids made whoopee all night at the sleepover.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在通宵聚会上整夜狂欢。
words.en: Whoopee refers to noisy and boisterous merrymaking.

words.ex: I'm glad to hear it you passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我很高兴听到你通过了考试。
words.en: Used to express pleasure upon hearing about someone else's good news or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 我很高兴……；我很欣慰……
words.ex: I'm glad that you passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我很高兴你通过了考试。
words.en: To feel pleased or happy about a particular situation or fact.

words.w: I feel like a million dollars
words.tr: 我感觉棒极了；精力充沛，状态非常好
words.uk: aɪ fiːl laɪk ə ˈmɪljən ˈdɒləz
words.us: aɪ fiːl laɪk ə ˈmɪljən ˈdɑːlərz
words.ex: After a good night's sleep, I feel like a million dollars.
words.ex_cn: 睡了一晚好觉后，我感觉棒极了。
words.en: Used to express that one feels extremely happy, healthy, or confident.

words.ex: I've never been this happy after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 我从未如此开心过，赢得比赛后。
words.en: Used to emphasize that one has never experienced a higher level of happiness.

words.ex: You passed the exam? That's good news!
words.ex_cn: 你通过考试了？那是个好消息！
words.en: Used to express satisfaction or approval upon hearing positive information.

words.tr: 感叹词短语。多么有趣啊；真有趣
words.ex: What fun we had at the park!
words.ex_cn: 我们在公园玩得多开心啊！
words.en: An exclamation expressing great enjoyment or amusement.

words.ex: I feel great after my morning walk.
words.ex_cn: 我晨练后感觉很棒。
words.en: Used to state that one is feeling physically and emotionally well.

words.w: I'm in a good mood today
words.uk: aɪm ɪn ə ɡʊd muːd təˈdeɪ
words.us: aɪm ɪn ə ɡʊd muːd təˈdeɪ
words.ex: I'm in a good mood today because the sun is shining.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气晴朗，我心情很好。
words.en: Used to describe one's current emotional state as positive and cheerful.

words.w: I'm looking forward to this summer
words.uk: aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfɔːwəd tu ðɪs ˈsʌmə
words.us: aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfɔrwərd tu ðɪs ˈsʌmər
words.ex: I'm looking forward to this summer.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着这个夏天。
words.en: Used to express anticipation and excitement about a future event or period.

words.ex: You look happy today.
words.ex_cn: 你今天看起来很开心。
words.en: A phrase used to comment on someone's apparent happiness.

words.ex: I'm walking on air after winning the prize.
words.ex_cn: 赢得奖品后，我欣喜若狂。
words.en: An idiom meaning to feel extremely happy or euphoric.

words.ex: I jumped for joy when I got the good news.
words.ex_cn: 当我听到这个好消息时，我高兴得跳了起来。
words.en: An expression of great delight or excitement.

words.w: This is too good to be true
words.uk: ðɪs ɪz tuː ɡʊd tə biː truː
words.us: ðɪs ɪz tuː ɡʊd tə biː tru
words.en: A phrase used when something seems so good that it might not be real.

words.tr: 没有任何事情能更美妙了
words.en: An expression meaning something is as good as it could possibly be.

words.ex: You made me happy when you smiled.
words.ex_cn: 你微笑的时候让我开心。
words.en: A statement indicating that someone's actions have caused happiness.

words.ex: I made it through the tough exam.
words.ex_cn: 我做到了，通过了艰难的考试。
words.en: I made it. (I succeeded in arriving, achieving something, or surviving a difficult situation.)

words.ex: You did it! You finished the race.
words.ex_cn: 你做到了！你完成了比赛。
words.en: An exclamation of praise for someone's achievement.

words.ex: He is lucky to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他很幸运赢得了奖品。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lucky, you mean that they have something which is very desirable or that they are in a very desirable situation.

words.ex: I lucked out today and found a free parking spot.
words.ex_cn: 我今天走运了，找到了一个免费停车位。
words.en: An idiom meaning to have good luck by chance.

words.tr: 这是你的好运日；今天你运气很好
words.ex: You won $100! It's your lucky day.
words.ex_cn: 你赢了100美元！这是你的好运日。
words.en: A phrase stating that today is a day of good fortune for someone.

words.ex: Thank heavens you arrived before the rain started.
words.ex_cn: 幸亏你在下雨前到了。
words.en: An exclamation of relief or gratitude, often used in difficult situations.

words.tr: 我中了头奖；意外获得巨大成功或财富
words.ex: I hit the jackpot and won one million dollars.
words.ex_cn: 我中了头奖，赢了一百万美元。
words.en: Achieved a sudden and significant success, often by chance.

words.ex: I was just lucky to find the right answer.
words.ex_cn: 我只是运气好才找到了正确答案。
words.en: My success was due to chance rather than skill or planning.

words.tr: 这是一句表达愿望实现的短语，意为：这真是梦想成真了。
words.ex: Winning the scholarship? It's a dream come true.
words.ex_cn: 赢得奖学金？这真是梦想成真了。
words.en: A long-held wish or ambition has finally been fulfilled.

words.tr: phrase. 谈论运气；说到幸运
words.ex: They talk about luck before the game.
words.ex_cn: 他们在比赛前谈论运气。
words.en: An expression used to comment on an instance of good fortune.

words.tr: 这就是它；关键时刻；就是这个了
words.ex: This is it—the moment we waited for.
words.ex_cn: 这就是它——我们等待的时刻。
words.en: This is the exact thing or situation I was referring to or hoping for.

words.ex: It's settled, we will leave tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 已决定，我们明天出发。
words.en: The matter has been decided or resolved definitively.

words.tr: 听起来很棒（用于表达赞同或对某事感到满意）
words.ex: The plan sounds great.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划听起来很棒。
words.en: Sounds excellent or very pleasing to the ear.

words.tr: 感叹语。表示“真是松了一口气；太让人宽慰了”
words.ex: What a relief to finish the exam!
words.ex_cn: 考完试真是松了一口气！
words.en: An exclamation of relief after a stressful or difficult situation ends.

words.ex: I'm surprised that he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我感到惊讶他通过了考试。
words.en: I experienced a feeling of unexpectedness.

words.tr: int. 唷（表示惊讶、宽慰、疲劳等）
words.ex: Whew! That was a close call.
words.ex_cn: 哎呀！真是有惊无险。
words.en: used to express surprise, relief, or tiredness

words.tr: int. 啊（表示惊奇、喜悦、同意等）；
words.ex: Aah! That’s so beautiful!
words.ex_cn: 啊！这太美了！
words.en: used to express pleasure, satisfaction, surprise, or great joy

words.w: I felt relieved to hear that
words.tr: 我听到那件事后感到松了一口气
words.uk: aɪ fɛlt rɪˈliːvd tə hɪər ðæt
words.us: aɪ fɛlt rɪˈliːvd tə hɪr ðæt
words.ex: I felt relieved to hear that the exam was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 我听到考试取消后感到松了一口气。
words.en: I felt a sense of relief upon receiving that information.

words.ex: Here we are at last, after walking for hours.
words.ex_cn: 我们终于到了，走了好几个小时后。
words.en: We have finally arrived at the intended place or moment.

words.ex: Good riddance to the noisy neighbor!
words.ex_cn: 好摆脱那个吵闹的邻居！
words.en: An expression of satisfaction that something or someone unpleasant has gone or been removed.

words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 哦，我不知道那件事。
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.tr:
n. 真见鬼
int. 真见鬼
words.ex: What the heck is going on here?
words.ex_cn: 这到底怎么回事，真见鬼！
words.en: used to express surprise, frustration, or for emphasis

words.tr: excl. 表示失望、沮丧或轻蔑的感叹词
words.ex: Shucks, I forgot my homework at home.
words.ex_cn: 哎呀，我把作业忘在家里了。
words.en: used to express mild disappointment, annoyance, or reluctance

words.ex: The soldier shoot at the target.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向目标射击。
words.en: To shoot means to fire a bullet from a gun or to take a photograph. It can also refer to the act of a plant sprouting or a player attempting to score in sports by sending the ball or puck towards the goal.

words.tr:
n. 屎；粪便；拉屎；胡扯
v. 拉屎；对…胡扯
int. 表示气愤或恼怒
words.ex: The dog left a pile of shit on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗在草地上拉了一堆屎。
words.en: Shit is a vulgar word for feces. It can also be used to express anger, frustration, or disappointment.

words.tr: int. 啊；哎（用于表示惊慌、惊觉或警醒）
words.ex: Uh-oh, I think I dropped my keys.
words.ex_cn: 哦唷，我想我把钥匙弄丢了。
words.en: An exclamation used to express alarm, concern, or the realization that something has gone wrong.

words.tr: 并非一切都有逻辑；不是所有事情都合乎逻辑
words.ex: Not everything is logical, like dreams.
words.ex_cn: 并非一切都有逻辑，比如梦境。
words.en: A statement acknowledging that some situations or outcomes defy rational explanation.

words.tr: 短语. 白费了；泡汤了；付诸东流
words.ex: All my effort it went down the drain when the project failed.
words.ex_cn: 当项目失败时，我所有的努力都白费了。
words.en: An idiom meaning something has been wasted, lost, or ruined.

words.tr: 短语动词. 做某事；采取行动
words.ex: He does something every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做点事情。
words.en: To perform an action or task; to engage in an activity.

words.ex: I'm so busy that I can't even have lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我太忙了，连午饭都吃不上。
words.en: I am extremely occupied with tasks.

words.w: This task is too much for me
words.tr: 这任务对我来说太重了
words.uk: ðɪs tɑːsk ɪz tuː mʌtʃ fɔː miː
words.us: ðɪs tæsk ɪz tuː mʌtʃ fɔr mi
words.ex: This task is too much for me.
words.ex_cn: 这任务对我来说太重了
words.en: A phrase stating that a particular job or responsibility is beyond one's capabilities.

words.w: I can't make ends meet on my small salary
words.tr: 我微薄的工资难以维持生计
words.uk: aɪ kɑːnt meɪk endz miːt ɒn maɪ smɔːl ˈsæləri
words.us: aɪ kænt meɪk endz miːt ɑːn maɪ smɔːl ˈsæləri
words.ex: I can't make ends meet on my small salary.
words.ex_cn: 我微薄的工资难以维持生计。
words.en: An idiom meaning one's income is insufficient to cover basic living expenses.

words.tr: 这是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草；比喻忍耐的极限已到，无法再忍受
words.ex: He forgot her birthday again — this is the last straw.
words.ex_cn: 他又忘了她的生日——这是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。
words.en: An idiom referring to the final incident in a series that causes someone to lose patience.

words.tr: 你的回应是不可接受的
words.ex: Your response is unacceptable because it does not answer the question.
words.ex_cn: 你的回应是不可接受的，因为它没有回答问题。
words.en: A formal statement that a reply or reaction is not satisfactory or acceptable.

words.w: I'm not satisfied with his answer
words.uk: aɪm nɒt sətˈɪsfaɪd wɪð hɪz ˈɑːnsə
words.us: aɪm nɑːt sətˈɪsfaɪd wɪð hɪz ˈænsər
words.ex: I'm not satisfied with his answer.
words.ex_cn: 我不满意他的回答。
words.en: An expression of disappointment or displeasure with a reply received.

words.w: He's got a chip on his shoulder today
words.tr: 他今天心怀不满，容易生气（指因过去受委屈而怀有敌意或怨气）
words.uk: hiːz ɡɒt ə tʃɪp ɒn hɪz ˈʃəʊldə təˈdeɪ
words.us: hiːz ɡɑːt ə tʃɪp ɑːn hɪz ˈʃoʊldər təˈdeɪ
words.ex: He's got a chip on his shoulder today because he was passed over for promotion.
words.ex_cn: 他今天心怀不满，容易生气，因为他没被提拔。
words.en: An idiom describing someone who is behaving in a resentful or aggressive manner.

words.tr: phrase. 公平行事；光明正大地比赛或竞争；遵守规则
words.ex: In sports, it's important to play fair and respect your opponents.
words.ex_cn: 在体育比赛中，公平竞争并尊重对手是很重要的。
words.en: To act in a way that is honest and does not cheat or take advantage of others.

words.w: What a waste of time and money
words.tr: 短语 真是浪费时间和金钱
words.uk: wɒt ə weɪst əv taɪm ənd ˈmʌni
words.us: wʌt ə weɪst əv taɪm ənd ˈmʌni
words.ex: Watching that boring movie was what a waste of time and money.
words.ex_cn: 看那部无聊的电影真是浪费时间和金钱。
words.en: An expression of frustration that something is not worth the time or resources spent on it.

words.ex: You're too generous to give me so much help.
words.ex_cn: 你太慷慨了，给了我这么多帮助。
words.en: A compliment meaning someone is being overly kind or giving more than is necessary.

words.w: He told me all about it
words.uk: hi təʊld miː ɔːl əˈbaʊt ɪt
words.us: hi t̬oʊld miː ɔːl əˈbaʊt ɪt
words.ex: He told me all about it when we met yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天我们见面时，他把一切都告诉了我。
words.en: He shared all the details or information with me.

words.tr: 短语 什么这么慢？；怎么这么久还没好？
words.ex: What's taking so long? The food is cold already.
words.ex_cn: 什么这么慢？饭都凉了。
words.en: A question expressing impatience about a delay or slow progress.

words.w: I can't make it in ten minutes
words.uk: aɪ kɑːnt meɪk ɪt ɪn ten ˈmɪnɪts
words.us: aɪ kænt meɪk ɪt ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnɪts
words.ex: I can't make it in ten minutes because the bus is late.
words.ex_cn: 我十分钟内赶不到，因为公交车晚点了。
words.en: I cannot arrive or complete the task within ten minutes.

words.ex: He looks down on me because I don't have a college degree.
words.ex_cn: 他瞧不起我，因为我没有大学学位。
words.en: He treats me with contempt or considers himself superior to me.

words.tr: 你一无是处；你毫无用处
words.ex: You're good for nothing if you don't try.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不努力，你一无是处。
words.en: You are useless or have no value.

words.tr: 它让我发疯；它让我抓狂
words.ex: The loud noise it drives me crazy.
words.ex_cn: 这巨大的噪音让我发疯。
words.en: It causes me extreme annoyance or irritation.

words.ex: Is that all you bought?
words.ex_cn: 这就是你买的所有东西吗？
words.en: A question used to ask if there is anything more to be said, done, or considered.

words.tr: adv. 那还不够；那不足以满足需求
words.ex: That's not enough money to buy a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 那还不够买一部新手机。
words.en: The amount provided is insufficient.

words.ex: He's unfair to me when he gives more work to others.
words.ex_cn: 当他给其他人更多工作时，他对我不公平。
words.en: He treats me unfairly or with bias.

words.tr: phrase. 别再找借口；没有更多借口
words.ex: It's time to take responsibility—no more excuses.
words.ex_cn: 是时候承担责任了——不再有借口。
words.en: Used to tell someone that they should stop making excuses and take responsibility or action.

words.w: I've heard enough of your excuses
words.tr: 我已经听够了你的借口
words.uk: aɪv hɜːd ɪˈnʌf əv jɔːr ɪkˈskjuːzɪz
words.us: aɪv hɜːrd ɪˈnʌf əv jɔːr ɪkˈskjuːzɪz
words.ex: I've heard enough of your excuses, so stop talking.
words.ex_cn: 我已经听够了你的借口，所以别说了。
words.en: I have listened to your explanations and am no longer willing to accept them.

words.w: I don't want to hear any excuses
words.uk: aɪ dəʊnt wɒnt tə hɪər ˈeni ɛkˈskjuːzɪz
words.us: aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tə hɪr ˈeni ɛkˈskjuːzɪz
words.ex: I don't want to hear any excuses for being late.
words.ex_cn: 我不想知道任何关于迟到的借口。
words.en: I do not wish to listen to any more explanations for your actions.

words.ex: You were late because your alarm didn't ring? That's not a good excuse.
words.ex_cn: 你迟到是因为闹钟没响？那不是一个好的借口。
words.en: The reason you have provided is not satisfactory or convincing.

words.tr: int. 有什么了不起的？（表示不满或质疑）
words.ex: He showed up late again—what's the big idea?
words.ex_cn: 他又迟到了——有什么了不起的？
words.en: What is the purpose or intention behind this action? (often rhetorical and critical)

words.w: Don't give me any lip service
words.tr: 不要给我空话；不要敷衍我
words.uk: dəʊnt ɡɪv mi ˈɛni lɪp ˈsɜːvɪs
words.us: doʊnt ɡɪv mi ˈɛni lɪp ˈsɜːrvɪs
words.ex: I need real help, not just don't give me any lip service.
words.ex_cn: 我需要真正的帮助，而不是空话。
words.en: Do not offer insincere or empty promises instead of genuine action.

words.w: Don't tell me what to do
words.tr: phrase. 别告诉我该怎么做；不要指使我
words.uk: dɒnt tel mi wɒt tu dʊ
words.us: dɑːnt tɛl mi wʌt tə du
words.ex: Don't tell me what to do.
words.ex_cn: 别告诉我该做什么。
words.en: An expression of annoyance or defiance when someone tries to give you orders or advice.

words.tr: 我生气了；我疯了（口语中常表示非常生气或情绪激动）
words.ex: I'm mad because you broke my cup.
words.ex_cn: 我生气了，因为你打碎了我的杯子。
words.en: I am feeling intense anger or irritation.

words.tr: phrase. 令人作呕的；令人厌恶的
words.ex: That smell is that's disgusting.
words.ex_cn: 那种气味令人作呕。
words.en: That is extremely unpleasant, offensive, or revolting.

words.tr: 你让我烦透了；你让我忍无可忍
words.ex: You're getting on my nerves with all that loud music.
words.ex_cn: 你放这么大的音乐，让我烦透了。
words.en: You are irritating me and causing me to lose patience.

words.ex: Don't make fun of me when I make mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 不要在我犯错时取笑我。
words.en: Do not ridicule or mock me.
Do not become distressed or unhappy.

words.ex: I've run out of patience with his constant excuses.
words.ex_cn: 我已经忍无可忍了，受不了他不断的借口。
words.en: I have completely lost my patience; I can no longer tolerate the situation.

words.tr: phrase. 竟敢；厚颜无耻（用于表达对他人无礼或大胆行为的震惊或愤怒）
words.ex: He had what nerve to ask for more money after being fired!
words.ex_cn: 他被解雇后竟敢要求更多钱！
words.en: An expression of shock or anger at someone's audacity or nerve.

words.w: How impudent you are to say such a thing
words.tr: 你竟敢说这种话，真是无礼至极
words.uk: haʊ ɪmˈpjuːdənt ju ɑː tu seɪ sʌtʃ ə θɪŋ
words.us: haʊ ɪmˈpjuːdənt ju ɑː tu seɪ sʌtʃ ə θɪŋ
words.ex: How impudent you are to say such a thing to your teacher!
words.ex_cn: 你竟敢对老师说这种话，真是无礼至极！
words.en: You are extremely rude and bold to make such a statement.

words.ex: What he says offends me.
words.ex_cn: 他说的话冒犯了我。
words.en: His words cause me to feel insulted or resentful.

words.tr: phrase. 必须报复；一定要讨回公道
words.ex: We've got to get even after they lied to us.
words.ex_cn: 他们骗了我们，我们必须报复。
words.en: We must retaliate or gain revenge for a wrong done to us.

words.tr: 我可不是昨天才出生的（意为：我并不傻，别想骗我）
words.ex: You can't fool me with that old trick, I wasn't born yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 你别想用那个老把戏骗我，我不是那么容易上当的。
words.en: Used to say that you are not easily deceived because you have a lot of experience.

words.w: Don't think you can make a fool out of me
words.uk: dəʊnt θɪŋk juː kæn meɪk ə fuːl aʊt əv miː
words.us: doʊnt θɪŋk juː kæn meɪk ə fuːl aʊt əv miː
words.ex: I know what you're doing — don't think you can make a fool out of me.
words.ex_cn: 我知道你在做什么——别以为你能愚弄我。
words.en: Do not believe you can deceive or ridicule me.

words.ex: You're making fun of me because I can't solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 你因为我解不出这道数学题而取笑我。
words.en: You are mocking or teasing me in a disrespectful way.

words.tr: 这要求太高了；这太过分了
words.ex: That's asking too much for a child to run five miles.
words.ex_cn: 让孩子跑五英里，这要求太高了。
words.en: That request is excessively demanding or unreasonable.

words.ex: He has a quick temper and gets angry easily.
words.ex_cn: 他脾气暴躁，容易生气。
words.en: He becomes angry very quickly and easily.

words.w: Who do you think you're talking to
words.tr: 你在跟谁说话呢？（表示愤怒或不满的质问）
words.uk: huː du ju θɪŋk juər ˈtɔːkɪŋ tu
words.us: hu du ju θɪŋk juər ˈtɔːkɪŋ tu
words.ex: Who do you think you're talking to? I'm not your servant!
words.ex_cn: 你在跟谁说话呢？我不是你的仆人！
words.en: You are speaking to me in a way that shows a lack of respect.

words.w: Do you have anything to say
words.uk: duː juː hæv ˈeniθɪŋ tuː seɪ
words.us: duː juː hæv ˈeniθɪŋ tuː seɪ
words.ex: Do you have anything to say about the plan?
words.ex_cn: 你有什么要说的吗？
words.en: A question asking if someone has something to say or wishes to speak.

words.w: I won't let you have your own way
words.uk: aɪ wəʊnt lɛt juː hæv jɔːr əʊn weɪ
words.us: aɪ woʊnt lɛt juː hæv jɔːr oʊn weɪ
words.ex: I won't let you have your own way if you break the rules.
words.ex_cn: 如果你违反规则，我不会让你为所欲为。
words.en: A statement refusing to allow someone to do whatever they want.

words.tr: n. 那是勒索；那是敲诈
words.ex: That's blackmail if you threaten to tell everyone.
words.ex_cn: 如果你威胁要告诉所有人，那就是勒索。
words.en: An accusation that someone is using threats to force compliance.

words.ex: Don't insult me for making a small mistake.
words.ex_cn: 不要因为我犯了一个小错误就侮辱我。
words.en: A command telling someone not to speak disrespectfully about you.

words.ex: You're a filthy liar for saying I stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 你诬陷我偷钱，是个肮脏的骗子。
words.en: An insult accusing someone of being dishonest and morally corrupt.
A warning that someone will regret their actions in the future.

words.tr: 你疯了吗？（表示惊讶、愤怒或质疑对方行为不理智）
words.ex: Are you crazy to jump into the cold water?
words.ex_cn: 你疯了吗？跳进冷水里？
words.en: A question expressing disbelief at someone's irrational or foolish behavior.

words.w: Don't look at me like that
words.tr: 别那样看着我（表示不满或委屈的语气）
words.uk: dəʊnt lʊk æt miː laɪk ðæt
words.us: doʊnt lʊk æt miː laɪk ðæt
words.ex: Don't look at me like that, I didn't break it.
words.ex_cn: 别那样看着我，我不是故意弄坏的。
words.en: A request for someone to stop staring in a disapproving or unsettling way.

words.w: I want to get even with him
words.tr: v. 向他报复；跟他算账
words.ex: I want to get even with him for lying to me.
words.ex_cn: 我想因为他对我撒谎而报复他。
words.en: An expression of a desire to retaliate or get revenge against someone.

words.tr: adj. 那个狡猾的；那个诡计多端的
words.ex: That sneaky dog stole my sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 那只狡猾的狗偷了我的三明治。

words.tr: n. 下流卑鄙的人；卑劣的家伙
words.ex: He is a low life creep who steals from old people.
words.ex_cn: 他是个从老人那里偷东西的卑劣家伙。

words.ex: He is not happy with the result.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个结果不满意。
words.en: Used to form the negative of the verb 'be' in the present tense.

words.tr: v. 是太（用于表示某事物过于某种状态，通常后接形容词或副词）
words.ex: The coffee is too hot to drink.
words.ex_cn: 这咖啡太烫了，不能喝。
words.en: Used to express that something is excessively or unacceptably so.

words.tr: 短语动词. 按你的方式行事；随你的意
words.ex: If you don't want to listen to my advice, have it your way.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不想听我的建议，那就随你的便吧。
words.en: To allow someone to do something in the way they want, even if you disagree.

words.ex: It's boring to watch the same movie again.
words.ex_cn: 再看同样的电影很无聊。
words.en: Used to say that something is uninteresting or tedious.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.tr: idiom. 这是给鸟的；毫无价值的；不值得做的
words.ex: That old TV is broken; it's for the birds.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧电视坏了；没什么用。
words.en: Used to say that something is worthless or unimportant.

words.tr: phrase. 我不感兴趣；我没兴趣
words.ex: I'm not interested in algebra.
words.ex_cn: 我对代数不感兴趣。
words.en: A direct statement of disinterest in a subject or activity.

words.ex: I'm not satisfied with the result.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个结果不满意。
words.en: Used to express that one is not pleased or content with a situation.

words.tr: 那只不过是另一次会议
words.ex: It was just another meeting about the budget.
words.ex_cn: 那只不过是另一次关于预算的会议。
words.en: Used to describe an event that was routine and not noteworthy.

words.w: I can't get into my work
words.uk: aɪ kɑːnt ɡɛt ˈɪntuː maɪ wɜːk
words.us: aɪ kænt ɡɛt ˈɪntuː maɪ wɜːrk
words.ex: I can't get into my work because I'm too tired.
words.ex_cn: 我太累了，无法投入到工作中。
words.en: Used to say that one cannot focus on or engage with one's tasks.

words.ex: That phone is outdated; it doesn't work with new apps.
words.ex_cn: 那部手机已经过时了，无法使用新应用。
words.en: Used to describe something that is no longer current or fashionable.

words.tr: phrase. 别开玩笑了；住手吧；让我歇会儿
words.ex: I've been working all day, give me a break!
words.ex_cn: phrase. 我已经工作一整天了，让我休息一下吧！
words.en: A phrase used to ask for a pause or respite from something, or to express frustration or disbelief.

words.tr: phrase. 我无法忍受它；我受不了了
words.ex: I can't stand it when the radio is too loud.
words.ex_cn: 当收音机声音太大时，我受不了。
words.en: I cannot tolerate it.

words.ex: That's enough, I don't want to hear more.
words.ex_cn: 够了，我不想再听了。
words.en: Used to indicate that a limit has been reached and no more is needed.

words.tr: 短语动词，表示劝人发发慈悲、同情或善良一点，常用于恳求或劝说的语境中
words.ex: Have a heart and help the poor child.
words.ex_cn: 发发慈悲，帮帮那个可怜的孩子吧。
words.en: If you say 'Have a heart' to someone, you are asking them to be compassionate or sympathetic.

words.w: The more I hear about it
words.uk: ðə mɔː aɪ hɪər əˈbaʊt ɪt
words.us: ðə mɔːr aɪ hɪr əˈbaʊt ɪt
words.ex: The more I hear about it, the more I want to learn.
words.ex_cn: 我越听越多，就越想了解。

words.ex: The more disgusted I get, the more I want to leave.
words.ex_cn: 我越感到厌恶，就越想离开。

words.tr: 她又来了（常用于表达对某人重复行为的无奈或调侃）
words.ex: There she goes again, talking about her diet even though she just ate a cake.
words.ex_cn: 她又来了，明明刚吃了蛋糕，还在说她的饮食。
words.en: A phrase used to express annoyance or frustration at someone's repeated behavior or complaint.

words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 哦，我不知道那件事。
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.tr:
n. 男人；人；
v. 操作；
words.ex: The man is walking his dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A man is an adult human male.

words.w: I don't want to hear it
words.tr: 我不想知道/不想听这件事
words.uk: aɪ dəʊnt wɒnt tə hɪər ɪt
words.us: aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tə hɪr ɪt
words.ex: I don't want to hear it when you lie to me.
words.ex_cn: 当你对我撒谎时，我不想听这件事。
words.en: A phrase used to tell someone to stop talking about something, often because it is annoying or upsetting.

words.tr: phrase. 现在怎么办；那接下来呢（表示困惑、无奈或询问下一步行动）
words.ex: Now what do you want to do?
words.ex_cn: 现在你想做什么？
words.en: Used to ask what should be done next.

words.w: Don't be a back seat driver
words.tr: v. 别当后座司机（比喻对别人的事指手画脚、多管闲事）
words.uk: dəʊnt biː ə ˈbæk siːt ˈdraɪvə
words.us: doʊnt biː ə ˈbæk sit ˈdraɪvər
words.en: A phrase used to tell someone to stop giving unwanted advice or criticism, especially when they are not in a position of authority.

words.ex: Please stop shouting, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请停止喊叫，太吵了。
words.en: A command telling someone to lower their voice or stop making loud noises.

words.ex: Stop complaining and help me clean up.
words.ex_cn: 别抱怨了，帮我收拾一下。
words.en: A command telling someone to stop expressing dissatisfaction or finding fault.

words.tr: phrase. 平静下来；镇定下来
words.ex: Please calm down and talk slowly.
words.ex_cn: 请冷静下来，慢慢说。
words.en: To become or make someone become quiet and relaxed after being angry, excited, or nervous.

words.ex: Will you help me with my homework?
words.ex_cn: 你会帮我做作业吗？
words.en: Are you going to?

words.tr: v. 别再唠叨了；别再烦人了
words.ex: Stop nagging me about cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 别再唠叨我打扫房间了。
words.en: A command telling someone to stop making persistent or annoying requests or criticisms.

words.tr: phrase. 别再烦我；别再责备我；别再对我指手画脚
words.ex: Stop getting off my back about the dirty room.
words.ex_cn: 别总因为房间脏而烦我了。
words.en: Used to tell someone to stop annoying you or to stop putting pressure on you.

words.tr: phrase. 不要顶嘴；不要反驳我（用于命令对方停止回嘴或反抗）
words.ex: Don't talk back to me when I'm giving you instructions.
words.ex_cn: 我在给你指示的时候不要顶嘴。
words.en: A phrase used to tell someone not to respond in a rude or argumentative manner.

words.tr: n. 大嘴巴；多嘴的人；爱说闲话的人
words.ex: He is a big mouth and always tells secrets.
words.ex_cn: 他是个大嘴巴，总是泄露秘密。
words.en: A person who talks too much, especially about things that should be kept private or that are not their business.

words.tr: phrase. 与你无关；少管闲事
words.ex: When I asked him about his salary, he just said, 'None of your business.'
words.ex_cn: 当我问起他的薪水时，他只是说，'不关你的事。'
words.en: used to tell someone that you do not want them to know about something because it is private or does not concern them

words.tr: 谁问你了（用于反驳或表示不耐烦，非正式用语）
words.ex: I didn't ask for your opinion—who asked you?
words.ex_cn: 我没问你意见——谁问你了？
words.en: A phrase used to tell someone that their opinion or comment was not requested and is unwelcome.

words.w: I can't talk to you now
words.uk: aɪ kɑːnt tɔːk tuː juː naʊ
words.us: aɪ kænt tɔːk tuː juː naʊ
words.ex: I can't talk to you now because I am busy.
words.ex_cn: 我现在不能和你说话，因为我很忙。
words.en: I am unable to speak with you at this moment.

words.ex: I don't need your help.
words.ex_cn: 我不需要你的帮助。
words.en: I do not require assistance from you.

words.tr: phrase. 离开这里；滚出去；别开玩笑了（表示难以置信或惊讶）
words.ex: Get out of here! I can't believe it!
words.ex_cn: 别逗了！我简直不敢相信！
words.en: Leave a place immediately, often used as an exclamation to tell someone to go away.

words.tr: v. 滚开，别在我面前晃悠（表示愤怒或厌烦地让人离开）
words.ex: Get out of my face, I'm tired of your excuses!
words.ex_cn: 滚开，我受够了你的借口！
words.en: Move away from me; leave me alone.

words.tr: phrase. v. 后退；退却；放弃；不再接近或攻击
words.ex: He told the dog to back off when it got too close.
words.ex_cn: 当狗靠得太近时，他让它后退。
words.en: To move backwards away from something or someone, especially in order to avoid a confrontation or to retreat from a previously stated position or commitment.

words.ex: Don't bother me while I'm reading.
words.ex_cn: 我读书时别打扰我。
words.en: Do not disturb or annoy me.

words.w: Are you trying to get rid of me
words.uk: ɑː ju ˈtraɪɪŋ tə ɡɛt rɪd əv miː
words.us: ɑːr ju ˈtraɪɪŋ tə ɡɛt rɪd əv mi
words.ex: You left early without saying goodbye—are you trying to get rid of me?
words.ex_cn: 你没说再见就早早离开了——你是不是想摆脱我？
words.en: Are you attempting to make me leave?

words.ex: He is a liar because he told a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个骗子，因为他撒了谎。
words.en: A liar is someone who tells lies.

words.ex: He said he didn't steal it, but that's a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他说他没偷，但那是个谎言。
words.en: That statement is not true.

words.ex: Don't lie to me about where you were last night.
words.ex_cn: 不要对我撒谎，说你昨晚去哪了。
words.en: Do not tell me falsehoods.

words.ex: Stop joking, I am serious.
words.ex_cn: 别开玩笑了，我是认真的。
words.en: Cease making jokes; be serious.

words.w: I've had enough of your nonsense
words.tr: 我已经受够了你的胡言乱语
words.uk: aɪv hæd ɪˈnʌf əv jɔː ˈnɒnsəns
words.us: aɪv hæd ɪˈnʌf əv jʊər ˈnɑːnsəns
words.ex: I've had enough of your nonsense, so stop talking now.
words.ex_cn: 我已经受够了你的胡言乱语，现在别说了。
words.en: I can no longer tolerate your foolish behavior.

words.tr: v. 别逗我们了；别骗我们了
words.ex: Stop putting us on, we know you're joking.
words.ex_cn: 别逗我们了，我们知道你在开玩笑。
words.en: Stop deceiving or tricking us.

words.ex: Don't act stupid, you know the rules.
words.ex_cn: 别装傻，你知道这些规则的。
words.en: A phrase used to tell someone to stop behaving in a foolish or silly manner.
Used to tell someone not to be foolish or to stop worrying about something trivial.

words.tr: adj. 那很愚蠢的；那很傻的
words.ex: That's stupid to leave your keys in the car.
words.ex_cn: 把钥匙留在车里那很愚蠢。
words.en: An expression used to describe an idea, action, or statement as foolish or lacking common sense.

words.tr: phrase. 别开玩笑，别愚弄我
words.ex: I know you're tired, but don't pull my leg about the exam results.
words.ex_cn: 我知道你累了，但别拿考试成绩骗我了。
words.en: Do not try to deceive or trick me.

words.tr: phrase. 收回（所说的话）；退回（商品）；撤销（声明或指控）
words.ex: He took it back because it was broken.
words.ex_cn: 他把它退了，因为坏了。
words.en: Retracting a previous statement or claim; admitting you were wrong.

words.w: I don't want to hear any more of your lies
words.tr: 我不再想听你的任何谎言
words.uk: aɪ dəʊnt wɒnt tə hɪər ˈɛni mɔːr əv jɔː laɪz
words.us: aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tə hɪr ˈɛni mɔr əv jɔr laɪz
words.ex: I don't want to hear any more of your lies.
words.ex_cn: 我不再想听你的任何谎言。
words.en: A statement expressing a desire for someone to stop telling untruths or deceptions.

words.w: Did you make up a story
words.uk: dɪd juː meɪk ʌp ə ˈstɔːri
words.us: dɪd juː meɪk ʌp ə ˈstɔːri
words.ex: Did you make up a story to avoid punishment?
words.ex_cn: 你编了一个故事来逃避惩罚吗？
words.en: A question asking if someone invented a false account or narrative.

words.tr:
adj. 假的；冒充的；欺骗的
n. 骗子；伪君子；假货
words.ex: He gave a phony excuse for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个虚假的借口来解释迟到。
words.en: If you describe something as phony, you disapprove of it because it is false rather than genuine.

words.tr: phrase. 别装傻；不要假装不知道
words.ex: I know you understand the rules, so don't play dumb.
words.ex_cn: 我知道你明白规则，所以不要装傻。
words.en: To pretend not to know or understand something, especially in order to avoid responsibility or to deceive someone.

words.ex: You tricked me into buying a broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 你骗了我买了一部坏手机。
words.en: An accusation that someone has deceived or misled you.

words.w: None of your tricks will work on me
words.tr: 你的任何花招都对我无效
words.uk: nʌn əv jɔː trɪks wɪl wɜːk ɒn miː
words.us: nʌn əv jɔːr trɪks wɪl wɜːrk ɑːn miː
words.ex: None of your tricks will work on me.
words.ex_cn: 你的任何花招都对我无效。
words.en: A declaration that no deceptive tactics or schemes will be successful against you.

words.tr: adj. 没有人是完美的（常用于安慰他人，表示人人都有缺点）
words.ex: You made a mistake? Nobody's perfect.
words.ex_cn: 你犯了个错？没有人是完美的。
words.en: A proverb meaning that everyone makes mistakes or has flaws.

words.ex: He is stingy with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱很吝啬。
words.en: If you describe someone as stingy, you are criticizing them for being unwilling to spend money or to give or use a lot of something.

words.tr: intj. 去你的； Fuck you 是一种粗俗的表达方式，用于表达愤怒或蔑视
words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句
words.en: A vulgar and offensive expression used to show extreme anger, contempt, or rejection.

words.tr: 你这个混蛋（粗俗用语，用于辱骂他人）
words.ex: You asshole, why did you break my phone?
words.ex_cn: 你这个混蛋，为什么把我的手机砸了？
words.en: An offensive term for a contemptible, unpleasant, or stupid person.

words.ex: Jesus is the Christ in Christian belief.
words.ex_cn: 在基督教信仰中，耶稣是基督。
words.en: Christ is the title given to Jesus, especially in the Christian religion, and it is also used as a name.

words.tr: 你这个畜生（用于愤怒或责骂时的口语表达）
words.ex: You beast! How could you hurt an innocent animal?
words.ex_cn: 你这个畜生！你怎么能伤害一只无辜的动物？
words.en: An offensive term for a cruel, violent, or brutish person.

words.tr: 你这个假小子（指行为举止像男孩的女孩）
words.ex: You tomboy, why are you climbing trees again?
words.ex_cn: 你这个假小子，为什么又在爬树？
words.en: An informal, sometimes offensive term for a girl or woman who behaves or dresses in a way traditionally considered masculine.

words.tr: n. 你这个狡猾的家伙（常用于幽默或责备的语气）
words.ex: You sly dog, you hid the cookies all this time!
words.ex_cn: 你这个狡猾的家伙，你一直把饼干藏起来！
words.en: A playful, teasing remark implying someone is clever or mischievous.

words.tr:
n. 苦工；劳累；香烟
v. （使）劳累；做苦工
words.ex: He works like a fag to support his family.
words.ex_cn: 他像苦工一样工作来养家糊口。
words.en: British informal, offensive term for a cigarette.

words.ex: Hey, can you help me with this?
words.ex_cn: 嗨，你能帮我一下吗？
words.en: used to attract attention or to express surprise, interest, or annoyance

words.ex: The old house looks ugly with broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有破窗户，看起来很丑陋。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

words.ex: The fatso ate all the cookies by himself.
words.ex_cn: 那个胖子自己吃掉了所有的饼干。
words.en: A fatso is a person who is very fat, often used as an insult.

words.ex: He called her shorty at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上叫她小不点。
words.en: A shorty is a person who is short in stature or something that is short in length.

words.tr: 感叹句：多么忘恩负义的人啊
words.ex: What an ungrateful man he is!
words.ex_cn: 多么忘恩负义的人啊！
words.en: An exclamation expressing disapproval of someone's lack of gratitude.

words.tr: n. 你这个下流坯；你这个卑鄙的人
words.ex: You lowlife, don't you dare steal my wallet!
words.ex_cn: 你这个下流坯，别敢偷我的钱包！
words.en: An insult implying someone is of low moral character or social standing.

words.tr: v. 别装酷了；别试图显得很酷
words.en: A request for someone to stop attempting to appear fashionable or impressive.

words.tr: phrase. 平静下来；镇定下来
words.ex: Please calm down and talk slowly.
words.ex_cn: 请冷静下来，慢慢说。
words.en: To become or make someone become quiet and relaxed after being angry, excited, or nervous.

words.tr: phrase. 放轻松；别紧张；悠着点
words.ex: Take it easy, the test is not hard.
words.ex_cn: 别紧张，考试不难。
words.en: To relax and not do anything too energetic or stressful.

words.tr: v. 别这么紧张；别这么焦虑（指劝别人放松）
words.ex: Don't get so uptight about the small mistake.
words.ex_cn: 别为这个小错误这么紧张。
words.en: An instruction to someone not to become overly anxious, agitated, or tense.

words.tr: v. 别那么拘谨；别那么僵硬
words.en: A request for someone to be more relaxed and less formal or rigid in manner.

words.tr: 短语. 慢慢来；不着急；从容不迫
words.ex: You can take your time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: phr. 你可以慢慢完成这个项目。
words.en: If you tell someone to take their time, you are telling them that they do not need to hurry.

words.ex: There's no need to rush, we have plenty of time.
words.ex_cn: 没必要匆忙，我们有很多时间。
words.en: A suggestion that there is no necessity to act with excessive speed or haste.

words.tr: v. 弥补；和好；编造（用于表示和解或虚构故事）
words.ex: He worked extra hours to let's make up for the missed deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他加班工作以弥补错过的截止日期。
words.en: An invitation to reconcile after a disagreement or argument.

words.tr: 短语 你编造的吗？；你杜撰的吗？
words.ex: Did you make up that story about the alien?
words.ex_cn: 那个关于外星人的故事是你编造的吗？
words.en: A question asking if someone has reconciled with another after a dispute.

words.tr: v. 停止打架；停止争斗
words.ex: Please stop fighting and talk nicely.
words.ex_cn: 请停止争吵，好好说话。
words.en: Cease physical conflict.

words.tr: 我们不能好好谈谈吗？（用于请求协商或沟通解决分歧）
words.ex: We had a fight, but can't we talk it over?
words.ex_cn: 我们吵架了，但我们不能好好谈谈吗？
words.en: A suggestion to discuss a disagreement or problem calmly and rationally.

words.tr: v. 努力和睦相处；设法相处融洽
words.ex: They try to get along even when they disagree.
words.ex_cn: 即使他们有分歧，他们也努力和睦相处。
words.en: An effort to improve a relationship or situation by being more cooperative.

words.ex: Let's forgive and forget the argument we had yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 让我们原谅并忘记昨天的争吵。
words.en: A proposal to stop holding grudges and move on from past conflicts.

words.tr: 短语 我被你难住了；我认输；你抓住我了
words.ex: You've got me—I didn't know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 你难住我了——我不知道答案。
words.en: An expression used when someone has asked a question you cannot answer.

words.ex: I've beaten you in the game.
words.ex_cn: 我已经在比赛中打败了你。
words.en: A boastful statement indicating victory over someone in a competition or argument.

words.w: I didn't mean to hurt you
words.tr: 我并不是有意要伤害你
words.uk: aɪ dɪdnt miːn tə hɜːt juː
words.us: aɪ dɪdnt miːn tə hɜːrt juː
words.ex: I didn't mean to hurt you.
words.ex_cn: 我不是故意要伤害你的。
words.en: Expressing unintentional harm: did not intend to cause hurt.

words.ex: I missed you when you were away.
words.ex_cn: 你离开的时候，我错过了你。
words.en: An expression of sadness or regret about someone's absence.

words.ex: I get lonely easily when I am alone at home.
words.ex_cn: 当我一个人在家时，我很容易感到孤独。
words.en: A tendency to feel isolated or sad when alone.

words.tr: v. 你不能把事情补救/和好吗（指修复关系或解决矛盾）
words.ex: Can't you patch things up with your brother after the argument?
words.ex_cn: 你们吵完架后，你不能和你弟弟和好吗？
words.en: A question asking if a relationship can be repaired after a dispute.

words.ex: What a disappointment! The movie was boring.
words.ex_cn: 真让人失望！这部电影很无聊。
words.en: An exclamation expressing deep sadness or regret about an unsatisfactory outcome.

words.tr: 感叹词短语。真遗憾；多可惜啊
words.ex: What a pity! He missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 真遗憾！他没赶上公交车。
words.en: An expression used to express regret or sympathy about something.

words.w: It was a waste of effort
words.uk: ɪt wɒz ə weɪst əv ˈɛfət
words.us: ɪt wʌz ə weɪst əv ˈɛfərt
words.ex: It was a waste of effort to clean the room before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 在风暴来临前打扫房间是一场徒劳的努力。
words.en: An acknowledgment that time and energy were spent without achieving a useful result.

words.tr: n. 徒劳的追求；无望的寻找
words.ex: Looking for a lost key in the big park is a wild-goose chase.
words.ex_cn: 在大公园里找一把丢失的钥匙是徒劳的追求。
words.en: A futile search or pursuit that has no chance of success.

words.tr: adv. 一无所获；白费力气
words.ex: He worked hard for months, but all that for nothing.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作了好几个月，却一无所获。
words.en: Used to express frustration or disappointment about a situation that has resulted in no gain or benefit.

words.ex: You let me down when you didn't come to my birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 你没来参加我的生日派对，让我失望了。
words.en: To disappoint someone by failing to meet their expectations or support them.

words.tr: 我搞砸了；我错过了机会
words.ex: I blew it when I forgot my interview time.
words.ex_cn: 我因为忘了面试时间而搞砸了。
words.en: To make a mistake or fail at something, often due to one's own fault.

words.tr: 短语 无法避免；无可奈何
words.en: Used to say that a situation cannot be changed or improved, so one must accept it.

words.tr: 这是一句短语，意为：浪费时间
words.ex: It's a waste of time to watch TV all day.
words.ex_cn: 整天看电视是浪费时间。
words.en: Something that is not worth doing because it will not produce any useful result.

words.ex: He almost finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎完成了作业。
words.en: You use almost to indicate that something is not completely the case but is nearly the case.

words.ex: I feel sad when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时我感到悲伤。
words.en: To experience a feeling of sorrow or unhappiness.

words.ex: I feel really sad when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，我感到非常难过。
words.en: To experience a strong feeling of sorrow or unhappiness.

words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 哦，我不知道那件事。
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.tr: adj. 亲爱的；昂贵的；宝贵的；
words.ex: Dear friend, I miss you so much.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的朋友，我非常想念你。
words.en: If someone or something is dear to you, it means you have a lot of affection for them or it is very important to you.

words.tr: interj. 哭哭啼啼；表示轻蔑或嘲笑的哭声
words.ex: Boohoo, I lost my toy!
words.ex_cn: 哭哭啼啼，我把玩具弄丢了！
words.en: An expression used to show that you are sad or crying, often in a humorous or exaggerated way.

words.ex: When she left, my heart broke.
words.ex_cn: 当她离开时，我的心碎了。
words.en: To feel extremely sad or heartbroken, usually because of a loss or disappointment.

words.w: My heart has been filled with grief
words.uk: maɪ hɑːrt hæz biːn fɪld wɪð ɡriːf
words.us: maɪ hɑːrt hæz biːn fɪld wɪθ ɡriːf
words.ex: My heart has been filled with grief since she left.
words.ex_cn: 自从她离开后，我的心被悲伤充满。
words.en: To be filled with a deep, often overwhelming feeling of sadness and sorrow.

words.tr: 悲伤的故事让我感到沮丧
words.ex: The sad story depressed me.
words.ex_cn: 悲伤的故事让我感到沮丧。
words.en: A narrative of sorrow that caused a feeling of sadness or low spirits.

words.tr: adv. 多么无情的；多么残忍的
words.ex: How ruthless she was to leave him without a word!
words.ex_cn: 她对他如此无情，连一句话都没说就离开了！
words.en: An expression of surprise or disapproval at someone's lack of compassion or mercy.

words.w: No one can understand how I really feel
words.tr: 没有人能理解我真正的感受
words.uk: nəʊ wʌn kæn ˌʌndəˈstænd haʊ aɪ ˈrɪəli fiːl
words.us: noʊ wʌn kæn ˌʌndərˈstænd haʊ aɪ ˈrɪəli fiːl
words.ex: No one can understand how I really feel.
words.ex_cn: 没有人能理解我真正的感受。
words.en: A statement expressing that one's true emotional state is incomprehensible to others.

words.ex: I feel lonely when no one calls me.
words.ex_cn: 当没有人给我打电话时，我感到孤独。
words.en: To experience a sense of isolation or lack of companionship.

words.ex: I hate being alone because it makes me feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌独处，因为它让我感到难过。
words.en: To have a strong aversion to solitary existence.

words.ex: I don't mind being alone when I read books.
words.ex_cn: 当我读书时，我不介意独处。
words.en: To be accepting or unbothered by solitary existence.

words.ex: I miss you.
words.ex_cn: 我想你。
words.en: I feel a longing for you.

words.ex: I feel empty after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对结束后我感到空虚。
words.en: To experience a sense of void, lack of purpose, or emotional numbness.

words.ex: My life is empty without my family.
words.ex_cn: 没有家人，我的生活是空虚的。
words.en: To describe a life devoid of meaning, joy, or fulfillment.

words.ex: After the party ended, she was alone at last.
words.ex_cn: 派对结束后，她终于独自一人了。
words.en: Having finally achieved a state of solitude, often after a period of waiting.

words.ex: I'm depressed because it rained all day.
words.ex_cn: 我感到沮丧，因为一整天都在下雨。
words.en: To be in a state of persistent sadness and low mood.

words.tr: 今天我感到忧郁（blues 指情绪低落、忧伤的状态）
words.ex: I've got the blues today because it's raining and I can't go out.
words.ex_cn: 今天我感到忧郁，因为下雨了，我不能出去。
words.en: Feeling sad or depressed today.

words.ex: It's depres.
words.ex_cn: 它是个无意义的词，没有含义。
words.en: Feeling down or depressed.

words.ex: Rainy days get me down because I can't go outside.
words.ex_cn: 阴雨天让我情绪低落，因为我不能出去。
words.en: Rainy days make me feel sad.

words.w: I don't feel like doing anything
words.uk: aɪ dəʊnt fiːl laɪk ˈduːɪŋ ˈɛnɪθɪŋ
words.us: aɪ doʊnt fiːl laɪk ˈduːɪŋ ˈɛnɪθɪŋ
words.ex: I don't feel like doing anything today.
words.ex_cn: 今天我不想去做任何事情。
words.en: I lack the motivation to do anything.

words.ex: He looks melancholy after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他失去狗后看起来忧郁的。
words.en: He appears sad or sorrowful.

words.tr: adj. 阴郁的；忧愁的；阴暗的
words.ex: He looks gloomy today because he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 他今天看起来阴郁，因为他丢了工作。
words.en: He appears sad or pessimistic today.

words.ex: I give up trying to solve this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我放弃了尝试解决这道数学题。
words.en: I surrender; I quit trying.

words.tr: 短语. 我忍不住；我控制不住自己
words.ex: I can't help it when I laugh so hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我笑得这么厉害时，我控制不住。
words.en: Used to say that you cannot stop yourself doing something or that you cannot control your feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 没门儿；绝对不可能；一点机会也没有
words.ex: He asked if he could borrow my car, but I said, 'Not a chance!'
words.ex_cn: 他问我能不能借我的车，我说：‘没门！’
words.en: Used to express that something is completely impossible or will definitely not happen.

words.tr: 短语 我一点也不知道；我毫无头绪
words.ex: I have no clue where my keys are.
words.ex_cn: 我一点也不知道我的钥匙在哪里。
words.en: I have no idea.

words.tr: adj. 没有希望的；无望的
words.ex: It's hopeless to find the lost key in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 在黑暗中找丢失的钥匙是没有希望的。
words.en: There is no possibility of success.

words.tr: phrase. 总比没有好；聊胜于无
words.ex: I only have a sandwich, but it's better than nothing.
words.ex_cn: 我只有一个三明治，但总比没有好。
words.en: An expression meaning that a modest or inferior option is preferable to having nothing at all.

words.ex: It was fate that we met on that rainy day.
words.ex_cn: 我们在那个雨天相遇，那是命运。
words.en: A phrase used to explain that an event or outcome was predetermined and unavoidable.

words.tr: 短语 它已成为历史；它已经过去了
words.ex: That old rule is it's history now.
words.ex_cn: 那个旧规则已经成为历史了。
words.en: A statement indicating that something is over, finished, or no longer relevant.

words.tr: phrase. 把我难住了；我不知道；真把我搞糊涂了
words.ex: It beats me how he managed to solve the problem so quickly.
words.ex_cn: 我不明白他是如何这么快解决问题的。
words.en: used to say that you do not understand something

words.w: I have no other choice but to do so
words.uk: aɪ hæv nəʊ ˈʌðə ˈtʃɔɪs bʌt tuː duː səʊ
words.us: aɪ hæv noʊ ˈʌðər ˈtʃɔɪs bʌt tuː duː soʊ
words.ex: I have no other choice but to do so.
words.ex_cn: 我别无选择，只能如此。
words.en: A declaration that one is compelled to take a specific action due to a lack of alternatives.

words.w: I no longer feel devoted to this company
words.tr: 我不再对这家公司忠诚。
words.ex: I no longer feel devoted to this company.
words.ex_cn: 我不再对这家公司忠诚。
words.en: An expression of lost loyalty or commitment to an employer or organization.

words.ex: He didn't show up again—that figures.
words.ex_cn: 他再也没有出现过——那说得通。
words.en: An exclamation used when an outcome, often negative, is exactly what was expected.

words.w: It is just as I imagined
words.uk: ɪt ɪz ʤʌst æz aɪ ɪˈmædʒɪnd
words.us: ɪt ɪz ʤʌst æz aɪ ɪˈmædʒɪnd
words.ex: The painting is just as I imagined.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画正是我所想象的。
words.en: A remark confirming that a situation has unfolded precisely as one had anticipated.

words.ex: I see a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我看到树上有一只鸟。
words.en: to perceive with the eyes; to understand or comprehend something

words.tr: adv. 我不是早就告诉过你了吗？（表示事态如所料，带有得意或责备的语气）
words.ex: I said it would rain, and look—it started! Didn't I tell you so?
words.ex_cn: 我说过会下雨，你看，真的下了！我不是早就告诉你了吗？

words.tr: phrase. 祝贺你；对你有好处；干得好（用于表达对他人好事的赞赏或讽刺）
words.ex: Good for you for finishing the race!
words.ex_cn: 你完成了比赛，真棒！
words.en: Used to express approval or congratulations to someone for something they have done.

words.ex: You forgot your umbrella and got wet—serves you right.
words.ex_cn: 你忘了带伞，被淋湿了——活该。
words.en: An expression stating that a misfortune or punishment is deserved and justified.

words.tr: phrase. 你永远不知道；世事难料
words.ex: You never know what will happen tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 你永远不知道明天会发生什么。
words.en: used to say that it is impossible to be certain about what will happen in the future

words.ex: No wonder he is tired, he worked all night.
words.ex_cn: 难怪他累了，他整晚都在工作。
words.en: It is not surprising that something is the case.

words.tr: phrase. 那就是为什么；因此
words.ex: He didn't study for the exam, that's why he failed.
words.ex_cn: conj. 他没有为考试学习，这就是他失败的原因。
words.en: used to introduce a reason or explanation for something that has just been stated

words.ex: I shouldn't have done it because it hurt my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我不该这么做，因为它伤害了我的朋友。
words.en: An expression of regret for a past action, implying it was a mistake.

words.ex: I shouldn't have said that about my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我不该说关于我朋友的那句话。
words.en: A phrase expressing regret over a past statement, implying it was inappropriate or harmful.

words.tr: 我本该知道的（表示对过去未察觉的事情感到懊悔或自责）
words.ex: I should have known the answer was simple.
words.ex_cn: 我本该知道答案很简单。
words.en: Used to express regret or frustration that one did not foresee or was not aware of something that is now obvious.

words.w: It was careless of me to do so
words.uk: ɪt wəz ˈkeələsəs əv miː tuː duː səʊ
words.us: ɪt wəz ˈkɛrələsəs əv miː tuː duː soʊ
words.ex: It was careless of me to leave the door unlocked.
words.ex_cn: 我忘记锁门是粗心的。
words.en: A statement acknowledging that one's action was imprudent or thoughtless.

words.ex: I regret doing that when I yelled at my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我后悔朝朋友大喊大叫。
words.en: An expression of remorse for a specific action one has taken.

words.ex: I had no choice but to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 我没有选择，只能早点离开。
words.en: A declaration that no alternative course of action was available.

words.ex: I went too far when I shouted at my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我冲朋友大喊时做得太过分了。
words.en: An admission that one's behavior or actions were excessive or extreme.

words.ex: I was too nervous to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 我太紧张了，不敢在全班面前说话。
words.en: An explanation that one's performance was impaired by excessive anxiety.

words.w: I wish I had studied harder
words.tr: 我希望我当初更努力学习（表示对过去未发生事情的遗憾）
words.uk: aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd ˈstʌdɪd ˈhɑːdə
words.us: aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd ˈstʌdɪd ˈhɑːrdər
words.ex: I wish I had studied harder for the exam.
words.ex_cn: 我希望我当初为考试更努力学习。
words.en: A lament about a past failure to study, implying a desire for better results.

words.tr: 我本该问他（表示对过去未做之事的后悔）
words.ex: I should have asked him if he needed help.
words.ex_cn: 我本该问他是否需要帮助。
words.en: A statement of regret for not seeking information or assistance from someone.

words.tr: phrase. 我忘了；我一时没想起来
words.ex: I'm sorry, I can't make it to the meeting today; it slipped my mind.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我今天不能参加会议了；我忘了。
words.en: To forget something; to be unable to remember something.

words.ex: I like it.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢它。
words.en: A statement indicating that you enjoy or have a positive opinion about something.

words.ex: I love pizza.
words.ex_cn: 我爱披萨。
words.en: A simple declaration of enjoyment for a specific food item.

words.ex: I like this dress.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢这条裙子。
words.en: A statement expressing approval or fondness for a particular piece of clothing.

words.w: Are you pleased with your new car
words.uk: ɑː juː pliːzd wɪð jɔː njuː kɑː
words.us: ɑːr juː pliːzd wɪð jɔːr nuː kɑːr
words.ex: Are you pleased with your new car?
words.ex_cn: 你对你的新车满意吗？
words.en: Expressing satisfaction with a recently acquired vehicle.

words.ex: I'm fond of this tea because it tastes warm and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 我非常喜欢这种茶，因为它味道温暖香甜。
words.en: Having a strong affection or preference for this particular tea.

words.tr: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: I like tea more than coffee.

words.ex: I'm hooked on watching videos every night.
words.ex_cn: 我每晚都沉迷于看视频。
words.en: I am very interested in or enthusiastic about something, often to an excessive degree.

words.w: Tomato soup is my cup of tea
words.tr: 短语. 正合我意；是我喜欢的东西
words.uk: təˈmɑːtəʊ suːp ɪz maɪ kʌp əv tiː
words.us: təˈmɑːtoʊ suːp ɪz maɪ kʌp əv ti
words.ex: I love quiet evenings with a book — tomato soup is my cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢安静的夜晚读书——这正合我意。
words.en: Referring to something that is particularly enjoyable or suitable for one's taste.

words.w: I've developed a great liking for Japanese food
words.ex: I've developed a great liking for Japanese food.
words.ex_cn: 我非常喜欢日本食物。
words.en: Have acquired a strong preference for Japanese cuisine over time.

words.tr: adj. 挑剔的；对事物要求高的
words.ex: I'm choosy about what I eat.
words.ex_cn: 我对吃的东西很挑剔。
words.en: Selective in one's choices; hard to please.

words.ex: At first, I didn't like sushi, but I came to like sushi after trying it again.
words.ex_cn: 起初我不喜欢寿司，但再次尝试后我渐渐喜欢上了寿司。
words.en: Came to appreciate or enjoy sushi, often after initial unfamiliarity.

words.tr: 短语 我越来越喜欢简了（指对某人或某事物逐渐产生好感）
words.ex: At first I didn't like Jane, but she has grown on me.
words.ex_cn: 起初我不喜欢简，但我越来越喜欢她了。
words.en: Become more appealing or likable to someone over time.

words.tr: 棒球渐渐吸引了我（指对棒球的兴趣逐渐增加）
words.ex: At first I didn't like baseball, but it grew on me.
words.ex_cn: 起初我不喜欢棒球，但它渐渐吸引了我。
words.en: Became more enjoyable or interesting to someone after initial exposure.
Something that will be enjoyable or entertaining.

words.ex: This is exciting!
words.ex_cn: 这很令人兴奋。
words.en: Something that causes feelings of enthusiasm and eagerness.

words.ex: I'm interested in reading books about history.
words.ex_cn: 我对阅读历史书籍感兴趣。
words.en: A phrase expressing a desire to learn about or engage with something.

words.ex: I'm satisfied with the result.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个结果感到满意。
words.en: I feel content or pleased with the situation.

words.ex: I enjoyed it when we went to the park.
words.ex_cn: 当我们去公园时，我享受了它。
words.en: I found it enjoyable or pleasurable.

words.ex: I was deeply moved when I saw the old man help the child.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到那位老人帮助孩子时，我深受感动。
words.en: I was profoundly affected emotionally, often in a positive or touching way.

words.ex: I don't like it when it rains all day.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢它一整天都下雨。
words.en: I have a dislike for it.

words.ex: I hate it when the bus is late.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌公交车晚点。
words.en: I feel intense dislike or aversion toward it.

words.ex: This is disgusting.
words.ex_cn: 这令人厌恶的。
words.en: It causes strong feelings of revulsion or disgust.

words.tr: n. 讨厌 （表示憎厌）讨厌，可恶
words.ex: Yuck! I don't like this soup.
words.ex_cn: 讨厌！我不喜欢这汤。
words.en: An exclamation of strong disgust or distaste.

words.ex: Peeyew is not a real word in English.
words.ex_cn: Peeyew 不是英语中的真实单词。
words.en: An exclamation expressing disgust or strong dislike.

words.w: It's your attitude I don't like
words.uk: ɪts jɔːr əˈtɪtjuːd aɪ dəʊnt laɪk
words.us: ɪts jʊr əˈtɪtud aɪ doʊnt laɪk
words.ex: It's your attitude I don't like.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢你的态度。
words.en: I dislike your way of thinking or behaving.

words.tr: 我讨厌他到极点；我非常憎恨他
words.ex: I hate his guts because he always lies.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌他到极点，因为他总是撒谎。
words.en: I feel intense hatred or animosity toward him.

words.tr: 我不喜欢它；我对它不感兴趣
words.ex: I don't care for it because it tastes too sweet.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢它，因为它太甜了。
words.en: I have no interest or liking for it.

words.tr: 我受不了他；我无法容忍他
words.ex: I can't stand him because he is always loud.
words.ex_cn: 我受不了他，因为他总是很吵。
words.en: An expression of strong dislike or intolerance for someone.

words.ex: I will never again trust someone so easily.
words.ex_cn: 我再也不会这么轻易地信任别人了。
words.en: At no time in the future; on no further occasion.

words.tr: 短语 我受够了；我忍无可忍了
words.ex: I've had it with all the noise every night.
words.ex_cn: 我受够了每天晚上的噪音。
words.en: An idiom meaning one is fed up or has reached a limit of tolerance.

words.tr: 短语. 怎么了；出了什么事
words.ex: What's the matter? You look sad.
words.ex_cn: 怎么了？你看起来很难过。
words.en: used to ask someone if there is a problem or if they are upset, worried, etc.

words.tr: 短语 你还好吗？；你没事吧？
words.ex: I saw you fall, are you okay?
words.ex_cn: 我看到你摔倒了，你还好吗？
words.en: A question asking about someone's physical or emotional well-being.

words.tr: 短语. 发生了什么事；情况如何；正在进行什么
words.ex: What's going on?
words.ex_cn: 发生什么事了？
words.en: A casual inquiry asking for an update on a situation or what is happening.

words.tr: 短语 你心里有事吗？；你有什么心事吗？
words.ex: You look quiet today—is something on your mind?
words.ex_cn: 你今天看起来很安静，你心里有事吗？
words.en: A question asking if someone is preoccupied with a thought or concern.

words.ex: I was worried about you when you didn't answer your phone.
words.ex_cn: 当你没有接电话时，我担心你。
words.en: An expression indicating that someone was feeling anxious about another person's safety or state.

words.w: Please don't go out of your way
words.uk: pliːz dəʊnt ɡəʊ aʊt əv jɔː weɪ
words.us: pliːz dount ɡo aʊt əv jɔr weɪ
words.ex: Please don't go out of your way to help me, I can do it myself.
words.ex_cn: 请不要特意麻烦自己帮我，我自己可以做。
words.en: A polite way to ask someone not to make a special effort or inconvenience themselves for you.

words.ex: You look serious today.
words.ex_cn: 你今天看起来很严肃。
words.en: A comment noting that someone appears serious, often implying they are deep in thought or troubled.

words.ex: You look sad today because you didn't sleep well.
words.ex_cn: 你今天看起来很难过，因为你没睡好。
words.en: A comment noting that someone appears unhappy or downcast on that particular day.

words.w: You don't look very happy today
words.tr: 你今天看起来不太开心
words.uk: juː dəʊnt lʊk ˈvɛri ˈhæpi təˈdeɪ
words.us: juː doʊnt lʊk ˈvɛri ˈhæpi təˈdeɪ
words.ex: You don't look very happy today.
words.ex_cn: 你今天看起来不太开心。
words.en: A casual observation suggesting the person appears unhappy.

words.ex: Why are you so glum today?
words.ex_cn: 你今天为什么这么忧郁？
words.en: A question asking why someone seems sad or dejected.

words.ex: You look exhausted after working all night.
words.ex_cn: 你通宵工作后看起来筋疲力尽。
words.en: A comment indicating someone looks extremely tired.

words.ex: You need a break after working so long.
words.ex_cn: 你工作了这么久，需要休息一下。
words.en: A suggestion that someone should take a rest from their activities.

words.w: Something is wrong with you today
words.uk: ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz rɒŋ wɪð ju təˈdeɪ
words.us: ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz rɔːŋ wɪð ju təˈdeɪ
words.ex: You are quiet today — something is wrong with you.
words.ex_cn: 你今天很安静——今天你有点不对劲。
words.en: A remark that someone is behaving unusually or seems unwell.

words.ex: Who are you irritated with after the meeting?
words.ex_cn: 会议后谁让你感到烦躁？
words.en: A question inquiring about the person causing someone's irritation.

words.ex: You're nervous before the test.
words.ex_cn: 你在考试前很紧张。
words.en: A statement that someone appears anxious or tense.

words.tr: phrase. 不幸的；令人遗憾的
words.ex: That's unfortunate that you missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 你没赶上公交车，真不幸。
words.en: An expression of sympathy for an unfortunate situation.

words.tr: phrase. 这很正常；世事难料；常有的事
words.ex: Don't worry about the mistake, it happens to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 别担心这个错误，每个人都会遇到。
words.en: Used to say that something occurs or exists by chance or without planning.

words.ex: It's a common mistake to forget the verb in this sentence.
words.ex_cn: 在这个句子中忘记动词是一个常见的错误。
words.en: A statement that an error is frequent and not unusual.

words.w: It must be tough for you
words.uk: ɪt mʌst bi tʌf fɔː ju
words.us: ɪt mʌst bi tʌf fɔːr ju
words.en: An acknowledgment that a situation is difficult for someone.

words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 哦，我不知道那件事。
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.tr: n. 可怜的东西（常用于表达同情）
words.ex: The little dog is lost and wet — poor thing.
words.ex_cn: 那只小狗迷路了，还淋湿了——真可怜。
words.en: An expression of sympathy for someone or something perceived as unfortunate or pitiable.

words.ex: I know how you feel when you lose your pet.
words.ex_cn: 当你失去宠物时，我知道你的感受。
words.en: A phrase used to show empathy and understanding of someone's emotional state.

words.ex: Never mind the mistake, let's keep going.
words.ex_cn: 别管那个错误了，我们继续吧。
words.en: You say 'never mind' when you are emphasizing that something is not serious or important, especially when someone is upset about it or you are telling them not to worry about it.

words.tr: 感叹词组 真倒霉；真不幸
words.ex: What bad luck! I missed the bus again.
words.ex_cn: 真倒霉！我又错过了公交车。
words.en: An exclamation expressing sympathy for someone's misfortune.

words.tr: phrase. 没关系；不要紧；没事（用于回应道歉或感谢）
words.ex: That's all right, I can help you.
words.ex_cn: 没关系，我可以帮你。
words.en: used to tell someone that you are not upset or angry about something, especially something they have done

words.ex: You didn't cause the accident, so don't blame yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你没有造成事故，所以不要责怪自己。
words.en: A phrase used to tell someone not to feel guilty or responsible for a negative outcome.

words.ex: It's not your fault that the glass fell.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃摔了不是你的错。
words.en: A statement used to reassure someone that they are not responsible for a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 这很正常；世事难料；常有的事
words.ex: Don't worry about the mistake, it happens to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 别担心这个错误，每个人都会遇到。
words.en: Used to say that something occurs or exists by chance or without planning.

words.w: It happens to the best of us
words.tr: 它也会发生在我们最优秀的人身上；谁都会犯错
words.uk: ɪt ˈhæpənz tu ðə bɛst əv ʌs
words.us: ɪt ˈhæpənz tu ðə bɛst əv ʌs
words.ex: I forgot my keys again — it happens to the best of us.
words.ex_cn: 我又忘了带钥匙——这种事也会发生在我们最优秀的人身上。
words.en: A saying used to comfort someone by indicating that even capable people experience setbacks.

words.w: There's no need to worry about it
words.uk: ðeəz nəʊ niːd tu ˈwʌri əˈbaʊt ɪt
words.us: ðɛrz noʊ niːd tu ˈwɜːri əˈbaʊt ɪt
words.ex: There's no need to worry about it, it's just a small mistake.
words.ex_cn: 不必担心它，这只是个小错误。
words.en: A phrase used to tell someone that there is no reason to be anxious or concerned.

words.ex: Don't give it another thought, it was just a small mistake.
words.ex_cn: 别再想了，那只是一个小小的错误。
words.en: An instruction to stop thinking about or worrying about something that has happened.

words.tr: 短语 无法避免；无可奈何
words.en: Used to say that a situation cannot be changed or improved, so one must accept it.

words.w: I don't want to put you out
words.uk: aɪ dəʊnt wɒnt tə pʊt ju aʊt
words.us: aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tə pʊt ju aʊt
words.ex: I don't want to put you out, but can you help me with this box?
words.ex_cn: 我不希望给你添麻烦，但你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？
words.en: A polite way of saying you do not want to cause someone trouble or inconvenience.

words.ex: This is nothing, don't worry.
words.ex_cn: 这没什么，别担心。
words.en: A phrase used to minimize the significance of a problem or inconvenience.

words.tr: adv. 多么可怕；多么糟糕
words.ex: How terrible the storm was!
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴多么可怕！
words.en: An expression of sympathy or disappointment about a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 没什么大不了的；无所谓；小事一桩
words.ex: Missing the meeting is no big deal; we can reschedule.
words.ex_cn: 错过会议不是什么大不了的事情；我们可以重新安排。
words.en: If you say that something is no big deal, you mean that it is not important or significant, especially in a way that you think someone else is making it seem more important or significant than it really is.

words.ex: The food was bad, but I've seen worse.
words.ex_cn: 食物很糟糕，但我见过更糟的。
words.en: A phrase used to reassure someone that their current problem is not the worst possible outcome.

words.w: Don't feel so bad about yourself
words.tr: 别对自己太苛刻；别这么难过或自责
words.uk: dəʊnt fiːl səʊ bæd əˈbaʊt jɔːself
words.us: doʊnt fiːl soʊ bæd əˈbaʊt jərˌsɛlf
words.ex: You made a mistake, but don't feel so bad about yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你犯了个错，但别对自己太苛刻。
words.en: A comforting statement encouraging someone not to be overly self-critical.

words.tr: 感叹词短语。真遗憾；多可惜啊
words.ex: What a pity! He missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 真遗憾！他没赶上公交车。
words.en: An expression used to express regret or sympathy about something.

words.tr: phr. 会顺利解决；会有好结果
words.ex: Don't worry, it'll work out.
words.ex_cn: 别担心，事情会顺利解决的。
words.en: A reassurance that a situation will improve or resolve itself positively.

words.ex: She's just upset because she lost the game.
words.ex_cn: 她只是因为输了比赛而难过。
words.en: An explanation that someone's negative behavior is due to temporary emotional distress.

words.ex: Don't cry, it's just a small scratch.
words.ex_cn: 别哭，只是个小擦伤。
words.en: A command or request not to weep or express sadness.

words.ex: She wiped her tears after hearing the sad news.
words.ex_cn: 她听到这个坏消息后擦去了眼泪。
words.en: A gentle instruction to dry one's eyes, often used to comfort someone who is crying.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.

words.tr: 短语动词. 尽你最大的努力；全力以赴
words.ex: No matter the outcome, just do your best.
words.ex_cn: 无论结果如何，只要尽力而为。
words.en: To put forth the maximum effort or attempt in a particular task or endeavor.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去争取吧；努力争取；勇敢尝试
words.ex: You can do it, so go for it!
words.ex_cn: 你可以做到，所以去干吧！
words.en: If you say 'go for it' to someone, you are encouraging them to increase their efforts to achieve or obtain something.

words.tr: 我们会为你们的队伍加油
words.ex: We'll cheer for your team when you play tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天你们比赛时，我们会为你们的队伍加油。
words.en: A promise of support and encouragement for someone's team or efforts.

words.ex: You didn't pass the test, but try harder next time.
words.ex_cn: 你这次没通过考试，但下次要更努力。
words.en: A suggestion to put in more effort in the future after a setback.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持下去；别放弃（用于鼓励他人在困难中保持毅力）
words.ex: Just hang in there; things will get better.
words.ex_cn: 坚持下去；情况会好转的。
words.en: If you tell someone to hang in there or to hang on in there, you are encouraging them to keep trying to do something and not to give up even though it might be difficult.

words.ex: Even when it's hard, don't give up.
