words.ex_cn: 即使很难，也不要放弃。
words.en: An encouragement to persevere and not abandon one's efforts or goals.

words.tr: 你做得到；你能行（用于鼓励他人）
words.ex: You can do it.
words.ex_cn: 你能做到。
words.en: An expression of confidence in someone's ability to succeed.

words.tr: phrase. 往好处想；看光明的一面；保持乐观
words.ex: He lost his job, but he tries to look on the bright side.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，但他努力看到积极的一面。
words.en: To focus on the positive aspects of a situation rather than the negative ones.

words.tr: idiom. 别太当真；别太较真
words.ex: He made a joke, so don't take it too seriously.
words.ex_cn: 他说了个笑话，别太当真。
words.en: To not treat something with excessive seriousness or concern.

words.tr: phrase. 振作起来；别灰心；保持乐观
words.ex: Keep your chin up, everything will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 振作起来，一切都会好起来的。
words.en: To remain cheerful and optimistic in a difficult situation.

words.w: You can do anything if you really want to
words.tr: 只要你真想做，你就能做到
words.uk: juː kæn duː ˈeniˌθɪŋ ɪf juː ˈrɪəli wɒnt tuː
words.us: juː kæn duː ˈeniˌθɪŋ ɪf juː ˈrɪrli wɑnt tu
words.ex: You can do anything if you really want to, like learning English every day.
words.ex_cn: 如果你真的想做，你就能做到任何事，比如每天学英语。
words.en: An empowering statement asserting that determination can overcome any obstacle.

words.tr: 短语 有可能；有希望
words.ex: There's a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: There is a possibility that something might happen.

words.w: Worrying about it won't solve anything
words.tr: 担心它并不能解决任何问题
words.uk: ˈwʌri.ɪŋ əˈbaʊt ɪt wəʊnt səlv ˈeni.θɪŋ
words.us: ˈwɜːr.i.ɪŋ əˈbaʊt ɪt woʊnt sʌlv ˈeni.θɪŋ
words.ex: Worrying about it won't solve anything.
words.ex_cn: 担心它解决不了任何问题。
words.en: Thinking anxiously about a problem will not fix it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 振作起来；使自己镇定；整理好状态
words.ex: You need to get it together if you want to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想通过考试，你需要振作起来。
words.en: To organize oneself or one's thoughts; to become composed or focused.

words.ex: He used a jack to lift the car.
words.ex_cn: 他用千斤顶把车顶了起来。
words.en: A jack is a device for lifting heavy objects, especially one for raising the axle of a motor vehicle so that a wheel can be changed or removed.

words.ex: Don't overthink it—just try it.
words.ex_cn: 别想太多，直接试试。
words.en: Make an attempt to do something, even if you are unsure.

words.ex: I will try and do it tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我会试着明天做它。
words.en: Make an effort to accomplish a task.

words.tr: phrase. 再试一次；重新尝试
words.ex: You failed the test, but you can try again.
words.ex_cn: 你考试没通过，但你可以再试一次。
words.en: Make another attempt after a previous failure.

words.tr: v. 别当胆小鬼；别退缩
words.en: Do not be cowardly; be brave.

words.tr: phrase. 面对现实吧；我们必须承认
words.ex: Let's face it, we need more time to finish this project.
words.ex_cn: 坦白说，我们需要更多时间来完成这个项目。
words.en: Used to introduce a statement that is true but perhaps unpleasant or difficult to accept.

words.ex: Let's cheer him up after he lost the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后，我们来让他振作起来吧。
words.en: Make someone feel happier or more cheerful.

words.ex: I wish you success in your new job.
words.ex_cn: 我祝愿你在新工作中取得成功。
words.en: I hope you are successful in your efforts.

words.tr: v. 当面告诉他；直言不讳地对某人说
words.ex: If you disagree, tell him to his face.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不同意，就当面告诉他。
words.en: Speak directly and honestly to someone about a matter.

words.ex: I'm serious about quitting sugar.
words.ex_cn: 我是认真的，要戒糖。
words.en: Used to emphasize that one is speaking seriously and not joking.

words.tr: phrase. 相信我（所说的话）；听我的没错
words.ex: You don't have to check every fact; just take my word for it.
words.ex_cn: 你不需要核实每一个事实；相信我的话就行了。
words.en: used to say that you should believe what someone is telling you, because they know or are honest

words.tr: int. 你最好相信这一点；当然，没错（用于强调肯定或惊讶）
words.ex: You'd better believe it, he won the race by a second.
words.ex_cn: 你最好相信，他以一秒之差赢得了比赛。
words.en: An expression used to stress that something is absolutely true or should be accepted without doubt.

words.ex: I'm sure of it, the keys are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我确定，钥匙在桌子上。
words.en: A statement expressing complete confidence in a fact or one's own judgment.

words.ex: It may sound strange, but I like broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 这听起来可能很奇怪，但我喜欢西兰花。
words.en: An expression indicating that something might seem unusual or surprising.

words.ex: I don't like spicy food, but it's true that it helps digestion.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢辣的食物，但它确实有助于消化。

words.ex: I'm innocent, I didn't steal the money.
words.ex_cn: 我是无辜的，我没偷钱。
words.en: A declaration of one's lack of guilt or wrongdoing in a particular situation.

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.tr: 你认真的吗？（表示惊讶或怀疑）
words.ex: Are you serious? You ate all the cookies?
words.ex_cn: 你是认真的吗？你把所有的饼干都吃光了？
words.en: Used to express surprise or disbelief at something someone has said or done.

words.ex: Are you joking? That’s impossible!
words.ex_cn: 你在开玩笑吧？那不可能！
words.en: Used to ask if someone is being humorous or not serious.

words.tr: 这对我来说很可疑；这听起来不对劲
words.ex: It sounds fishy to me that he left work early without telling anyone.
words.ex_cn: 我觉得他没告诉任何人就早早离开工作，这很可疑。
words.en: Used to express suspicion or doubt about the truth of a situation or statement.

words.tr: 我不相信那个说法（俚语，表示不接受某人的解释或借口）
words.ex: I won't buy that story about the alien landing.
words.ex_cn: 我不相信那个关于外星人登陆的故事。
words.en: Used to indicate that you do not believe what someone is saying.

words.ex: Do you think she's serious about quitting her job?
words.ex_cn: 你认为她认真考虑辞职吗？
words.en: Used to ask if someone believes another person is being sincere or serious.

words.w: I don't take him too seriously
words.uk: aɪ dəʊnt teɪk hɪm tuː ˈsɪərɪəsli
words.us: aɪ doʊnt teɪk hɪm tuː ˈsɪriəsli
words.ex: I don't take him too seriously because he always jokes.
words.ex_cn: 我不太当真对待他，因为他总是开玩笑。
words.en: Used to indicate that you do not fully believe or trust what someone says or does.

words.ex: I don't believe him when he says he will be on time.
words.ex_cn: 当他说他会准时时，我不相信他。
words.en: Used to state that you do not accept something as true.

words.w: It's too good to be true
words.tr: phrase. 好得令人难以置信；太完美反而不真实
words.ex: It's too good to be true that I got a free car.
words.ex_cn: 我得到一辆免费的车，这太好了，不像是真的。
words.en: Used to say that you cannot believe that something is as good as it seems because it is usually not possible.

words.w: I don't know what to do
words.ex: I don't know what to do when the computer stops working.
words.ex_cn: 当电脑停止工作时，我不知道该怎么办。
words.en: Used to express uncertainty or a lack of a solution to a problem.

words.w: What am I supposed to do
words.tr: 我该做什么？（表示困惑或寻求指导）
words.uk: wɒt əm aɪ səˈpəʊzd tu du
words.us: wʌt əm aɪ səˈpoʊzd tu du
words.ex: I don't know what am i supposed to do next.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道接下来我该做什么。
words.en: Used to ask what action you should take in a particular situation.

words.tr: n. 麻烦事；令人烦恼的事
words.ex: It's a hassle to wait in line for hours.
words.ex_cn: 排几个小时的队很麻烦。
words.en: A situation that is annoying or inconvenient to deal with.

words.ex: It's really a difficult problem to solve without a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 没有计算器，这真是个难题。
words.en: It is a very challenging issue that is hard to resolve.

words.w: I don't know what to say
words.tr: phrase. 我不知道该说什么
words.ex: I don't know what to say when she cries.
words.ex_cn: 当她哭的时候，我不知道该说什么。
words.en: An expression used when someone is at a loss for words or does not know how to respond in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 你抓住我了；你难倒我了；我认输（常用于承认被对方说中或无法回答）
words.ex: You got me laughing with that joke.
words.ex_cn: 你那个笑话让我笑了。
words.en: You have successfully deceived or tricked me.

words.tr: n. 讨厌的人；令人烦恼的事物
words.ex: He's a nuisance because he talks loudly during class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课时大声说话，是个烦人的人。
words.en: He is a person who causes annoyance or trouble.

words.ex: Oops, I dropped my phone.
words.ex_cn: 哎哟，我把手机掉地上了。
words.en: An exclamation used to express surprise or to acknowledge a minor mistake or accident.

words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 哦，我不知道那件事。
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.tr: 那就是硬p（指发音清晰、不送气的/p/音）
words.ex: That's the hard part of learning a new language.
words.ex_cn: 那是学习一门新语言的困难部分。
words.en: That is the difficult part or the main challenge.

words.ex: I feel guilty for eating the last cookie.
words.ex_cn: 我吃了最后一块饼干，感到内疚。
words.en: I feel a sense of remorse or responsibility for a wrong action.

words.ex: You look puzzled when I explain the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 当我解释这道数学题时，你看起来很困惑。
words.en: You appear confused or perplexed.

words.tr: 这个想法萦绕在我心头
words.ex: The idea haunts me every night.
words.ex_cn: 这个想法每晚都萦绕在我心头。
words.en: The thought persists in my mind and causes distress.

words.tr: phrase. 我不在乎；我不介意
words.ex: I don't care about algebra.
words.ex_cn: 我不在乎代数。
words.en: I am indifferent or uninterested.

words.tr: phrase. 谁在乎；表示对某事漠不关心或无所谓的态度
words.ex: Who cares if he is late?
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，谁在乎呢？
words.en: used to say that something is not important or that you are not worried about it

words.tr: pron. 任何你想要的东西；随便什么；whatever：pron. 无论什么；任何；adj. 不管怎样的；you：pron. 你；want：v. 想要；需要
words.ex: He will do whatever you want.
words.ex_cn: 他会做你想要的任何事。
words.en: An expression of agreement or compliance with someone's wishes.

words.ex: Nobody knows where he went last night.
words.ex_cn: 没人知道他昨晚去哪了。
words.en: A statement indicating that information is unknown to anyone.

words.w: It has nothing to do with me
words.tr: phrase. 这与我无关；这事跟我没关系
words.uk: ɪt hæz ˈnʌθɪŋ tə du wɪð miː
words.us: ɪt hæz ˈnʌθɪŋ tə du wɪð mi
words.ex: It has nothing to do with me.
words.ex_cn: 这和我无关。
words.en: It is not connected to or my responsibility.

words.tr: phrase. 我一点也不在乎；我完全不关心
words.ex: I couldn't care less about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 我对这部电影毫不在意。
words.en: A phrase indicating complete indifference or lack of concern.

words.ex: He shouted in the street, but nobody cares.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上大喊，但没人关心。
words.en: An expression of indifference, stating that no one is concerned or interested.

words.tr: phrase. (习语) 顺其自然；听之任之；别管它
words.ex: He sang, 'Let it be,' when he felt sad.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到难过时，他唱了‘顺其自然’。
words.en: A phrase meaning to accept a situation as it is and not try to change or worry about it.

words.w: I don't care what they say
words.uk: aɪ dəʊnt keə wɒt ðeɪ seɪ
words.us: aɪ doʊnt kɛr wʌt ðeɪ seɪ
words.ex: I don't care what they say, I will keep practicing.
words.ex_cn: 他们说什么我不在乎，我会继续练习。
words.en: A declaration of disregard for the opinions or criticisms of others.

words.tr: 只要任何人就行；谁都可以
words.ex: I just need someone to help me move; anyone will do.
words.ex_cn: 我只需要有人帮我搬家，谁都可以。
words.en: Used to indicate that any person or thing is acceptable or sufficient for a purpose.

words.tr: 我们能没有他；我们不需要他
words.ex: We can do without him because the team has enough skilled members.
words.ex_cn: 我们没有他也能行，因为团队已经有足够多的熟练成员。
words.en: An expression indicating that someone's absence or lack of contribution would not be a problem.

words.w: I've got nothing special to talk about
words.tr: 我没什么特别的可说的
words.uk: aɪv ɡɒt ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈspɛʃəl tə tɔːk əˈbaʊt
words.us: aɪv ɡɑt ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈspɛʃəl tə tɔk əˈbaʊt
words.ex: I've got nothing special to talk about.
words.ex_cn: 我没什么特别的可说的。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate that one has no particular topic of conversation to share.

words.tr: phrase. 没关系；无所谓；不重要
words.ex: It doesn't matter if you're late, just come when you can.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 如果你迟到也没关系，能来的时候来就行。
words.en: Used to say that something is not important or that you should not worry about it.

words.tr: 短语 还是老一套；老调重弹
words.ex: He lost his job again—it's the same old story.
words.ex_cn: 他又丢了工作——还是老样子。
words.en: A remark used to express that a situation or problem is a recurring and unchanging one.

words.ex: I'm shy when I meet new people.
words.ex_cn: 我见到新的人时很害羞。
words.en: I am nervous or timid in the company of others.

words.ex: I'm ashamed of myself for lying to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我因为对朋友撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: I feel embarrassed or humiliated by my own actions.

words.ex: It is how shameful to lie to your best friend.
words.ex_cn: 对最好的朋友撒谎是多么可耻。
words.en: It is a cause for shame or disgrace.

words.tr: phrase. 表示谴责或不满：你真可耻； shame（羞耻）是名词，on you 是介词短语，整体作为固定表达用于责备某人行为不当
words.ex: Shame on you for lying to your friend.
words.ex_cn: 你对朋友撒谎，真丢脸。
words.en: Used to express disapproval or disappointment towards someone's actions.

words.ex: I'm surprised that he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我感到惊讶他通过了考试。
words.en: I experienced a feeling of unexpectedness.

words.ex: I'm shocked when I saw the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到破碎的窗户时，我感到震惊。
words.en: An exclamation expressing strong surprise or dismay at something unexpected.

words.ex: That's amazing! You finished the puzzle in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 太棒了！你五分钟就完成了这个拼图。
words.en: An expression of great admiration or astonishment at something impressive.

words.tr: interj. 你在开玩笑吧；别逗了
words.ex: You're kidding me—you won the lottery?
words.ex_cn: 你在开玩笑吧——你中了彩票？
words.en: An exclamation expressing disbelief or skepticism about what someone has said.

words.ex: It can't be true that he failed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他考试不及格不可能是真的。
words.en: used to express that something is impossible or highly unlikely.

words.tr: 你认真的吗？（表示惊讶或怀疑）
words.ex: Are you serious? You ate all the cookies?
words.ex_cn: 你是认真的吗？你把所有的饼干都吃光了？
words.en: Used to express surprise or disbelief at something someone has said or done.

words.tr: phrase. （表示惊讶或赞叹）那可真了不起；那可真不简单
words.ex: That's really something!
words.ex_cn: 那真的太棒了！
words.en: An exclamation of admiration or astonishment at something impressive or remarkable.

words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 哦，我不知道那件事。
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.ex: My book is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我的书在桌子上。
words.en: Used to refer to oneself as the possessor of something.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.ex: You surprised me with a gift on my birthday.
words.ex_cn: 你在我生日时送我一份礼物，让我很惊讶。
words.en: A statement indicating that someone's action or words were unexpected.

words.tr: interj. 真的吗？（表示惊讶或怀疑）
words.ex: He won the lottery? You don't say!
words.ex_cn: 他中了彩票？真的吗！
words.en: An expression of feigned or genuine surprise, often used sarcastically.

words.tr: interj. 那才怪呢；那才不会发生呢（表示极度怀疑或不可能）
words.en: An expression of strong disbelief that something will ever happen.

words.tr: n. 巨大的震惊；极大的打击
words.ex: The news of his death was a great shock to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他去世的消息让所有人都感到非常震惊。
words.en: A sudden, overwhelming feeling of astonishment or dismay.

words.tr: 那对我来说是新鲜事；我以前不知道
words.ex: I didn't know he quit his job—that's news to me.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他辞职了——这对我来说是新闻。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate that one has just learned something new and surprising.

words.tr: adj. 令人难以置信的；令人震惊的
words.ex: It's mind-boggling how fast the internet has grown.
words.ex_cn: 互联网发展得如此之快，令人难以置信。
words.en: Extremely difficult to comprehend or imagine; astonishing.

words.ex: Gosh, I forgot my keys again!
words.ex_cn: 天哪，我又忘了带钥匙！
words.en: used to express surprise or emphasis

words.w: We were surprised by the news
words.tr: 我们对这个消息感到惊讶
words.uk: wiː wɜː səˈpraɪzd baɪ ðə njuːz
words.us: wiː wɜːr sərˈpraɪzd baɪ ðə nuːz
words.ex: We were surprised by the news.
words.ex_cn: 我们对这个消息感到惊讶。
words.en: We were taken aback by the information we received.

words.tr:
int. 呸；嘘
n. 嘘声
v. 发出嘘声
words.ex: The crowd gave a loud boo when the player missed the goal.
words.ex_cn: 当球员错失进球时，观众发出了大声的嘘声。
words.en: If you boo a speaker or performer, you shout 'boo' or make other loud sounds to indicate that you do not like them, their opinions, or their performance.

words.ex: Congratulations on your graduation!
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你毕业！
words.en: An expression of pleasure or joy in the success or good fortune of another.

words.ex: Congratulations on your engagement! We are so happy for you.
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你们订婚！我们为你们感到非常高兴。
words.en: Best wishes on your engagement to be married.

words.ex: Congratulations on your marriage!
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你们结婚！
words.en: Best wishes on your wedding day and marriage.

words.w: Congratulations on the birth of your child
words.uk: kənˌɡrætʃʊˈleɪʃənz ɒn ðə bɜːθ əv jɔː tʃaɪld
words.us: kənˌɡrætʃʊˈleɪʃənz ɑːn ðə bɜːrθ əv jɔːr tʃaɪld
words.ex: Congratulations on the birth of your child!
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你喜得贵子！
words.en: Best wishes on the arrival of your new baby.

words.ex: Congratulations on entering the competition!
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你参加比赛！
words.en: Best wishes on your entry into a new place or situation.

words.ex: Congratulations on your promotion, John.
words.ex_cn: 约翰，恭喜你升职。
words.en: An expression of praise and good wishes to someone who has been promoted to a higher position at work.

words.ex: Congratulations on your complete recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你完全康复，手术后恢复得很好。
words.en: Best wishes on your full return to health.

words.tr: phrase. 祝贺你；对你有好处；干得好（用于表达对他人好事的赞赏或讽刺）
words.ex: Good for you for finishing the race!
words.ex_cn: 你完成了比赛，真棒！
words.en: Used to express approval or congratulations to someone for something they have done.

words.ex: I'm going to the store.
words.ex_cn: 我正要去商店。
words.en: I'm is the contraction of 'I am'. It is used in informal English to indicate the present tense of the verb 'to be' for the first person singular.

words.tr: n. 欢呼声；激励；“cheer”的复数；
words.ex: The crowd gave cheers when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众欢呼起来。
words.en: used to express good wishes before drinking; used to express thanks or goodbye

words.tr: 短语 让我们干杯；为某人或某事举杯致意
words.ex: Let's make a toast to our friend's new job.
words.ex_cn: 让我们为朋友的新工作干杯。
words.en: A phrase used to propose a celebratory drink, typically with a short speech or sentiment.

words.tr: 短语 祝你健康（常用于祝酒时）
words.ex: Here's to your health!
words.ex_cn: 祝你健康！
words.en: A traditional toast expressing good wishes for someone's health, often said while raising a glass in celebration or goodwill.

words.w: Let me propose a toast to Mr. Smith
words.tr: 让我为史密斯先生敬酒
words.uk: lɛt mi prəˈpəʊz ə təʊst tu ˈmɪstə ˈsmɪθ
words.us: lɛt mi prəˈpoʊz ə tɔst tu ˈmɪstər ˈsmɪθ
words.ex: Let me propose a toast to Mr. Smith for his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 让我为史密斯先生的辛勤工作敬一杯。
words.en: A formal expression used to invite others to raise their glasses and drink to the health or honor of someone, typically at a celebration or event.

words.tr: phrase. 祝你好运（常用于戏剧界，字面意为‘断条腿’，实为祝福语）
words.ex: Break a leg before your performance!
words.ex_cn: 演出前祝你好运！
words.en: A phrase used to wish someone good luck, especially in the performing arts.

words.ex: I sympathize with you because you lost your job.

words.ex: This coffee is not hot enough to drink.
words.ex_cn: 这杯咖啡还不够热，没法喝。
words.en: Indicates that the coffee is insufficiently heated, lacking the desired warmth.

words.tr: 这面包是软塌塌的；这面包湿软得不成形
words.ex: This bread is soggy because it got wet in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 这块面包变软了，因为它淋雨了。
words.en: Describes bread that is unpleasantly wet and soft, often from excess moisture.

words.ex: These potato chips are stale, so I threw them away.
words.ex_cn: 这些薯片不脆了，所以我把它们扔了。
words.en: Refers to potato chips that have lost their crispness and become soft or stale.

words.ex: This milk is sour, so I threw it away.
words.ex_cn: 这牛奶变酸了，所以我把它扔了。
words.en: Indicates that milk has gone bad, developing a sour taste and smell.

words.ex: This coffee tastes bitter because it was over-brewed.
words.ex_cn: 这杯咖啡尝起来很苦，因为煮过头了。
words.en: Describes coffee with a sharp, unpleasant taste, often due to over-brewing.

words.ex: This meat is tough, so I can't chew it easily.
words.ex_cn: 这块肉很硬，所以我很难咀嚼。
words.en: Describes meat that is difficult to chew due to being tough or fibrous.

words.ex: This soup has a strong flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这道汤味道很浓。
words.en: Refers to a food or drink with a very pronounced and intense taste.

words.ex: The soup is it's too salty to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太咸了，没法吃。
words.en: Indicates that something contains an excessive amount of salt.

words.ex: It's too greasy to eat.
words.ex_cn: 它太油腻了，没法吃。
words.en: Describes food that is unpleasantly oily or fatty.

words.ex: It's too hot to go outside.
words.ex_cn: 外面太热了，不能出去。
words.en: Used to express that the temperature is uncomfortably high.

words.ex: I ate spicy food, and now my mouth is burning.
words.ex_cn: 我吃了辣的食物，现在嘴巴火辣辣的。
words.en: A phrase describing a sensation of intense heat or spiciness in the mouth.

words.tr: 短语，用于礼貌地询问对方是否想要一些（某物），常用于提供食物、饮料等
words.ex: Would you like some water?
words.ex_cn: 你想要一些水吗？
words.en: A polite offer of something to eat or drink.

words.ex: I'd like some more wine with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我想再喝点葡萄酒配晚餐。
words.en: A polite request for an additional serving of wine.

words.ex: I dropped my fork when I heard the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 我听到巨大的噪音时，把叉子掉在地上了。
words.en: An announcement that a fork has fallen, often used to excuse oneself or alert others.

words.w: I'd like another cup of coffee
words.uk: aɪd laɪk əˈnʌðə kʌp əv ˈkɒfi
words.us: aɪd laɪk əˈnʌðə kʌp əv ˈkɔːfi
words.ex: I'd like another cup of coffee, please.
words.ex_cn: 我想要再喝一杯咖啡。
words.en: A polite request for a second cup of coffee.

words.ex: That was good.
words.ex_cn: 那很不错。
words.en: An expression of satisfaction with food or a situation.

words.ex: I'm very full after eating the big dinner.
words.ex_cn: 吃完这顿大餐后，我非常饱。
words.en: A statement indicating a lack of hunger due to having eaten a sufficient amount.

words.ex: There isn't enough water for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 水不够给所有人。
words.en: There is an insufficient amount of something.

words.tr: 你想要再来一杯饮料吗？
words.ex: Would you like another drink?
words.ex_cn: 你想要再来一杯饮料吗？
words.en: A polite offer to provide another alcoholic beverage.

words.w: How do you like your coffee
words.tr: 你喜欢怎么喝你的咖啡？（询问对方对咖啡的偏好，如加糖、加奶或黑咖啡等）
words.uk: haʊ dʊ ju laɪk jɔː ˈkɒfi
words.us: haʊ du ju laɪk jʊr ˈkɔːfi
words.ex: How do you like your coffee? With sugar or without?
words.ex_cn: 你喜欢怎么喝你的咖啡？加糖还是不加糖？
words.en: A question asking about a person's preference for their coffee (e.g., with milk, sugar, black).

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.tr:
int. 请；
v. 使欢喜；取悦；
words.ex: Please pass me the salt.
words.ex_cn: 请把盐递给我。
words.en: to make someone happy or satisfied

words.tr: 副词短语 我该在哪里付款
words.ex: Where should I pay for the coffee?
words.ex_cn: 我该在哪里付咖啡的钱？
words.en: A polite inquiry about the location or method for making a payment.

words.tr: phrase. 我请客；算在我账上；我来付
words.ex: It's on me to pay for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 这次咖啡我来付钱。
words.en: Used to indicate that the speaker will pay for something.

words.ex: Don't worry about the broken chair, I'll take care of it.
words.ex_cn: 别担心那把坏掉的椅子，我会处理好的。
words.en: A statement indicating that one will handle or manage a task or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 这是用来做什么的？
words.ex: He uses algebra to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用代数来解决数学问题。
words.en: A question asking about the purpose or function of something.

words.w: I'm afraid there is a mistake here
words.uk: aɪm əˈfreɪd ðeər ɪz ə meɪsˈtɛk hɪə
words.us: aɪm əˈfreɪd ðer ɪz ə meɪsˈtɛk hɪr
words.ex: I'm afraid there is a mistake here in the math answer.
words.ex_cn: 恐怕这个数学答案这里有个错误。
words.en: A polite expression of concern that an error or problem has occurred.

words.tr: phrase. 我们各付各的账；AA制
words.ex: Let's go Dutch for dinner tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚吃饭我们AA制吧。
words.en: To split a bill equally between people, especially in a restaurant.

words.ex: We'd like to pay separately for our meals.
words.ex_cn: 我们想分开付饭钱。
words.en: A request for individual payments instead of a single bill.

words.tr: phrase. 不用找零了；把零钱当作小费
words.ex: After paying for the coffee, I told the barista to keep the change.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 付完咖啡钱后，我告诉咖啡师不用找零了。
words.en: A phrase used to tell someone to keep the money that is left over after paying for something as a tip or gift.

words.ex: May I have a receipt, please?
words.ex_cn: 我可以要一张收据吗？

words.ex: Where's the tourist information center?
words.ex_cn: 游客信息中心在哪里？
words.en: A question asking for the location of the office that provides information for visitors.

words.w: May I have a free city map
words.tr: 我可以要一份免费的城市地图吗？
words.uk: meɪ aɪ hæv ə friː ˈsɪti mæp
words.us: meɪ aɪ hæv ə friː ˈsɪti mæp
words.ex: May I have a free city map?
words.ex_cn: 我可以要一份免费的城市地图吗？
words.en: A polite request to obtain a map of the city without charge.

words.ex: When does the museum open?
words.ex_cn: 博物馆什么时候开门？
words.en: A question about the time the museum begins its daily operations.

words.w: Please tell me about some interesting places in this town
words.tr: 请告诉我这个城镇的一些有趣的地方
words.ex: Please tell me about some interesting places in this town.
words.ex_cn: 请告诉我这个城镇里一些有趣的地方。
words.en: A request for information about notable or appealing locations within the town.

words.ex: What are your interests?
words.ex_cn: 你的兴趣是什么？
words.en: A question inquiring about a person's hobbies, pastimes, or areas of curiosity.

words.ex: I'm interested in architecture because I like designing buildings.
words.ex_cn: 我对建筑感兴趣，因为我喜欢设计建筑物。
words.en: A statement expressing a personal interest in the study and design of buildings.

words.w: What kind of tours do you have
words.tr: 你有什么样的旅游项目？
words.uk: wɒt kaɪnd əv tʊəz du ju hæv
words.us: wʌt kaɪnd əv tʊrz du ju hæv
words.ex: What kind of tours do you have?
words.ex_cn: 你们有什么类型的旅游线路？
words.en: A question inquiring about the types of guided trips available.

words.ex: Please show me the way to the station.
words.ex_cn: 请告诉我去车站的路。
words.en: A request for directions or guidance to a specific destination.

words.ex: Are they open on Saturdays?
words.ex_cn: 他们周六开门吗？
words.en: A question asking if a place operates on Saturdays.

words.ex: Are there any sightseeing buses in this city?
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有观光巴士吗？
words.en: A question asking if buses are available for touring sights and attractions.

words.w: I'd like a tour by taxi
words.uk: aɪd laɪk ə tʊər baɪ ˈtæksi
words.us: aɪd laɪk ə tʊr baɪ ˈtæksi
words.ex: I'd like a tour by taxi to see the city.
words.ex_cn: 我想坐出租车游览这座城市。
words.en: A request to arrange a tour using a taxi as the mode of transport.

words.ex: I'd like a guide to help me find the museum.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一个向导帮我找到博物馆。
words.en: A polite request for a guide.

words.tr: 我想找一个会说日语的导游
words.uk: aɪ wɒnt ə ˌdʒæpəˈniːz ˈspiːkɪŋ ɡaɪd
words.us: aɪ wɑnt ə ˌdʒæpəˈniːz ˈspiːkɪŋ ɡaɪd
words.ex: I want a Japanese-speaking guide for my trip to Tokyo.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一个会说日语的导游陪我去东京旅行。
words.en: A request for a guide who speaks Japanese.

words.w: How much is it per day
words.uk: haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ɪt pə dɛɪ
words.us: haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ɪt pər deɪ
words.ex: How much is it per day to rent this car?
words.ex_cn: 租这辆车每天多少钱？
words.en: Ask about the daily cost of something.

words.tr: admission n. 入场费；准入；进入权
words.ex: How much is admission to the museum?
words.ex_cn: 参观博物馆的门票多少钱？
words.en: A question about the cost of entry.

words.ex: I bought two tickets for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 我买了两张电影票。

words.tr:
int. 请；
v. 使欢喜；取悦；
words.ex: Please pass me the salt.
words.ex_cn: 请把盐递给我。
words.en: to make someone happy or satisfied

words.ex: What's that building over there?
words.ex_cn: 那边那栋楼是什么？
words.en: A question identifying a specific building.

words.ex: How old is it? The building was built in 1920.
words.ex_cn: 它有多久了？这座建筑建于1920年。
words.en: A question about the age of a person or thing.

words.ex: Can we go in now? The door is open.
words.ex_cn: 我们现在可以进去吗？门开着。
words.en: A question asking for permission to enter.

words.w: Let's go to see the castle
words.uk: lɛts ɡəʊ tə siː ðə ˈkɑːsəl
words.us: lɛts goʊ tə siː ðə ˈkæsəl
words.ex: Let's go to see the castle.
words.ex_cn: 我们去参观城堡吧。
words.en: A suggestion to visit the castle.

words.tr: 感叹语：多么美丽的景色
words.ex: What a beautiful view from the top of the hill!
words.ex_cn: 从山顶上看，景色真美！
words.en: An exclamation expressing admiration for a view.

words.ex: I want to stay longer because the weather is nice.
words.ex_cn: 我想多待一会儿，因为天气很好。
words.en: A statement expressing a desire to remain longer.

words.ex: Let's leave now, it's getting late.
words.ex_cn: 我们现在走吧，天快晚了。
words.en: A suggestion to depart immediately.

words.w: I want to rest a while
words.uk: aɪ wɒnt tə rɛst ə waɪl
words.us: aɪ wɑnt tə rɛst ə waɪl
words.ex: I want to rest a while after walking.
words.ex_cn: 走了一段路后，我想休息一会儿。
words.en: A desire to pause for a short period of relaxation.

words.w: May I take a picture here
words.uk: meɪ aɪ teɪk ə ˈpɪktʃə hɪə
words.us: meɪ aɪ teɪk ə ˈpɪktʃər hɪr
words.ex: May I take a picture here?
words.ex_cn: 我可以在这里拍照吗？
words.en: A polite request for permission to photograph the current location.

words.w: Would you take a picture for us
words.tr: 你会为我们拍张照片吗
words.uk: wʊd juː teɪk ə ˈpɪktʃə fɔːr əs
words.us: wʊd juː teɪk ə ˈpɪktʃər fɔːr əs
words.ex: Would you take a picture for us near the fountain?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我们在喷泉附近拍张照片吗？
words.en: A request for someone to photograph a group, including the speaker.

words.w: Would you mind posing with me
words.tr: 你介意和我一起摆姿势吗？
words.uk: wʊd ju maɪnd ˈpəʊzɪŋ wɪð miː
words.us: wʊd ju maɪnd ˈpoʊzɪŋ wɪð mi
words.ex: Would you mind posing with me for a photo?
words.ex_cn: 你介意和我一起拍张照吗？
words.en: A polite inquiry asking if someone would stand for a photo with the speaker.

words.ex: I'll send the pictures after the party.
words.ex_cn: 聚会后我会发送这些照片。
words.en: A promise to transmit the photographs at a later time.

words.ex: Where is the gift shop?
words.ex_cn: 礼品店在哪里？
words.en: A question asking for the location of a shop selling souvenirs.

words.ex: It's outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 它在房子外面。

words.ex: The book is to the left of the lamp.
words.ex_cn: 书在灯的左边。
words.en: Positioned on the left side of a person or object, or in a political context, favoring left-wing ideas.

words.ex: Can I walk there instead of taking the bus?
words.ex_cn: 我可以走路去那里，而不是坐公交车吗？
words.en: A question inquiring if the destination is reachable on foot.

words.ex: You should take a bus to school because it is faster.
words.ex_cn: 你应该坐公交车去学校，因为更快。
words.en: A recommendation to use public transport for the journey.

words.ex: What's on tonight at the cinema?
words.ex_cn: 今晚电影院有什么电影？
words.en: A question about what films are being shown at cinemas or on television that evening.

words.tr: 疑问句. 它能持续多久？
words.ex: How long does the movie last?
words.ex_cn: 这部电影持续多久？
words.en: used to ask about the duration of something

words.w: What time will it be over

words.us: wʌt taɪm wɪl ɪt bi ˈoʊvər

words.us: aɪd laɪk tə hæv ə ˌdʒæpəˈniːz ˌɪntərˈprɛtər

words.ex_cn: 我想为这次会议请一位日语翻译。
words.en: A request for a person who can translate between Japanese and another language.

words.ex: I can't speak English.
words.ex_cn: 我不会说英语。
words.en: A statement indicating an inability to communicate in the English language.

words.ex: I can't speak fluently because my English isn't good enough.
words.ex_cn: 我不能流利地说，因为我的英语不够好。
words.en: A modest assessment that one's English skills are insufficient for effective communication.

words.ex: He is a Japanese-speaking person who works in Tokyo.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说日语的人，在东京工作。

words.tr:
int. 请；
v. 使欢喜；取悦；
words.ex: Please pass me the salt.
words.ex_cn: 请把盐递给我。

words.ex_cn: 请你慢一点？我跟不上你。

words.uk: aɪd laɪk ə ˌdʒæpəˈniːz ˈspiːkɪŋ ɡaɪd
words.us: aɪd laɪk ə ˌdʒæpəˈniːz ˈspiːkɪŋ ɡaɪd

words.ex_cn: 我说得很慢，但还是无法让别人理解我。
words.en: I am unable to communicate my meaning clearly.

words.tr: 我不知道用英语怎么说

words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’

words.en: What is the English term for this object?

words.ex_cn: 我在火车站被偷了包。
words.en: Someone stole my bag.

words.ex_cn: 你带什么样的包去学校？
words.en: What type of bag was it?

words.ex_cn: 我问里面有什么，他说只是水。

words.ex_cn: 直到我打开盒子，才知道里面有多少。

words.ex_cn: 我们将不胜感激您早日回复关于您的决定。
words.en: We would be grateful for a quick response.

words.w: We look forward to your favorable reply
words.tr: 我们期待您的满意回复
words.uk: wi lʊk ˈfɔːwəd tu jɔː ˈfeɪvərəbl rɪˈplaɪ
words.us: wi lʊk ˈfɔːrwərd tu jɔːr ˈfeɪvərəbl rɪˈplaɪ
words.ex: We look forward to your favorable reply.
words.ex_cn: 我们期待您的满意回复。
words.en: We anticipate a positive reply from you.

words.w: We look forward to hearing from you soon
words.tr: 我们期待尽快收到您的回复
words.uk: wi lʊk ˈfɔːwəd tə ˈhɪərɪŋ frɒm ju suːn
words.us: wi lʊk ˈfɔːrwərd tə ˈhɪrɪŋ frəm ju suːn
words.ex: We look forward to hearing from you soon.
words.ex_cn: 我们期待尽快收到您的回复。
words.en: We eagerly await your response.

words.w: Your prompt attention to this matter will be appreciated
words.tr: 您对此事的及时关注将不胜感激
words.uk: jɔːr  prɒmpt əˈtenʃn tu ðɪs ˈmætər wɪl bi əˈpriːʃieɪtɪd
words.us: jɔːr  prɑːmpt əˈtenʃn tu ðɪs ˈmætər wɪl bi əˈpriːʃieɪtɪd
words.en: We value your swift attention to this matter.

words.w: Please write us at the above address
words.uk: pliːz raɪt ʌs æt ðə əˈbʌv ˈædrəs
words.us: pliːz raɪt ʌs æt ðə əˈbʌv ˈædrəs
words.ex: Please write us at the above address.
words.ex_cn: 请寄信至上述地址。
words.en: Please contact us at the address provided.

words.w: Your kind cooperation in this aspect is greatly appreciated
words.tr: 您在这一方面的友好合作深表感谢
words.ex: Your kind cooperation in this aspect is greatly appreciated.
words.ex_cn: 您在这一方面的友好合作深表感谢。
words.en: Your cooperation in this regard is highly valued.

words.w: We hope we can count on your continued cooperation and support
words.tr: 我们希望可以依赖您持续的合作与支持
words.uk: wiː həʊp wiː kæn萧ʊnt ɒn jɔː kənˈtɪnjuːd ˌkəʊ.əˈpɛə.rəʃən ənd səˈpɔːt
words.us: wiː hoʊp wiː kæn萧ʊnt ɑːn jʊr kənˈtɪnjuːd ˌkoʊ.əˈpɛr.ʃən ənd səˈpɔːrt
words.ex: We hope we can count on your continued cooperation and support.
words.ex_cn: 我们希望可以依赖您持续的合作与支持。
words.en: A polite expression of hope for ongoing assistance and backing.

words.ex: We look forward to your reply.
words.ex_cn: 我们期待您的回复。
words.en: A courteous anticipation of a forthcoming response or action.

words.tr: 我们相信我们的请求将会
words.ex: We trust our request will be approved soon.
words.ex_cn: 我们相信我们的请求将会很快被批准。
words.en: A confident expectation that a request will be granted or fulfilled.

words.w: We are looking forward to the time when
words.uk: wiː ər ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfɔːwəd tuː ðə taɪm wɛn
words.us: wiː ər ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfɔːrwərd tuː ðə taɪm wɛn
words.ex: We are looking forward to the time when we can go home.
words.ex_cn: 我们期待着能回家的时候。
words.en: An expression of eager anticipation for a future event or situation.

words.w: Please do not hesitate to contact us
words.uk: pliːz dəʊ nɒt ˈhɛzɪteɪt tə ˈkɒntækt ʌs
words.us: pliːz doʊ nɑːt ˈhɛzɪteɪt tə ˈkɑːntækt ʌs
words.ex: Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have questions.
words.ex_cn: 如果你有问题，请不要犹豫联系我们。
words.en: A standard invitation to seek help or information without reservation.

words.w: We are always anxious to assist you in
words.tr: 我们总是急于帮助您在
words.uk: wiː ɑːlweɪz ˈæŋkʃəs tə əˈsɪst juː ɪn
words.us: wiː ɑːlweɪz ˈæŋkʃəs tə əˈsɪst juː ɪn
words.ex: We are always anxious to assist you in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 我们总是急于帮助您解决数学问题。
words.en: A statement of readiness and willingness to provide help or support.

words.ex: Should you have any questions, just ask your teacher.
words.ex_cn: 如果你有任何问题，就问老师。

words.w: please do not hesitate to contact us
words.uk: pliːz dəʊ nɒt ˈhɛzɪteɪt tə ˈkɒntækt ʌs
words.us: pliːz doʊ nɑːt ˈhɛzɪteɪt tə ˈkɑːntækt ʌs
words.ex: Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have questions.
words.ex_cn: 如果你有问题，请不要犹豫联系我们。
words.en: A standard invitation to seek help or information without reservation.

words.w: Thank you for calling this matter to our attention
words.tr: 感谢您将此事提请我们注意
words.uk: θæŋk juː fɔː ˈkɔːlɪŋ ðɪs ˈmætə(r) tuː ˈaʊə əˈtenʃən
words.us: θæŋk juː fɔːr ˈkɔːlɪŋ ðɪs ˈmætər tuː ˈaʊər əˈtenʃən
words.ex: Thank you for calling this matter to our attention.
words.ex_cn: 感谢您将此事提请我们注意。
words.en: A thank you for bringing an issue or matter to one's notice.

words.w: Thank you very much for your cooperation
words.uk: θæŋk ju ˈvɛri mʌtʃ fɔːr jɔː kəʊˌɒpəˈreɪʃən
words.us: θæŋk ju ˈvɛri mʌtʃ fɔːr jɔːr koʊˌɑːpəˈreɪʃən
words.ex: Thank you very much for your help.
words.ex_cn: 非常感谢你的帮助。
words.en: I am very grateful for your assistance.

words.w: Thank you for the opportunity to be of service
words.tr: 感谢您给予我提供服务的机会
words.uk: θæŋk juː fɔː ðə ˌɒpəˈtjuːnəti tuː biː əv ˈsɜːvɪs
words.us: θæŋk juː fɔːr ðə ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti tuː biː əv ˈsɜːrvɪs
words.en: A thank you for the chance to provide help or perform a service.

words.ex: We appreciate this opportunity to learn from you.
words.ex_cn: 我们感谢这个机会向您学习。
words.en: A grateful acknowledgment of a chance to assist or contribute.

words.w: It is always a pleasure doing business with you
words.tr: 与您做生意总是令人愉快的
words.uk: ɪt ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ə ˈplɛʒə ˈduːɪŋ ˈbɪznəs wɪð juː
words.us: ɪt ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ə ˈplɛʒər ˈduːɪŋ ˈbɪznəs wɪð juː
words.ex: It is always a pleasure doing business with you.
words.ex_cn: 与您做生意总是令人愉快的
words.en: A polite expression indicating that working with someone is consistently enjoyable.

words.tr: 请接受我们诚挚的道歉
words.ex: Please accept our sincere apologies for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 请接受我们对延误的诚挚道歉。
words.en: A formal way to express regret for a mistake or inconvenience caused.

words.w: I want to extend my personal apologies for
words.tr: 我想向你表达我个人的歉意，以弥补（某事）
words.uk: aɪ wɒnt tə ɪkˈstɛnd maɪ ˈpɜːsənəl əˈpɒlədʒiz fɔː
words.us: aɪ wɑːnt tə ɪkˈstɛnd maɪ ˈpɜːrsənəl əˈpɑːlədʒiz fɔːr
words.ex: I want to extend my personal apologies for being late.
words.ex_cn: 我想为迟到向你表示个人歉意。
words.en: A personal and sincere expression of regret for a specific action or situation.

words.w: We wish you a bright and successful New Year
words.tr: 祝你有一个光明而成功的新年
words.uk: wi wɪʃ ju ə braɪt ənd səkˈsesfʊl njuː jɪə
words.us: wi wɪʃ ju ə braɪt ənd səkˈsesfəl nuː jɪr
words.ex: We wish you a bright and successful new year.
words.ex_cn: 祝你有一个光明而成功的新年。
words.en: A warm wish for happiness and success in the coming year.

words.w: We trust that an increase in will continue in the future
words.tr: 我们相信，……的增加在未来将继续
words.ex: We trust that an increase in sales will continue in the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们相信，销售额的增加在未来将继续。
words.en: A formal expression of confidence that a positive trend will persist.

words.ex: This book is yours.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是你的。
words.en: Used to refer to something belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.tr: adj. 每一个汤姆（泛指任何人，常与 'dick' 和 'harry' 连用，表示泛指普通人）
words.ex: Every tom, dick, and harry was at the party.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都在派对上。

words.tr: n. 无关紧要的人（常用于否定句中，表示‘任何小人物’）
words.ex: I don't care about dick and harry; I only care about my own work.
words.ex_cn: 我不关心那些无关的人，我只关心自己的工作。

words.w: Out of the frying pan into the fire
words.tr: phrase. 从一个困境跳入另一个更糟的困境；逃出火坑，又入火海
words.uk: aʊt əv ðə ˈfraɪɪŋ pæn ˈɪntu ðə ˈfaɪə
words.us: aʊt əv ðə ˈfraɪɪŋ pæn ˈɪntu ðə ˈfaɪər
words.ex: He left his old job, but out of the frying pan into the fire, he got a much worse one.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了旧工作，但又从一个困境跳入了更糟的困境，找到了一份更差的工作。
words.en: A situation that changes from bad to worse, often due to a hasty or ill-considered action.

words.tr: 我活着就是为了吃；我以吃为生
words.ex: I live to eat, so I try new food every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我活着就是为了吃，所以每个周末我都尝试新食物。
words.en: A humorous expression indicating that one's primary motivation in life is the enjoyment of food.

words.tr: 谚语. 每个人都有得意的时候；风水轮流转
words.ex: He lost the game, but every dog has his day.
words.ex_cn: 他输了比赛，但每个人都会有走运的一天。
words.en: This proverb means that everyone will have good luck or success at some point in their lives.

words.tr: phrase. 说曹操，曹操就到（刚提到某人，此人就出现了）
words.ex: I was just thinking about Tom, and speak of the devil, he walked in.
words.ex_cn: 我刚在想汤姆，说曹操曹操就到，他进来了。
words.en: used when someone you have been talking about appears unexpectedly

words.tr: 习语 爱是盲目的；形容人在恋爱时忽视对方的缺点或现实问题
words.ex: He ignored her bad temper because love is blind.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了她的坏脾气，因为爱是盲目的。
words.en: A proverb meaning that love can cause people to overlook flaws or faults in their beloved.

words.w: Kill two birds with one stone
words.tr: phrase. 一石二鸟；一举两得
words.ex: By going to the grocery store, I can kill two birds with one stone and pick up dinner ingredients and some office supplies.
words.ex_cn: 去杂货店我可以一举两得，既买了晚餐的食材，又买了一些办公用品。
words.en: To achieve two things at the same time with a single action.

words.tr: phrase. 没有消息就是好消息（表示没有消息通常意味着一切顺利）
words.ex: I haven't heard from him in weeks, but no news is good news.
words.ex_cn: 我已经几周没有他的消息了，但没有消息就是好消息。
words.en: If you do not hear any news about someone or something, it is likely that everything is fine and nothing bad has happened.

words.tr: 短语. 光阴似箭；时光飞逝
words.ex: Time flies when we are having fun.
words.ex_cn: 当我们玩得开心时，光阴似箭。
words.en: Time seems to pass very quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 多面手；万事通；杂而不精的人
words.ex: He was a Jack of all trades, but a master of none.
words.ex_cn: 他是个杂而不精的人，但不是任何领域的专家。
words.en: A person who can do many different types of work but who is not necessarily very good at any of them.

words.tr: n. 无所专长的人；样样通、样样松的人
words.ex: He tries to learn many skills, but he is a master of none.
words.ex_cn: 他试图学习很多技能，但样样通，样样松。

words.ex: He didn't believe the magic trick until he saw it, and then he said, 'Seeing is believing.'
words.ex_cn: 他直到亲眼看到那个魔术才相信，然后他说：'眼见为实。'
words.en: A proverb meaning that it is better to see something for oneself than to hear about it from others.

words.w: There is no smoke without fire
words.tr: 谚语 无风不起浪；事出有因
words.uk: ðeər ɪz nəʊ sməʊk wɪˈθaʊt ˈfaɪə(r)
words.us: ðɛr ɪz noʊ smoʊk wɪˈθaʊt ˈfaɪɚ
words.ex: He was accused of stealing, and there is no smoke without fire.
words.ex_cn: 他被指控偷窃，无风不起浪。
words.en: A proverb meaning that rumors or suspicions often have a basis in truth.

words.tr: 谚语. 诚实是最好的策略；做人应以诚实为上策
words.us: ˈɑːnəsti ɪz ðə bɛst ˈpɑːli si
words.ex: He always tells the truth because honesty is the best policy.
words.ex_cn: 他总是说真话，因为诚实是最好的策略。
words.en: A proverb advising that telling the truth is always the most advantageous course of action in the long run.

words.tr: phrase. 迟做总比不做好；晚来总比不来强
words.ex: I started exercising last week—better late than never.
words.ex_cn: 我上周才开始锻炼——迟做总比不做好。
words.en: It is better to do something late than to not do it at all.

words.tr: 习语. 男孩天性如此；男孩子调皮捣蛋是正常的
words.ex: When they saw the mud puddle, they jumped right in—boys will be boys.
words.ex_cn: 当他们看到泥坑时，直接跳了进去——男孩总是男孩。
words.en: An expression used to say that it is not surprising or unusual when men or boys behave in energetic, rough, or inappropriate ways. It suggests that such behavior is typical and to be expected.

words.ex: Knowledge is power.
words.ex_cn: 知识就是力量。
words.en: Understanding and information give you the ability to achieve success.

words.w: Rome was not built in a day
words.tr: 谚语. 罗马不是一天建成的；伟业非一日之功
words.uk: ˈrəʊm wɒz nɒt bɪlt ɪn ə deɪ
words.us: ˈroʊm wʌz nɑːt bɪlt ɪn ə deɪ
words.ex: Rome was not built in a day.
words.ex_cn: 罗马不是一天建成的。
words.en: Significant achievements require time and patience to accomplish.

words.tr: phrase. 条条大路通罗马；比喻达到同一目的可以有多种不同的方法或途径
words.ex: All roads lead to Rome, no matter how you start.
words.ex_cn: 无论你怎么开始，所有路都通向罗马。
words.en: All methods or paths lead to the same goal or outcome.

words.tr: idiom. 入乡随俗（字面意思为“在罗马时”，完整表达为“When in Rome, do as the Romans do.”）
words.ex: When in Rome, he ate pasta like the locals.
words.ex_cn: 到了罗马，他就像当地人一样吃意大利面。
words.en: When in a foreign place, do as the local people do.

words.tr: phrase. 入乡随俗；按照当地的做法行事
words.ex: When he visited Italy, he decided to do as the Romans do and eat pasta for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 当他访问意大利时，他决定入乡随俗，晚餐吃意大利面。
words.en: A proverb advising that when in a foreign place, one should follow the local customs and practices.

words.ex: She practiced the piano every day, and now she plays beautifully. Practice makes perfect.
words.ex_cn: 她每天练习钢琴，现在弹得非常优美。熟能生巧。
words.en: The phrase 'practice makes perfect' means that by repeatedly doing something, you can become very good at it.

words.tr: 习语. 历史重演；过去的事情再次发生
words.ex: History repeats itself when people forget the past.
words.ex_cn: 当人们忘记过去时，历史就会重演。
words.en: The idea that events in history tend to occur again in similar ways.

words.ex: When it rains, the streets get wet.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，街道会变湿。

words.ex: It is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 它在桌子上。
words.en: used to refer to a thing previously mentioned or easily identified

words.tr: 谚语 有志者事竟成
words.ex: He failed many times, but where there's a will, he kept trying.
words.ex_cn: 他失败了很多次，但只要有决心，他就继续努力。

words.ex: There's a way to solve this problem easily.
words.ex_cn: 有一种简单的方法可以解决这个问题。

words.tr: 谚语. 行动比言语更有说服力；事实胜于雄辩
words.ex: He said he would help, but actions speak louder than words.
words.ex_cn: 他说他会帮忙，但行动胜于言辞。
words.en: This phrase means that what you do is more important and shows your intentions and feelings more clearly than what you say.

words.tr: adj. 来得容易的（常用于短语 easy come, easy go，表示来得快去得也快）
words.ex: He got the money easy come, easy go.
words.ex_cn: 他钱来得容易，去得也快。

words.tr: adj. 随和的；轻松的；不拘束的
words.ex: He is an easy go person who never gets upset.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个随和的人，从不生气。

words.tr: 习语. 血浓于水，指血缘关系比其他关系更为牢固
words.ex: Even though they argued, he helped his brother because blood is thicker than water.
words.ex_cn: 即使他们吵架了，他还是帮了弟弟，因为血浓于水。
words.en: A proverb meaning family relationships are stronger and more important than other bonds or loyalties.

words.tr: 像父亲一样；有其父必有其子
words.ex: He runs fast, like father, like son.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，有其父必有其子。

words.ex: He treats his dog like son.
words.ex_cn: 他对待他的狗就像对待儿子一样。

words.w: All's fair in love and war
words.tr: 谚语. 在爱情和战争中，一切手段都是正当的
words.uk: ɔːlz feər ɪn lʌv ənd wɔː
words.us: ɔːlz fer ɪn lʌv ənd wɔːr
words.ex: He lied to win her heart, but all's fair in love and war.
words.ex_cn: 他为了赢得她的心而撒了谎，但在爱情和战争中，一切手段都是正当的。
words.en: A proverb meaning that in matters of love and conflict, people may use methods that would be considered unfair in other situations.

words.tr: 谚语 美貌只是肤浅的；外貌美丽并不等于内在美好
words.ex: Don't judge her by her looks; beauty is only skin deep.
words.ex_cn: 不要以貌取人；美貌只是肤浅的。
words.en: A proverb meaning that physical attractiveness is superficial and not indicative of a person's true character or worth.

words.w: The grass is always greener on the other side
words.tr: 谚语 东边不亮西边亮；这山望着那山高；别人的生活总是更好
words.uk: ðə ɡrɑːs ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈɡriːnə ɒn ðə ˈʌðə saɪd
words.us: ðə ɡræs ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈɡriːnər ɑːn ðə ˈʌðər saɪd
words.ex: He quit his job to travel, but now he misses his old office — the grass is always greener on the other side.
words.ex_cn: 他辞了工作去旅行，但现在他怀念以前的办公室——东边不亮西边亮。
words.en: A proverb suggesting that other people's situations or circumstances often seem more desirable than one's own, but this is often an illusion.

words.w: You cannot make an omelet without breaking eggs
words.tr: 谚语 不打破鸡蛋就做不成煎蛋卷；比喻想要有所成就，就必须付出代价或经历必要的牺牲
words.uk: juː ˈkæn.nɒt meɪk ən ˈɒm.lət wɪðˈaʊt ˈbreɪ.kɪŋ ɛɡz
words.us: juː ˈkæn.nɑt meɪk ən ˈɑː.mə.lət wɪðˈaʊt ˈbreɪ.kɪŋ ɛɡz
words.ex: You cannot make an omelet without breaking eggs, so don't be upset about the small losses.
words.ex_cn: 不打破鸡蛋就做不成煎蛋卷，所以不要为小小的损失生气。
words.en: A proverb meaning that it is impossible to achieve something important without causing some unpleasantness or making sacrifices.

words.w: A rolling stone gathers no moss
words.tr: phrase. 滚石不生苔；人挪活，树挪死；比喻经常变换环境或职业的人不会积累负担或牵绊，但也可能错失稳定与积累
words.uk: ə ˈrəʊlɪŋ stəʊn ˈɡæðəz nəʊ mɒs
words.us: ə ˈroʊlɪŋ stoʊn ˈɡæðərz noʊ mɔːs
words.ex: He never stays in one job long; a rolling stone gathers no moss.
words.ex_cn: 他从不长时间待在一个工作上；滚石不生苔。
words.en: A person who keeps moving avoids stagnation.

words.w: A friend in need is a friend indeed
words.uk: ə frend ɪn niːd ɪz ə frend ɪnˈdiːd
words.us: ə friend ɪn nid ɪz ə friend ɪnˈid
words.ex: When I lost my job, Tom helped me — a friend in need is a friend indeed.
words.ex_cn: 当我失业时，汤姆帮了我——患难见真情。
words.en: A proverb meaning a true friend is one who helps you when you are in trouble.

words.w: All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy
words.tr: 习语. 只工作不玩耍，聪明的孩子也变傻；强调劳逸结合的重要性
words.uk: ɔːl wɜːk ənd nəʊ pleɪ meɪks dʒæk ə dʌl bɔɪ
words.us: ɔːl wɜːrk ənd noʊ pleɪ meks dʒæk ə dʌl bɔɪ
words.ex: He works every day and never rests; all work and no play makes jack a dull boy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天工作从不休息，只工作不玩耍，聪明孩子也变呆。
words.en: Proverb: used to say that if a person works all the time and does not relax, they will become very boring.

words.w: The proof of the pudding is in the eating
words.tr: 谚语 事实胜于雄辩；效果才是检验真理的标准
words.uk: ðə pruːf əv ðə ˈpʊdɪŋ ɪz ɪn ðə ˈiːtɪŋ
words.us: ðə pruːf əv ðə ˈpʊdɪŋ ɪz ɪn ðə ˈiːtɪŋ
words.ex: He says his new diet works, but the proof of the pudding is in the eating.
words.ex_cn: 他说他的新饮食有效，但事实胜于雄辩。
words.en: A proverb meaning that the true value or quality of something can only be judged by experiencing or testing it directly.

words.w: Time and tide wait for no man
words.tr: 谚语：时光与潮汐不等人（意指时间不等人，应珍惜当下）
words.uk: /taɪm ənd taɪd weɪt fɔː nəʊ mæn/
words.us: /taɪm ənd taɪd weɪt fɔr noʊ mæn/
words.ex: He missed the train because he was late; time and tide wait for no man.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到错过了火车；时光和潮水不等人。
words.en: This proverb means that opportunities and time do not wait for anyone; one must act promptly and not delay.

words.tr: adv. 越早越好（常用于句型 the sooner... the better）
words.ex: The sooner you start, the sooner you will finish.
words.ex_cn: 你越早开始，就越早完成。

words.tr: adv. 更好的（用于比较结构中，如 'the more, the better'）
words.ex: This book is the better choice for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是初学者更好的选择。

words.tr: phrase. 准确无误地；恰好；正好
words.ex: He guessed the price on the nose.
words.ex_cn: 他准确地说出了价格。
words.en: Exactly right; precisely correct or accurate.

words.ex: The children are playing hide-and-seek in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在花园里玩捉迷藏。
words.en: A children's game in which one player tries to find and catch others who are hiding.

words.tr: 短语. 未完待续；下回分解
words.ex: The story is not finished; to be continued.
words.ex_cn: 故事还没结束；未完待续。
words.en: To be continued: indicating that something is not finished and will be resumed later.

words.tr: phrase. 一个巴掌拍不响；双方都有责任
words.ex: When they argue, it takes two to tango.
words.ex_cn: 当他们争吵时，一个巴掌拍不响。
words.en: used to say that both people involved in a bad situation are responsible for it

words.tr: phrase. 尽快，尽早（表示某事应以最快速度完成）
words.ex: Please send the report as soon as possible.
words.ex_cn: 请尽快发送报告。
words.en: If you say that something will happen as soon as possible, you mean that it will happen as quickly as it can.

words.tr: adj. 无限量供应的；自助式的（指餐饮）
words.ex: We went to an all-you-can-eat buffet for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们去吃了一家无限量供应的自助餐晚餐。
words.en: A restaurant or meal where customers can eat as much as they want for a fixed price.

words.ex: He answered all the multiple-choice questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些选择题。
words.en: A multiple-choice question is a question type in which the respondent is asked to select one or more options from a list of possible answers.

words.ex: I am ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 我准备好考试了。
words.en: If you are ready, you are prepared for something or are in a suitable state to do or deal with it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 准备好；做好准备（常用于命令或鼓励语气，如 'Get set, go!'）
words.ex: He gets set for the race quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快做好了赛跑的准备。
words.en: Get ready; prepare for a race or event by assuming a starting position.

words.ex: He goes to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天去上学。
words.en: To move or travel from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 从头到尾；全面地；无所不包的
words.ex: He read the book from a to z.
words.ex_cn: 他从头到尾读了这本书。
words.en: Thoroughly; covering every detail or aspect from beginning to end.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.w: As far as I can remember
words.tr: phrase. 就我所记得的；据我所知
words.uk: æz fɑːr æz aɪ kæn rɪˈmembə(r)
words.us: æz fɑːr æz aɪ kæn rɪˈmembər
words.ex: As far as I can remember, we met at a conference in 2015.
words.ex_cn: 据我所记得的，我们在2015年的一次会议上见过。
words.en: to the extent that one can recall or remember something.

words.tr: phrase. 以牙还牙；针锋相对的报复行为
words.ex: He insulted me, so I insulted him back — it's just tit for tat.
words.ex_cn: 他侮辱了我，所以我回敬了他——这就是以牙还牙。
words.en: If you say that someone is using a tit-for-tat strategy, you mean that they are doing the same thing that someone else has done to them, especially something bad, as a way of punishing them or getting revenge.

words.tr: 那就是我在这里的原因
words.ex: You need help? That's what I'm here for.
words.ex_cn: 你需要帮助？那就是我在这里的原因。
words.en: A polite and confident response indicating that one is present and ready to assist or provide what is needed.

words.ex: Two and three is five.
words.ex_cn: 两加三等于五。
words.en: A simple, factual statement of basic arithmetic, often used to illustrate an obvious truth or to confirm a straightforward calculation.

words.w: We're as different as night and day
words.tr: 我们截然不同，像黑夜与白天一样
words.uk: wiːr æz ˈdɪfərənt æz naɪt ænd deɪ
words.us: wɪr æz ˈdɪfərənt æz naɪt ænd deɪ
words.ex: We're as different as night and day when it comes to music preferences.
words.ex_cn: 在音乐喜好上，我们截然不同，像黑夜与白天一样。
words.en: Extremely different in character or nature.

words.tr: v. （非正式）猴子看到，模仿他人行为（常用于短语 monkey see, monkey do）
words.ex: He copied the teacher's answer—monkey see, monkey do.
words.ex_cn: 他抄了老师的答案——你学我样。

words.tr: v. 机械地模仿；盲目跟随（常用于短语 'monkey see, monkey do'，表示看到什么就跟着做什么）
words.ex: He just monkey do what others do, without thinking.
words.ex_cn: 他只是盲目模仿别人，从不思考。

words.ex: First come, first served.
words.ex_cn: 先到先得。
words.en: The principle that those who arrive first will be served or dealt with before those who arrive later.

words.ex: The tickets are first served, so arrive early.
words.ex_cn: 门票是先到先得的，所以早点来。
words.en: The principle that those who arrive first are given priority or served before others.

words.ex: This phone is old; it's out of date.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很旧了，它已过时。
words.en: No longer current or fashionable.

words.w: TV has its merits and demerits
words.ex: TV has its merits and demerits.
words.ex_cn: 电视有其优缺点。
words.en: Television has both good and bad aspects.

words.w: I took advantage of his weakness
words.uk: aɪ tʊk ədˈvɑːntɪdʒ əv hɪz ˈwiːknəs
words.us: aɪ tʊk ədˈvæntɪdʒ əv hɪz ˈwiːknəs
words.ex: I took advantage of his weakness and won the game.
words.ex_cn: 我利用了他的弱点，赢得了比赛。
words.en: I exploited his vulnerability for my gain.

words.ex: I've learned something new today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天学到了一些新东西。
words.en: I have gained new knowledge or understanding.

words.ex: Leaving clothes near the heater is it's a fire hazard.
words.ex_cn: 把衣服放在暖气附近是一个火灾隐患。
words.en: It poses a risk of causing a fire.

words.ex: Don't worry, anything could happen tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 别担心，明天任何事情都可能发生。
words.en: Any outcome is possible.

words.tr: 用于将来参考；以备日后查阅
words.ex: I wrote down the address for future reference.
words.ex_cn: 我把地址写下来以备将来参考。
words.en: Kept for possible use or consultation in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 背着我；在我不知情的情况下
words.ex: They made plans behind my back.
words.ex_cn: 他们背着我制定了计划。
words.en: Done secretly or without one's knowledge.

words.tr: 短语. 换换口味；改变一下；为了有所不同
words.ex: He ate pasta for a change.
words.ex_cn: 他换换口味，吃了意大利面。
words.en: If you do something for a change, you do something different from your usual routine or habits.

words.tr: phrase. 金钱万能；有钱能使鬼推磨
words.ex: In this world, money talks and people listen.
words.ex_cn: 在这个世界上，金钱万能，人们都听从。
words.en: Used to say that money has a powerful influence and can make things happen.

words.tr: phrase. 永不言败；永不放弃
words.ex: He lost the game but never say die.
words.ex_cn: 他输了比赛，但永不言败。
words.en: Never give up; maintain hope and determination.

words.tr: phrase. 让过去的事过去吧；既往不咎；过去的就让它过去
words.ex: They decided to let bygones be bygones and start fresh.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定放下过去，重新开始。
words.en: To forgive past offenses and move on without holding grudges.

words.tr: phrase. 总比没有好；聊胜于无
words.ex: I only have a sandwich, but it's better than nothing.
words.ex_cn: 我只有一个三明治，但总比没有好。
words.en: An expression meaning that a modest or inferior option is preferable to having nothing at all.

words.tr: phrase. 只在顺境时才做朋友的人；不能共患难的朋友
words.ex: He is a fair-weather friend who leaves when things get hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个只在顺境时才陪伴的朋友，一有困难就离开。
words.en: A person who is only supportive or friendly in times of success or good fortune.

words.tr: phrase. 每一份小小的帮助都有用；积少成多，点滴援助亦有帮助
words.ex: Every little bit helps when you save money.
words.ex_cn: 存钱时，每一点都有帮助。
words.en: Even a small amount of assistance is valuable.

words.w: I want to take a nap
words.uk: aɪ wɒnt tə teɪk ə næp
words.us: aɪ wɑnt tə teɪk ə næp
words.ex: I want to take a nap after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我想在午饭后小睡一会儿。
words.en: I want to sleep for a short time.

words.ex: I'm going to lie down because I feel tired.
words.ex_cn: 我打算躺下休息，因为我感到累了。
words.en: I am going to recline and rest.
You are feigning sleep.

words.tr: 你当时在睡觉吗？（过去进行时，用于询问对方过去某一时刻是否在睡觉）
words.ex: Were you sleeping when I called?
words.ex_cn: 我打电话的时候你睡着了吗？
words.en: Were you asleep?

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.ex: I was awake when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响的时候，我醒着。

words.w: Will you change the baby's diaper
words.uk: wɪl juː tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈbeɪbiːz ˈdaɪpər
words.us: wɪl juː tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈbeɪbiːz ˈdaɪpər
words.ex: Will you change the baby's diaper after lunch?
words.ex_cn: 午饭后你给婴儿换尿布吗？
words.en: A question asking if someone will change the baby's diaper.

words.ex: Do you need to pee before we leave?
words.ex_cn: 我们走之前你需要上厕所吗？
words.en: A question asking if someone needs to urinate.

words.ex: It's time to go wee-wee, so let's head to the bathroom.
words.ex_cn: 该去小便了，我们去洗手间吧。
words.en: An expression indicating it is time to urinate.

words.tr: n. <主美>躲躲猫（一种把脸一隐一现以逗小孩的游戏）
words.ex: The baby laughs when Mom plays peekaboo.
words.ex_cn: 当妈妈玩躲猫猫时，宝宝会笑。
words.en: A simple game played with young children, involving hiding and revealing the face.

words.ex: The baby said 'kuchi-kuchi-koo' while playing with toys.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝玩玩具时说着‘kuchi-kuchi-koo’。
words.en: An onomatopoeic phrase mimicking the sound of chewing or eating, often used playfully.

words.ex: Let's play catch in the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 放学后我们去公园玩接球吧。
words.en: An invitation to play a game where a ball is thrown and caught.

words.ex: The water is leaking from the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水正从破掉的管道里漏出来。
words.en: A statement that water is escaping from a container or pipe.

words.tr: adj. 很多灰尘的；积满灰尘的
words.ex: It's so dusty in the attic that I couldn't see the floor.
words.ex_cn: 阁楼里积了厚厚一层灰，我都看不见地板了。
words.en: A statement that there is a lot of fine, dry powder in the air.

words.ex: It's stuffy in this room, so I opened the window.
words.ex_cn: 这房间很闷，所以我打开了窗户。
words.en: A statement that the air in the room is warm, humid, and lacks fresh air.

words.tr: adj. 这个房间有穿堂风；通风不良的
words.ex: It's drafty in this room, so I closed the window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有穿堂风，所以我关上了窗户。
words.en: A statement that there is an unpleasant cold current of air in the room.

words.ex: Will you feed the dog before you leave?
words.ex_cn: 你走之前会喂狗吗？
words.en: A question asking if someone will give food to a dog.

words.w: Will you take the dog for a walk
words.uk: wɪl juː teɪk ðə dɒɡ fɔːr ə wɔːk
words.us: wɪl juː teɪk ðə dɔːɡ fɔːr ə wɔːk
words.ex: Will you take the dog for a walk after dinner?
words.ex_cn: 你晚饭后带狗去散步吗？
words.en: A question asking if someone will take a dog for a walk.

words.w: Take care of my brother and sister
words.uk: teɪk keər əv maɪ ˈbrʌðər ænd ˈsɪstər
words.us: teɪk kɛr əv maɪ ˈbrʌðər ænd ˈsɪstər
words.ex: I take care of my brother and sister every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天照顾我的弟弟和妹妹。
words.en: To look after and provide for your siblings.

words.ex: Please water the plants every morning.
words.ex_cn: 请每天早上给植物浇水。
words.en: To add water to the plants to help them grow.

words.tr: 感叹词短语。表示‘真是一团糟’或‘多么混乱啊’
words.ex: What a mess! The toys are all over the floor.
words.ex_cn: 真乱啊！玩具到处都是。
words.en: An expression of frustration at a chaotic situation.

words.ex: He is learning algebra to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习代数以通过考试。
words.en: A request for assistance or support.

words.ex: Mom told me to clean up my room before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈让我在晚饭前整理好房间。
words.en: To tidy and organize your personal space.

words.w: Help me clean up the house
words.uk: hɛlp miː kliːn ʌp ðə haʊs
words.us: hɛlp mi klin ʌp ðə haʊs
words.ex: Can you help me clean up the house after dinner?
words.ex_cn: 你能在晚饭后帮我打扫一下房子吗？
words.en: Assist me in making the house tidy and orderly.

words.ex: We're out of dish detergent, so we can't wash the plates.
words.ex_cn: 我们洗碗液用完了，所以洗不了盘子。
words.en: We have no more dishwashing liquid left.

words.w: Would you put up the clothes to dry
words.tr: 你会把衣服挂起来晾干吗？
words.uk: wʊd ju pʊt ʌp ðə kləʊðz tə draɪ
words.us: wʊd ju pʊt ʌp ðə kloʊðz tə draɪ
words.ex: Would you put up the clothes to dry?
words.ex_cn: 你能把衣服挂起来晾干吗？
words.en: Would you hang the wet laundry on a line to dry?

words.w: Will you help me fold up the clothes
words.ex: Will you help me fold up the clothes after the laundry?
words.ex_cn: 你能在洗衣后帮我把衣服叠起来吗？
words.en: Will you assist me in folding the clean laundry?

words.ex: Please sweep the floor before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 请在晚饭前扫地。
words.en: Use a broom to remove dirt from the floor.

words.ex: Please scrub the sink with soap and water.
words.ex_cn: 请用肥皂和水擦洗水槽。
words.en: Clean the sink thoroughly, often with a brush.

words.w: I have to vacuum my room
words.ex: I have to vacuum my room every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我每个周末都必须吸尘打扫我的房间。
words.en: I need to clean my room using a vacuum cleaner.

words.ex: Please dust the shelves before the guests arrive.
words.ex_cn: 请在客人到来之前给书架除尘。
words.en: A request to clean shelves by removing dust with a cloth or duster.

words.ex: Please mop the floor before the guests arrive.
words.ex_cn: 请在客人到来之前拖一下地板。
words.en: A request to clean the floor using a mop and water or cleaning solution.

words.ex: Will you iron the shirt before the meeting?
words.ex_cn: 你能在会议前把衬衫烫平吗？
words.en: A question asking if someone will press a shirt with an iron to remove wrinkles.

words.w: I have to iron my skirt
words.ex: I have to iron my skirt before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 我在会议前必须熨我的裙子。
words.en: A statement indicating the speaker must press their skirt with an iron to smooth it.

words.ex: Let's go grocery shopping after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我们午饭后去购物吧。
words.en: A suggestion to go to a store to buy food and other household items.

words.ex: The park was crowded on Sunday afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 星期天下午，公园里人很多。
words.en: The park had many people in it, making it feel full and possibly busy.

words.tr: 你能今晚帮忙照看孩子吗？
words.ex: Can you baby-sit tonight while I go to work?
words.ex_cn: 今晚我去上班，你能帮忙照看孩子吗？
words.en: A question asking if someone can care for a child or children tonight.

words.ex: This is for you.
words.ex_cn: 这是给你的。
words.en: A gift or item is being offered or given to the person being addressed.

words.ex: This is your share of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 这是你的那部分披萨。
words.en: The portion of something (like money or food) that belongs to the person being addressed.

words.w: What do you want for your birthday
words.uk: wɒt djuː wɒnt fɔːr jɔː ˈbɜːθdeɪ
words.us: wʌt duː wɑːnt fɔːr jɔːr ˈbɜrθdeɪ
words.ex: What do you want for your birthday?
words.ex_cn: 你生日想要什么？
words.en: A question asking what gift the person would like to receive for their birthday.

words.tr: interj. （表示惊喜或展示成果时的感叹）瞧好了！看吧！
words.ex: Ta-dah! I made this cake all by myself!
words.ex_cn: 瞧好了！这蛋糕是我自己做的！
words.en: An exclamation used to announce a reveal or the completion of a task, similar to 'ta-da'.

words.w: I usually work out after work
words.uk: aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli wɜːk aʊt ˈɑːftə wɜːk
words.us: aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli wɜːrk aʊt ˈæftər wɜːrk
words.ex: I usually work out after work.
words.ex_cn: 我通常下班后锻炼。
words.en: I typically exercise after finishing my job.

words.ex: I've started jogging every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上开始慢跑以保持健康。
